ucs.kql:
let _server_parents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","java.exe","java","javaw.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nginx.exe","nginx","xrdp","xrdp-sesman","portainer.exe","portainer","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek-tui","n8n.exe","n8n","flowise","ruby.exe","ruby","perl","go","php-fpm"]);
let _shells_lolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let _build_noise = @"(?i)(npm\s+(test|install|run|ci)|cargo\s+(test|build|run)|gradle\s|mvn\s+(install|test|package)|pip\s+install|go\s+test|jest|pytest|eslint|prettier|webpack)";
let _cradle = @"(?i)(base64\s+-d|/dev/tcp/|bash\s+-i|powershell\s+-(e|enc)|FromBase64String|IEX |Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|certutil\s+-urlcache|wget\s+http|curl\s+-s\s+http)";
let _spawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_server_parents)
    | where FileName in~ (_shells_lolbins)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId,
              SHA256;
let _egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionAttempt")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
_spawn
| join kind=leftouter _egress on DeviceId, $left.ChildPid == $right.NetPid
| extend EgressWithinWindow = iif(isnotnull(NetTime) and datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime) between (0 .. 300), true, false)
| extend SuspiciousCmd = ChildCmd matches regex _cradle
| where EgressWithinWindow or SuspiciousCmd
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildPid, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, NetTime, EgressWithinWindow, SuspiciousCmd
| order by SpawnTime desc

ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, values(Processes.process_path) as child_paths, values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","php-fpm","php-cgi","php-cgi.exe","php.exe","php","httpd","httpd.exe","apache2","nginx","nginx.exe","node","node.exe","n8n","n8n.exe","python","python3","python.exe","ruby","ruby.exe","java","java.exe","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","utcp","utcp.exe","strapi","ghost","drupal","yeswiki") AND Processes.process_name IN ("ssh","ssh.exe","git","git.exe","bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","pwsh","cmd.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat","python","python3","perl","ruby") by host, Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval injection_class = case(match(process,"(?i)(-oProxyCommand|-o\s+ProxyCommand|-oIdentityFile=|ProxyJump=)"),"ssh-argv-injection", match(process,"(?i)(--upload-pack=|--receive-pack=|-c\s+core\.sshCommand|--exec=)"),"git-argv-injection", match(process,"(?i)(-EncodedCommand|\s-enc\s|\s-ec\s)"),"powershell-encoded", match(process,"(?i)(\$\(|`[^`]{2,}`|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|powershell|base64|chmod)|\|\s*(sh|bash|nc|base64|tee)|&&\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|powershell))"),"shell-metachars", match(process,"(?i)(/dev/tcp/|bash\s+-i|nc\s+-e|base64\s+-d|python\S*\s+-c\s+['\"]\s*(import|exec|os\.system))"),"reverse-shell-pattern", match(process,"(?i)(--config\s|\s-K\s|--upload-file|\s-T\s+[A-Za-z/])"),"curl-argv-injection", "") | where injection_class!="" | search NOT user IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","root") AND NOT match(user,"\\$$") | sort 0 - lastTime

let ServiceParents = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","php-fpm","php-cgi","php-cgi.exe","php.exe","php","httpd","httpd.exe","apache2","nginx","nginx.exe","node","node.exe","n8n","n8n.exe","python","python3","python.exe","ruby","ruby.exe","java","java.exe","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","utcp","utcp.exe","strapi","ghost","drupal","yeswiki"]);
let InterpreterChildren = dynamic(["ssh","ssh.exe","git","git.exe","bash","sh","dash","zsh","ksh","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","pwsh","cmd.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat","python","python3","perl","ruby"]);

| extend SshArg   = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(-oProxyCommand|-o\s+ProxyCommand|-oIdentityFile=|ProxyJump=)"
| extend GitArg   = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(--upload-pack=|--receive-pack=|-c\s+core\.sshCommand|--exec=)"

ucs.title: [LLM] Onyx Sleet (Andariel) public-facing exploit → web-tier process spawning download LOLBins
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Andariel initial-access chain: a Java/IIS/Tomcat web worker process spawning cmd/PowerShell that then drops second-stage payloads via certutil, bitsadmin, curl or Invoke-WebRequest. This is the documented post-exploitation pattern after Andariel weaponises Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228), ManageEngine ServiceDesk (CVE-2022-47966), and MOVEit (CVE-2023-34362) to deliver TigerRAT, BlackRAT, NukeSped and DTrack.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*-urlcache*","*bitsadmin*/transfer*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*DownloadString*","*DownloadFile*","*-decode *","*FromBase64String*")) AND NOT (Processes.user IN ("*$","NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM") AND Processes.process_name="cmd.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*echo*","*\\inetsrv\\appcmd*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","FromBase64String","curl -o ","wget -O ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where not (FileName =~ "cmd.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("appcmd list","iisreset"))   // strip benign IIS admin
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBase in ("w3wp.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","java.exe","javaw.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","jusched.exe")
| where ChildBase in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","mshta.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
    or CommandLine has_any ("certutil -urlcache","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","DownloadFile","FromBase64String","curl -o ","wget -O ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where not (ChildBase == "cmd.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("appcmd list","iisreset"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Andariel (Onyx Sleet) Web-Tier Process Spawning Download LOLBin
id: 7c1b2d4f-3e8a-4f1b-b8c2-9a5e6f7d8c11
status: experimental
description: Detects the Andariel/Onyx Sleet post-exploitation chain where a Java/IIS web-worker spawns cmd/PowerShell or a download LOLBin (certutil, bitsadmin, curl, wget) after exploitation of Log4Shell, ManageEngine ServiceDesk (CVE-2022-47966) or MOVEit (CVE-2023-34362).
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/18/multiple-north-korean-threat-actors-exploiting-the-teamcity-cve-2023-42793-vulnerability/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-187a
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_web:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  cmd_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'certutil -decode'
      - 'bitsadmin /transfer'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'curl -o '
      - 'wget -O '
  filter_iis_admin:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'appcmd list'
      - 'iisreset'
  condition: parent_web and (child_lolbin or cmd_download) and not filter_iis_admin
falsepositives:
  - Web-server administration scripts kicked off by SCCM / Ansible
  - Application-server self-updaters that legitimately call curl
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\tomcat*.exe OR *\\Tomcat*.exe OR *\\java.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\javaw.exe OR *\\httpd.exe OR *\\nginx.exe) AND (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\BITSAdmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"certutil -urlcache"* OR *"certutil -decode"* OR *"bitsadmin /transfer"* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *FromBase64String*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|tomcat\d*|java|javaw|httpd|nginx|jusched)\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|wget|mshta|regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i OR regex("(certutil\s+-urlcache|certutil\s+-decode|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|Invoke-WebRequest|DownloadString|DownloadFile|FromBase64String)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| NOT (ImageFileName=/\\cmd\.exe$/i AND regex("(appcmd\s+list|iisreset)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: Andariel/Onyx Sleet is the DPRK cluster most consistently observed pivoting from internet-exposed Java middleware (Log4Shell, ManageEngine SDP CVE-2022-47966, MOVEit CVE-2023-34362, TeamCity CVE-2023-42793) directly into hands-on-keyboard cmd.exe → certutil/bitsadmin loaders that stage TigerRAT, BlackRAT and DTrack. The parent set (w3wp/tomcat/java) plus the LOLBin set is the actor's canonical T11

ucs.title: [LLM] Andariel Maui ransomware staging — renamed ProcDump on LSASS followed by interactive maui.exe -p execution
ucs.description: Hunts the documented Andariel pre-Maui-ransomware playbook from CISA AA22-187A: operator-driven LSASS credential dump using ProcDump (frequently renamed) followed within the same logon session by interactive execution of maui.exe (or rebranded variant) with the actor-specific `-p`/`-f`/`-d` switch that selects target paths. Maui is currently attributed almost exclusively to Andariel, so this combination is a fingerprint of the actor staging encryption.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process IN ("*lsass*","*-ma *","*-mm *") AND Processes.process IN ("*-accepteula*","*procdump*","*dump64*","*dump32*")) OR Processes.process IN ("*maui.exe -p *","*maui.exe -f *","*maui.exe -d *","*maui64.exe -p *") OR (Processes.original_file_name="procdump" AND Processes.process_name!="procdump.exe" AND Processes.process_name!="procdump64.exe") ) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_tools by host user | where distinct_tools >= 2 OR like(cmdline,"%maui%") | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LsassDumps =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-ma ","-mm ") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
         or (ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "procdump" and FileName !in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "-accepteula" and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId,
              DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DumpImage = FileName, DumpSHA256 = SHA256;
let MauiExec =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^maui(64)?\.exe$"
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bmaui(64)?\.exe\s+-(p|f|d)\s+"
    | project MauiTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId,
              MauiCmd = ProcessCommandLine, MauiSHA256 = SHA256;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner MauiExec on DeviceId, AccountName
| where MauiTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 24h)
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff('minute', MauiTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, MauiTime, MinutesBetween, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, DumpSHA256, MauiCmd, MauiSHA256
| order by MauiTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LsassDumps =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where (CommandLine has_any ("-ma ","-mm ") and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (CommandLine has "-accepteula" and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (ChildBase startswith "dump" and CommandLine has "lsass")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectLogonId,
              DumpCmd = CommandLine, DumpImage = NewProcessName;
let MauiExec =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildBase matches regex @"^maui(64)?\.exe$"
         or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bmaui(64)?\.exe\s+-(p|f|d)\s+"
    | project MauiTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              MauiCmd = CommandLine, MauiImage = NewProcessName;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner MauiExec on Computer, SubjectUserName
| where MauiTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 24h)
| extend MinutesBetween = datetime_diff('minute', MauiTime, DumpTime)
| project DumpTime, MauiTime, MinutesBetween, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          DumpImage, DumpCmd, MauiImage, MauiCmd
| order by MauiTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 AND ((@CommandLine:(*lsass* AND (*"-ma "* OR *"-mm "* OR *-accepteula*))) OR @Image:(*\\maui.exe OR *\\Maui.exe OR *\\MAUI.EXE OR *\\maui64.exe OR *\\Maui64.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"maui.exe -p "* OR *"maui.exe -f "* OR *"maui.exe -d "* OR *"maui64.exe -p "*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (regex("lsass", field=CommandLine, flags="i") AND regex("(-ma\s|-mm\s|-accepteula)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")) OR ImageFileName=/\\maui(64)?\.exe$/i OR regex("\\bmaui(64)?\\.exe\\s+-(p|f|d)\\s+", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| count >= 1
ucs.rationale: CISA/FBI AA22-187A and Stairwell's reverse-engineering of the Maui sample tie this ransomware family almost exclusively to Andariel/Onyx Sleet, distinguished by manual operator invocation with explicit path arguments (`-p`, `-f`, `-d`) rather than worm-style propagation. Andariel's pre-encryption tradecraft consistently chains a ProcDump variant against LSASS (often renamed dump64.exe / sqldumper.

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Brand-Impersonation Domain Fetch Followed by User-Context Loader Within 10 Minutes
ucs.splunk:
``` Brand-impersonation domain contact + user-context loader within 10 min (joint pattern across THN/BleepingComputer/Microsoft/ESET/Cyber Security News briefings) ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS dl_time
    values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
      AND (
           All_Traffic.dest="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecode*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*anthropic-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openai-*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*huggingface-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openclaw*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*download-version.1-5-8*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecodedoc*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*macclean*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mac-storage-guide*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*csec-c2-server*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*steamhostserver*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*serverconect*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*transcloud*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*recargapopular*" OR All_Traffic.url="*.msixbundle*"
        OR All_Traffic.url="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.url="*download-version.1-5-8*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest IN (<brand_lookalike_domain_list>)
        OR All_Traffic.dest_ip IN (<c2_ip_list>)
      )
    by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| rename src AS host
| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time
        values(Processes.process_name) AS child_proc values(Processes.process) AS child_cmd
        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh")
          AND Processes.user!="*$"
        by Processes.dest Processes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
     | rename dest AS host]
| eval delta_sec = exec_time - dl_time
| where delta_sec >= 0 AND delta_sec <= 600
| table host user dl_time exec_time delta_sec dl_app dl_dest dl_url dl_ip parent_proc child_proc child_cmd child_hash
| sort - dl_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgr = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","pnpm.exe","pnpm","yarn.exe","yarn","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","nuget.exe","dotnet.exe","code.exe","cursor.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3.exe","python3","pwsh.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","dash","curl.exe","wget.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","api.nuget.org","nuget.org","marketplace.visualstudio.com","open-vsx.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","ghcr.io","go.dev","crates.io","rubygems.org"]);
let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," add ","restore","--install-extension"," ci ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | extend HostOnly = tolower(tostring(split(RemoteUrl, "/")[0]))
    | where not(HostOnly in~ (RegistryAllow))
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".npmjs.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pypi.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pythonhosted.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".yarnpkg.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".nuget.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".visualstudio.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".github.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".githubusercontent.com")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChildProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ChildCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
Installs
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId, AccountName
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, InstallTime)
| summarize InstallTime = min(InstallTime),
            EgressTime = min(EgressTime),
            DelaySec   = min(DelaySec),
            RemoteHits = dcount(strcat(RemoteIP,":",tostring(RemotePort))),
            SampleRemoteUrl = any(RemoteUrl),
            SampleRemoteIP  = any(RemoteIP),
            SamplePkgCmd    = any(PkgCmd),
            SampleChildCmd  = any(ChildCmd)
         by DeviceName, AccountName, PkgMgr, ChildProc, ChildParent
| order by EgressTime desc

ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) AS firstTime max(_time) AS lastTime values(Processes.process) AS cmdlines values(Processes.process_path) AS exec_paths values(Processes.parent_process) AS parent_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("httpd","nginx","apache2","java","tomcat","sslmgr","useridd","authd","mifs","node","python","python3","sshd","pan_comm_mgr","panlogd","catalina.sh","ws_TomcatService.sh") AND Processes.process_name IN ("bash","sh","csh","zsh","dash","ksh","tcsh","python","python3","perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat","busybox","gawk") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(parent_process,"(?i)(puppet|ansible|chef-client|salt-minion|systemd|/cron[/ ]|crond)") AND NOT match(process,"(?i)(\s--version|\sstatus(\s|$)|\shealthcheck|\s-V(\s|$))") | join type=inner dest [| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="created" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/webapps/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/htdocs/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/www/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/mi/tomcat/*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.jsp" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.jspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.php" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.sh") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest AS dest] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Edge zero-day post-exploit — service process spawning shell/ingress LOLBin on Linux/macOS
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let _WebServerProcs = dynamic([
    "httpd","nginx","apache2","java","tomcat","sslmgr","useridd",
    "authd","mifs","node","python","python3","sshd","pan_comm_mgr",
    "panlogd","catalina.sh","ws_TomcatService.sh"]);
let _ShellChildren = dynamic([
    "bash","sh","csh","zsh","dash","ksh","tcsh","python","python3",
    "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat","busybox","gawk"]);
let _AutomationParents = dynamic([
    "puppet","ansible-playbook","chef-client","salt-minion","cron","crond","systemd"]);
let ShellSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OSPlatform in ("Linux","macOS")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | where FileName in~ (_ShellChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ (_AutomationParents)
    | where ProcessCommandLine !has " --version"
        and ProcessCommandLine !has " -V"
        and not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bstatus\b")
        and ProcessCommandLine !has "healthcheck"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc  = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              FolderPath, SHA256;
// Corroborating signal — webshell/script drop into a web root by the same kind of service process
let WebshellDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has_any (
        @"/mi/tomcat/webapps/", @"/var/www/", @"/usr/share/nginx/html/",
        @"/opt/pan/", @"/var/panlogs/", @"/opt/tomcat/webapps/",
        @"/srv/www/", @"/htdocs/")
    | where FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName endswith ".jspx"
         or FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".aspx"
         or FileName endswith ".sh"  or FileName endswith ".py"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedFile = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath, DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ShellSpawns
| join kind=leftouter WebshellDrops on DeviceId
| extend CorroboratingDropMin = iff(isnotempty(DropTime), datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, DropTime), int(null))
| where isnull(CorroboratingDropMin) or abs(CorroboratingDropMin) <= 10
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentProc, ParentCmd, ChildProc, ChildCmd, FolderPath, SHA256, CorroboratingDropMin, DroppedFile, DropPath, DroppedBy
| order by Timestamp desc

let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents

    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)

    | project ShellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FileName,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,

RuntimeShells

| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)

ucs.title: [LLM] Embargo / MDeployer safe-mode reboot to bypass EDR before encryption (BlackCat-lineage tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts Embargo's signature pre-encryption reboot-into-safe-mode chain (inherited from the BlackCat/ALPHV codebase) where the actor sets `safeboot` via bcdedit or registry, registers an auto-start RunOnce/SafeBoot entry pointing at MDeployer or the Rust encryptor, and forces a reboot — booting the host into Minimal/Network safe mode where Defender, MDE, and most EDR drivers do not load.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process IN ("*safeboot*minimal*","*safeboot*network*")) OR (Processes.process_name=reg.exe Processes.process="*\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SafeBoot\\*" Processes.process="*add*") OR (Processes.process_name IN (powershell.exe,pwsh.exe) Processes.process IN ("*Set-ItemProperty*SafeBoot*","*New-ItemProperty*SafeBoot*","*bcdedit*safeboot*")) by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host_dest | join type=inner host [ | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as shutdown_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN (shutdown.exe,cmd.exe,powershell.exe) Processes.process IN ("*shutdown*/r*","*shutdown*-r*","*Restart-Computer*") by host _time span=15m ] | where _time<=lastTime+900 AND _time>=firstTime-60 | eval signal="Embargo safe-mode reboot chain" | table firstTime lastTime host user process_name cmd shutdown_cmd signal | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Embargo / MDeployer safe-mode reboot chain — bcdedit safeboot OR SafeBoot registry add, then forced reboot within 15 min on the same host
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 15m;
let SafeBootStaging = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
              and ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
              and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minimal", "network"))
         or (FileName =~ "reg.exe"
              and ProcessCommandLine has "add"
              and ProcessCommandLine has @"\Control\SafeBoot\")
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
              and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-ItemProperty", "New-ItemProperty", "bcdedit")
              and ProcessCommandLine has "SafeBoot")
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              StagingProcess = FileName,
              StagingCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              StagingParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              StagingParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// Reboot trigger on the SAME host shortly after
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "shutdown.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/r", "-r"))
     or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "Restart-Computer")
     or (FileName =~ "cmd.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shutdown", "/r"))
| join kind=inner SafeBootStaging on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, SafeBootTime)
| project SafeBootTime, RebootTime = Timestamp, DelaySec,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          StagingProcess, StagingCmd, StagingParent, StagingParentCmd,
          RebootProcess = FileName, RebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Embargo / MDeployer safe-mode reboot chain — Sentinel SecurityEvent (4688) port
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 15m;
let SafeBootStaging = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
              and CommandLine has "safeboot"
              and CommandLine has_any ("minimal", "network"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\reg.exe"
              and CommandLine has "add"
              and CommandLine has @"\Control\SafeBoot\")
         or (NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
              and CommandLine has_any ("Set-ItemProperty", "New-ItemProperty", "bcdedit")
              and CommandLine has "SafeBoot")
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account,
              StagingProcess = NewProcessName,
              StagingCmd = CommandLine,
              StagingParent = ParentProcessName;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\shutdown.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("/r", "-r"))
     or (NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has "Restart-Computer")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shutdown", "/r"))
| join kind=inner SafeBootStaging on Computer
| where TimeGenerated between (SafeBootTime .. SafeBootTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, SafeBootTime)
| project SafeBootTime, RebootTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec,
          Computer, Account,
          StagingProcess, StagingCmd, StagingParent,
          RebootProcess = NewProcessName, RebootCmd = CommandLine
| order by SafeBootTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Embargo MS4Killer BYOVD — vulnerable kernel driver service install + EDR process termination
ucs.description: Hunts Embargo's MS4Killer (a.k.a. Probably-Killer / 'msdrv'-style) Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver tooling: a kernel driver dropped to a non-system path (Temp / Public / ProgramData), registered as a service, then used (via IOCTL) to terminate Defender/EDR user-mode processes within minutes — the technique Embargo inherits from the BlackCat affiliate toolkit.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") by host Filesystem.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=inner host [ | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as kill_cmds values(Processes.process_name) as killer_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN (taskkill.exe,sc.exe,net.exe,powershell.exe,pwsh.exe,wmic.exe) AND Processes.process IN ("*MsMpEng*","*MsSense*","*SenseIR*","*WinDefend*","*Sense*","*CSFalconService*","*xagt*","*SentinelAgent*","*ekrn*","*mfeesp*","*MBAMService*")) OR (Processes.parent_process_name=services.exe AND Processes.process IN ("*\\Temp\\*.sys*","*\\ProgramData\\*.sys*","*\\Public\\*.sys*")) by host _time span=30m ] | where lastTime>=firstTime AND (lastTime-firstTime)<1800 | eval signal="Embargo MS4Killer BYOVD candidate" | table firstTime lastTime host user file_name file_path killer_proc kill_cmds signal | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Embargo MS4Killer BYOVD — non-system-path .sys dropped, kernel driver service installed, then EDR/AV processes killed on same host within 30 min
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let EdrTargets = dynamic([
    "MsMpEng.exe", "MsSense.exe", "SenseIR.exe", "SenseCncProxy.exe", "WinDefend",
    "CSFalconService.exe", "CSFalconContainer.exe", "xagt.exe", "SentinelAgent.exe",
    "SentinelServiceHost.exe", "ekrn.exe", "egui.exe", "mfeesp.exe", "masvc.exe",
    "MBAMService.exe", "AvastSvc.exe", "avp.exe", "sophosfs.exe", "SAVService.exe",
    "TmCCSF.exe", "PccNTMon.exe"
  ]);
let KnownVulnerableDrivers = dynamic([
    "truesight.sys", "gmer.sys", "viragt64.sys", "procexp152.sys", "procexp.sys",
    "rentdrv2.sys", "dbutil_2_3.sys", "dbutildrv2.sys", "ene.sys", "asrdrv101.sys",
    "asrdrv102.sys", "asrdrv103.sys", "WnBios.sys", "WnBios64.sys", "mhyprot2.sys",
    "daxin.sys", "kavg.sys", "ms4killer.sys"
  ]);
let DriverDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\",
                                 @"\ProgramData\", @"\Downloads\", @"\PerfLogs\")
        or FileName in~ (KnownVulnerableDrivers)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DroppedDriver = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath, DropSHA256 = SHA256,
              DropperProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropperCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
// Service registration for that driver (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\<name>\ImagePath)
let ServiceReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\",
                                        @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\")
    | where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
    | project SvcRegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SvcKey = RegistryKey, SvcImagePath = tostring(RegistryValueData),
              SvcRegisterer = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SvcRegistererCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// EDR/AV process termination on same host
let EdrKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (FileName in~ ("taskkill.exe", "sc.exe", "net.exe", "wmic.exe",
                            "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
              and (ProcessCommandLine has_any (EdrTargets)
                   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend", "Sense", "MDE", "Defender")))
    | project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              KillProcess = FileName, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              KillParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner ServiceReg on DeviceId
| where SvcRegTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=inner EdrKill on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| project DropTime, SvcRegTime, KillTime,
          DeviceName, DropperUser,
          DroppedDriver, DropPath, DropSHA256,
          DropperProcess, DropperCmd,
          SvcImagePath, SvcRegisterer,
          KillProcess, KillCmd
| order by DropTime desc

              KillCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;

| where KillTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMin)
| project DropTime, SvcRegTime, KillTime,

          KillProcess, KillCmd

ucs.title: [LLM] Flax Typhoon Sticky Keys / Accessibility Feature debugger hijack via IFEO registry
ucs.description: Hunts for Flax Typhoon's signature persistence + bypass technique: writing a 'Debugger' value under Image File Execution Options for an accessibility binary (sethc.exe, utilman.exe, magnify.exe, etc.) so that pressing Shift x5 / WinKey+U at the lock screen spawns SYSTEM-level cmd.exe. Microsoft Threat Intelligence (Aug 2023) called this the actor's most distinctive fingerprint after observed campaigns vs. Taiwanese government and academia.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Image File Execution Options\\*" AND Registry.registry_value_name="Debugger" AND (Registry.registry_path="*\\sethc.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\utilman.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\magnify.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\narrator.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\osk.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\displayswitch.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\atbroker.exe*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\hkcmd.exe*") AND Registry.user!="*$" by Registry.dest Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name Registry.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | rename dest as host, user as src_user | eval reason="Flax Typhoon style accessibility-feature IFEO debugger hijack"
ucs.kql:
// Flax Typhoon — accessibility-feature IFEO debugger hijack
// Microsoft (Aug 2023): sethc.exe / utilman.exe Debugger value swapped to cmd.exe or powershell.exe
let _accessibility_bins = dynamic(["sethc.exe","utilman.exe","magnify.exe","narrator.exe","osk.exe","displayswitch.exe","atbroker.exe","hkcmd.exe"]);
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has @"\Image File Execution Options\"
| where RegistryValueName =~ "Debugger"
| extend HijackedBinary = tolower(extract(@"(?i)Image File Execution Options\\([^\\]+)$", 1, RegistryKey))
| where HijackedBinary in~ (_accessibility_bins)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
   or InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("trustedinstaller.exe","msiexec.exe")  // exclude only known-good system installers
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, HijackedBinary,
          DebuggerSetTo = RegistryValueData,
          RegistryKey,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession = tostring(InitiatingProcessAccountSid)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Flax Typhoon — accessibility-feature IFEO debugger hijack on Sentinel
// Catches both the registry write itself and the post-trigger SYSTEM cmd.exe / powershell.exe spawn under winlogon
let _accessibility_bins = dynamic(["sethc.exe","utilman.exe","magnify.exe","narrator.exe","osk.exe","displayswitch.exe","atbroker.exe","hkcmd.exe"]);
let _hijack_writes = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventID == 4657                                  // registry value set (must enable subcat)
    | where ObjectName has @"\Image File Execution Options\"
    | where ObjectValueName =~ "Debugger"
    | extend HijackedBinary = tolower(extract(@"(?i)Image File Execution Options\\([^\\]+)$", 1, ObjectName))
    | where HijackedBinary in~ (_accessibility_bins)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
              HijackedBinary, RegistryKey = ObjectName, ProcessName;
let _post_trigger = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith @"\winlogon.exe"
    | where NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\cmd.exe" or NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith_cs @"\pwsh.exe"
    | where TargetUserSid in ("S-1-5-18")                    // SYSTEM cmd from logon screen
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
union _hijack_writes, _post_trigger
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] APT1 RAR staging for exfiltration — password-protected, multi-volume archive in user-writeable path
ucs.description: Hunts APT1's documented data-staging tradecraft: a renamed/dropped rar.exe (often placed in C:\RECYCLER\, %TEMP%, or a user profile path) invoked with the distinctive `-hp<password> -v<size>m -m5` flag combination to produce password-protected split archives prior to FTP/HTTP exfil. Mandiant attributed this exact RAR command shape to multiple Comment Crew intrusions and it remains a high-fidelity Unit 61398 signature.

id: 8f2c7a14-apt1-rar-stage-c4e9-b3d1f7062894
status: experimental
description: Detects the password-protected, multi-volume RAR archive command line documented as APT1 / Unit 61398 staging tradecraft (rar a -hp<pw> -v<size>m -m5 ...). Catches both legit-named rar.exe outside Program Files and renamed RAR binaries.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0006/

  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0006

  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rar_name:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rar.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'

      - '\rar64.exe'

    CommandLine|re|i: '\s+a\s+-hp\S+'

level: high

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.
// The sender-domain root and url-domain root are extracted then
// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to
// suppress the residual newsletter / vendor-tracker noise.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LegitTrackers = dynamic(["mailchimp.com","sendgrid.net","sendgrid.com",
    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",
    "list-manage.com","createsend1.com","createsend.com","sg.actblue.com",
    "ml-attach.com","emltrk.com","amazonses.com","amazon.com","sndarsffrt.com",
    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | project Url, ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on Url
| extend UrlDomLower = tolower(UrlDomain)
| extend UrlRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| where UrlRoot != SenderRoot
   and UrlRoot !in (LegitTrackers)
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".office.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".sharepoint.com"
| extend RiskScore = case(UrlTld in (CheapTlds), 3,
                          UrlRoot endswith ".ru" or UrlRoot endswith ".cn", 2,
                          1)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

// Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s.
// Far higher fidelity than "every clicked URL" — most legitimate clicks
// never spawn a non-browser child process, so the join eliminates the
// 99% of noise that makes a raw click query unactionable.

let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
        | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, EmailTimestamp = Timestamp
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
      ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
              Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress,
              ActionType;
// Correlate to a non-browser child process spawned within 60 seconds on
// the recipient's device.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                         "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                        "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
                        "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 60s)
| project ClickTime, ProcessTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress,
          Subject, Url, UrlDomain, ActionType,

let LookbackHours = 24h;

let InstallHints = dynamic(["preinstall","postinstall","install.js","setup.py","pip install","npm install","yarn add","gem install","cargo install"]);
let ProcStart = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ScriptHost  = FileName,
              ScriptCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              ProcSHA256  = SHA256,
              ProcId      = ProcessId,
              IsRemoteSession = IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (EdgeDomains)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressProcId = InitiatingProcessId;

| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| extend InstallContext = iff(ParentCmd has_any (InstallHints) or ScriptCmd has_any (InstallHints), "install-hook", "runtime")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime), HitCount = count(),

// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ListenerPorts = make_set(ListenerPort, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, ParentPid, SHA256
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, FirstInbound)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,

// APT3 / Buckeye accessibility-feature backdoor — IFEO Debugger redirect of sethc/utilman/etc.
let _accessibility_bins = dynamic(["sethc.exe","utilman.exe","osk.exe","narrator.exe","magnify.exe","displayswitch.exe","atbroker.exe"]);
let _ifeo_root = @"\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\";
// 1. Registry write of an IFEO Debugger value targeting an accessibility binary
let RegHits = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"Image File Execution Options"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "Debugger" or RegistryValueName =~ "GlobalFlag" or RegistryValueName =~ "MonitorProcess"
    | extend HijackedBin = tolower(tostring(split(RegistryKey, "\\")[-1]))
    | where HijackedBin in (_accessibility_bins)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"            // exclude SYSTEM/machine
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("trustedinstaller.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, HijackedBin, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName,
              RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// 2. The post-trigger artefact — winlogon.exe / accessibility binary spawning a shell
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winlogon.exe","sethc.exe","utilman.exe","osk.exe","narrator.exe","magnify.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","powershell_ise.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel;
union isfuzzy=true
    (RegHits | extend Signal = "IFEO debugger registered on accessibility binary"),
    (ProcHits | extend Signal = "Accessibility binary or winlogon spawned interactive shell")

// APT3 / Gothic Panda — recon burst + LSASS access -> outbound RDP/SMB pivot on same operator account
let Window = 30m;
let ReconBins = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
// 1. Hosts where one operator runs >= 4 distinct recon binaries in a 30-min window
let ReconBursts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe")
    | where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
    | summarize ReconBins = make_set(FileName), ReconStart = min(Timestamp), ReconEnd = max(Timestamp)
              by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
    | where array_length(ReconBins) >= 4;
// 2. LSASS access / credential-dump indicators on the same host+user (APT3 used MiniDumpWriteDump via comsvcs.dll, procdump, custom tools)
let LsassTouches = union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where AccountName !endswith "$"
        | where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24"))
             or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
             or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Out-Minidump","MiniDumpWriteDump","-MemoryDumpPath"))
             or (ProcessCommandLine has "sekurlsa" or ProcessCommandLine has "lsadump")
        | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DumpTool = FileName),
    (DeviceEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
        | where ActionType in ("OpenProcessApiCall","ReadProcessMemoryApiCall")
        | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
        | where AdditionalFields has "lsass"
        | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
                  DumpCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, DumpTool = InitiatingProcessFileName);
// 3. Outbound lateral RDP (3389) / SMB (445) from that host+user shortly after
let Pivots = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
    | where RemotePort in (3389, 445)
    | where ipv4_is_private(RemoteIP)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project PivotTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, PivotProc = InitiatingProcessFileName, PivotCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
ReconBursts
| join kind=inner LsassTouches on DeviceId, AccountName
| where DumpTime between (ReconStart .. ReconEnd + 30m)
| join kind=inner Pivots on DeviceId, AccountName
| where PivotTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 60m)
| project ReconStart, DumpTime, PivotTime,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ReconBins, DumpTool, DumpCmd,
          RemoteIP, RemotePort, PivotProc, PivotCmd
| order by PivotTime desc

// APT3 recon -> LSASS dump -> RDP/SMB pivot chain
let Window = 30m;
let ReconBins = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","arp.exe","route.exe"]);
let ReconBursts = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where AccountType == "User"
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where Bin in (ReconBins)
    | summarize ReconSet = make_set(Bin), ReconStart = min(TimeGenerated), ReconEnd = max(TimeGenerated)
              by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
    | where array_length(ReconSet) >= 4;
let LsassTouches = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24"))
         or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\procdump.exe","\\procdump64.exe") and CommandLine has "lsass")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("Out-Minidump","MiniDumpWriteDump","sekurlsa","lsadump"))
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, DumpCmd = CommandLine, DumpTool = NewProcessName;

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID in (4624, 4648)
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)                                  // Network or RemoteInteractive
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where ipv4_is_private(IpAddress)

              RemoteHostFromAuth = WorkstationName, IpAddress, LogonType;

| join kind=inner LsassTouches on Computer, Account
| where DumpTime between (ReconStart .. ReconEnd + 30m)
| join kind=inner Pivots on Computer, Account
| where PivotTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + 60m)
| project ReconStart, DumpTime, PivotTime, Computer, Account, ReconSet,

| order by PivotTime desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

let CredFileNames = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc",".netrc",".env","credentials","credentials.json","id_rsa","id_ed25519",".gitconfig","config.json"]);
let CredPathFragments = dynamic([@"\.aws\credentials","/.aws/credentials",@"\.ssh\","/.ssh/",@"\.docker\config.json","/.docker/config.json",@"\.config\gh\","/.config/gh/"]);
let PkgInstallChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentName=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildName=FileName,
              ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid=ProcessId,
              ChildSha256=SHA256;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
         or ActionType startswith "FileAccessed"
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames)
         or FolderPath has_any (CredPathFragments)
    | project EventTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, Pid=InitiatingProcessId,
              Kind="cred",
              Detail=strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName);
let OffRegistryEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend Host = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | where not(Host has_any (TrustedRegistries))
    | project EventTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, Pid=InitiatingProcessId,

| join kind=inner FollowUps on DeviceId

| where Pid == ChildPid or Kind == "net"  // file events are pid-tight; net broadens to host-window
| summarize FollowUpEvents=make_set(strcat(Kind,":",Detail), 25),

            LastFollowUp=max(EventTime)

| where array_length(Kinds) >= 1
| extend HasCred = Kinds has "cred", HasNet = Kinds has "net"
| order by FirstChild desc

    "ssh-cleartext")

ucs.kql:
// APT39 (Chafer / Remix Kitten) — OWA / Exchange w3wp.exe spawning recon LOLBins
// Symantec Chafer Dec 2015; FireEye APT39 Jan 2019; FBI Rana Intelligence Computing 2020
let _lookback = 14d;
let _recon_lolbins = dynamic([
    "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe",
    "whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe",
    "tasklist.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","hostname.exe","nltest.exe",
    "arp.exe","netstat.exe","reg.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
let _exchange_app_pools = dynamic([
    "MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool",
    "MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool",
    "MSExchangeMapiFrontEndAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(_lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (_exchange_app_pools)
| where FileName in~ (_recon_lolbins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
   or AccountName in~ ("system","network service","iusr")            // OWA pool runs as NT AUTHORITY\NETWORK SERVICE — keep these in scope
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AppPool = extract(@"-ap\s+\"?([^\"\s]+)\"?", 1, InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
          AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash  = SHA256
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(_lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\inetpub\wwwroot\", @"\Exchange Server\", @"\ClientAccess\Owa\", @"\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\")
    | where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx"
    | summarize WebShellCandidates = make_set(strcat(FolderPath, FileName), 25) by DeviceName
  ) on DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc

// APT39 — Exchange OWA web-shell command exec via w3wp child process
let _lookback = 14d;
let _recon_lolbins = dynamic([

    "whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe",
    "tasklist.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","hostname.exe","nltest.exe",
    "arp.exe","netstat.exe","reg.exe","wmic.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
let _exchange_app_pools = dynamic([
    "MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool",
    "MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool",
    "MSExchangeMapiFrontEndAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| where ProcessName has_any (_exchange_app_pools) or ParentProcessName has "w3wp"

| extend ChildLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildLeaf in~ (_recon_lolbins)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, AccountDomain,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);

let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents

| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)

    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
