let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 240;
// 1. Click on a credential-harvester hosted on free PaaS — APT42's documented infra preference
let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | where Url has_any ("sites.google.com",".glitch.me",".web.app",".workers.dev",
                         ".pages.dev","firebaseapp.com",".repl.co",".onrender.com",
                         ".herokuapp.com",".000webhostapp.com","r2.dev")
    | where Url has_any ("login","signin","office","microsoft","outlook","o365","auth","verify")
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, NetworkMessageId;
// 2. Per-user 30d country baseline
let UserBaselineCountry = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(Country), KnownASN = make_set(IPAddress) by AccountUpn;
// 3. Successful sign-in to Exchange / Graph / SPO within 4h of click, from new country
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ErrorCode == 0                                  // 0 = success
| where ApplicationId in ("00000002-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000",   // EXO
                           "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000",   // Graph
                           "00000003-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000")   // SPO
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| join kind=leftouter UserBaselineCountry on AccountUpn
| extend IsNewCountry = iff(isnotempty(Country) and Country !in (KnownCountries), true, false)
| where IsNewCountry == true or IsAnonymousProxy == true or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high")
| project ClickTime, SignInTime = Timestamp, DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          AccountUpn, Url, IPAddress, Country, City, Application,
          IsAnonymousProxy, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, ClientAppUsed
| order by SignInTime desc

    | extend Body = tostring(Parameters)

    | where ResultType == 0

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ResultType == 0
| where AppDisplayName has_any ("Office 365 Exchange","Microsoft Graph","Office 365 SharePoint","OfficeHome","Outlook")
| extend Country = tostring(parse_json(LocationDetails).countryOrRegion)
| join kind=inner SuspectMail on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated between (MailTime .. MailTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| join kind=leftouter KnownCountry on UserPrincipalName
| extend IsNewCountry = iff(isnotempty(Country) and Country !in (KnownCountries), true, false)
| where IsNewCountry == true or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium","high")
| project MailTime, SignInTime = TimeGenerated,

ucs.description: APT42 routinely drops VBS (NICECURL) or PowerShell (TAMECAT/POWERPOST) backdoors via spearphishing attachments — the loader chain runs wscript.exe or an Office app spawning powershell.exe with downloader cradles, then resolves second-stage staging from a benign-looking web service (Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub raw, Telegram bot API) per APT42's T1102 web-service C2 tradecraft. let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe",
                          "powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let DownloaderTokens = dynamic(["DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest",
                                "Invoke-Expression"," IEX "," iex(","FromBase64String",
                                "-EncodedCommand"," -enc "," -ec ","Net.WebClient",
                                "WebRequest","Start-BitsTransfer"]);
let APT42WebSvc = dynamic(["googleusercontent.com","drive.google.com",
                           "dropboxusercontent.com","dropbox.com",
                           "githubusercontent.com","api.telegram.org",
                           "onedrive.live.com","sharepoint.com",
                           "pastebin.com","hastebin.com","sites.google.com"]);
// Stage 1 — Office/wscript spawning PowerShell with a downloader cradle
let LoaderSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (DownloaderTokens)
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, ProcessId;
// Stage 2 — same PowerShell PID resolves a second-stage on a legit web service (APT42 T1102)
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (APT42WebSvc)
   or RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)\.(workers\.dev|web\.app|pages\.dev|glitch\.me|firebaseapp\.com)$"
| join kind=inner LoaderSpawn on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| where Timestamp between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + 5m)
| project SpawnTime, NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, SHA256
| order by SpawnTime desc

title: APT42 NICECURL/TAMECAT Loader - Script Host Spawns PowerShell Downloader Cradle
id: a4274218-42ce-4f01-9f82-6e1cbb9a4242
status: experimental
description: Detects APT42 (Charming Kitten / Mint Sandstorm) loader chain where wscript/cscript or an Office application spawns powershell.exe with a downloader cradle (DownloadString, IEX, EncodedCommand, FromBase64String) used by the NICECURL VBS or TAMECAT/POWERPOST PowerShell backdoors.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044/
    - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/apt42-charms-cons-compromises
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/04
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1059.005
    - attack.t1102
    - attack.g1044
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'
            - '\winword.exe'
            - '\excel.exe'
            - '\powerpnt.exe'
            - '\outlook.exe'
            - '\mshta.exe'
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
    selection_cradle:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'DownloadString'
            - 'DownloadFile'
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'Invoke-Expression'
            - ' IEX '
            - 'FromBase64String'
            - '-EncodedCommand'
            - ' -enc '
            - ' -ec '
            - 'Net.WebClient'
            - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
    filter_machine_account:
        User|endswith: '$'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cradle and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate IT automation that wraps PowerShell downloads behind wscript/cscript launchers (rare, baseline before alerting)
    - Software deployment tools using Office templates that invoke PowerShell
level: high

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","rubygems.org","proxy.golang.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","nodejs.org","npmmirror.com"]);
let CredPaths = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",@"\.aws\credentials",@"\.ssh\id_",@"\.npmrc",@"\.docker\config.json",@"\.gitconfig",@".config/gh/hosts.yml"]);
let InstallSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallTime = Timestamp,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildFile = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isempty(RemoteUrl) or not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, NetTime = Timestamp,
              EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FolderPath has_any (CredPaths)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    | project DeviceId, FileTime = Timestamp,
              AccessProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              AccessFile = FolderPath;
InstallSpawns
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow)
| join kind=leftouter CredAccess on DeviceId
| extend CredHit = iif(isnotempty(AccessFile) and FileTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow), AccessFile, "")
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| project InstallTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd,
          NetTime, DelaySec, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, EgressProcess,
          CredHit
| summarize arg_min(InstallTime, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentFile, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by InstallTime desc

let _server_parents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","java.exe","java","javaw.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nginx.exe","nginx","xrdp","xrdp-sesman","portainer.exe","portainer","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek-tui","n8n.exe","n8n","flowise","ruby.exe","ruby","perl","go","php-fpm"]);
let _shells_lolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let _build_noise = @"(?i)(npm\s+(test|install|run|ci)|cargo\s+(test|build|run)|gradle\s|mvn\s+(install|test|package)|pip\s+install|go\s+test|jest|pytest|eslint|prettier|webpack)";
let _cradle = @"(?i)(base64\s+-d|/dev/tcp/|bash\s+-i|powershell\s+-(e|enc)|FromBase64String|IEX |Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|certutil\s+-urlcache|wget\s+http|curl\s+-s\s+http)";
let _spawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_server_parents)
    | where FileName in~ (_shells_lolbins)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId,
              SHA256;
let _egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionAttempt")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
_spawn
| join kind=leftouter _egress on DeviceId, $left.ChildPid == $right.NetPid
| extend EgressWithinWindow = iif(isnotnull(NetTime) and datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime) between (0 .. 300), true, false)
| extend SuspiciousCmd = ChildCmd matches regex _cradle
| where EgressWithinWindow or SuspiciousCmd
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildPid, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, NetTime, EgressWithinWindow, SuspiciousCmd
| order by SpawnTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 600;
let CredScripts = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.exe","pwsh.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe","bash.exe","sh","bash","zsh","python.exe","python3","python","cat","head","tail","awk","sed","grep","strings","xxd","od","tr","dd","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","git.exe","git"]);
let CredTargets = dynamic([".npmrc",".aws\\credentials",".aws/credentials",".git-credentials",".docker\\config.json",".docker/config.json",".kube\\config",".kube/config",".netrc",".ssh\\id_",".ssh/id_","/proc/","169.254.169.254","metadata.google.internal","169.254.170.2","GITHUB_TOKEN","NPM_TOKEN","AWS_SESSION_TOKEN","environ"]);
let BaselineDomains = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize BaselineHosts = dcount(DeviceName) by RemoteUrl
    | where BaselineHosts > 2;
let CredReads = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (CredScripts)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredTargets)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project CredTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              CredProc = FileName, CredCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              CredParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              CredParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl !endswith "github.com"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "githubusercontent.com"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "registry.npmjs.org"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "pypi.org"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "files.pythonhosted.org"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "amazonaws.com"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "googleapis.com"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "azure.com"
         and RemoteUrl !endswith "microsoft.com"
    | join kind=leftanti BaselineDomains on RemoteUrl
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (CredTime .. CredTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, CredTime)
| project CredTime, EgressTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          CredProc, CredCmd, CredParent, CredParentCmd,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, EgressProc, EgressCmd
| order by CredTime desc

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Vendor / Third-Party OAuth App or SP Sign-in From Unbaselined Egress Followed by Bulk SaaS Object Read
ucs.splunk:
``` Stage 1 — successful SP / OAuth / federated sign-ins (last 14d) with their (app,src) pair ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) as auth_time, values(Authentication.src) as auth_src, values(Authentication.app) as auth_app, values(Authentication.signature_id) as auth_sig from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND Authentication.signature_id IN ("ServicePrincipalSignIn","NonInteractiveUserSignIn","UserLoggedIn","ConsoleLogin","AssumeRoleWithSAML","federatedSSO","user.session.start") AND earliest=-14d@d by Authentication.user span=1m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| rename user as actor
``` Anti-baseline: keep only (app,src) pairs never (or barely) seen in the prior 30d window ```
| join type=left auth_app, auth_src [ tstats `summariesonly` count as baseline_count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND earliest=-30d@d latest=-14d@d by Authentication.app, Authentication.src | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename app as auth_app, src as auth_src ]
| fillnull baseline_count value=0
| where baseline_count <= 2
``` Stage 2 — bulk SaaS object reads by the same actor within 30 minutes ```
| join type=inner actor max=0 [ tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action IN ("read","downloaded","accessed","exported","cloned") AND All_Changes.object_category IN ("file","email","repository","record","blob","secret","mailbox") by _time, All_Changes.user, All_Changes.object, All_Changes.app, All_Changes.object_category | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | rename user as actor, _time as access_time, object as object_id, app as access_app, object_category as object_kind ]
| where access_time >= auth_time AND access_time <= auth_time + 1800
| stats count as ObjectsRead, dc(object_id) as DistinctObjects, values(object_kind) as ObjectKinds, values(access_app) as AccessApps, min(access_time) as FirstAccess, max(access_time) as LastAccess by actor, auth_app, auth_src, auth_time
| where ObjectsRead >= 50 OR DistinctObjects >= 25
| convert ctime(auth_time) ctime(FirstAccess) ctime(LastAccess)

ucs.title: [LLM] APT5 (Mulberry Typhoon / UNC2630) LSASS credential dump via rundll32 + comsvcs.dll MiniDump
ucs.description: Hunts the LOLBIN credential-access tradecraft APT5 reliably uses after pivoting from a compromised Pulse Secure / Citrix NetScaler appliance into the Windows estate — invoking rundll32.exe against C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll with the MiniDump (ordinal #24) export, against the LSASS PID. APT5 prefers LOLBIN credential extraction over dropping a Mimikatz binary, so this combo (rundll32 + comsvcs + MiniDump/#24) is a high-fidelity signature of the cluster Mandiant tracks as UNC2630 / Microsoft tracks as Mulberry Typhoon.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND (Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll *MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,#24*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll #24*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,MiniDumpW*") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_id Processes.process_hash _time 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| eval target_pid = case(match(process, "(?i)\sMiniDump\s+(\d+)\s"), 1) 
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT5 / Mulberry Typhoon — LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump LOLBIN
let _machine_accounts = dynamic(["system","local service","network service"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"                       // indexed term
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)comsvcs\.dll[ ,]+(MiniDump(W)?|#24)\b"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ (_machine_accounts)
// Pull the LSASS PID argument when present — third positional arg after MiniDump
| extend TargetPid = extract(@"(?i)comsvcs\.dll[ ,]+(?:MiniDump(?:W)?|#24)\s+(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DumpPath  = extract(@"(?i)(?:MiniDump(?:W)?|#24)\s+\d+\s+([\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s\"']+|\\\\\?\\[A-Z]:\\[^\s\"']+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ProcessCommandLine, TargetPid, DumpPath,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentIntegrity = InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel,
          IsRemote = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

| extend DumpPath  = extract(@"(?i)(?:MiniDump(?:W)?|#24)\s+\d+\s+([\"']?[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s\"']+)", 1, CommandLine)

title: APT5 LSASS Credential Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
id: a5c0d9c1-5c5a-4d3e-9c7b-8f2a3d5b1e44
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32.exe invoking comsvcs.dll's MiniDump (ordinal #24) export — a LOLBIN credential-dumping technique repeatedly observed from APT5 / UNC2630 / Mulberry Typhoon following Pulse Secure & Citrix NetScaler appliance compromise.
references:
  - https://media.defense.gov/2022/Dec/13/2003131586/-1/-1/0/CSA-APT5-CITRIX-ADC-V1.PDF
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/check-your-pulse-suspected-apt-actors-leverage-authentication-bypass
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1023/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/05
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1218.011
  - apt5
  - mulberry_typhoon
  - unc2630
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'

// APT5 / Mulberry Typhoon — RAR archive staging in non-user paths
let _stage_paths = dynamic([@"C:\PerfLogs\", @"C:\ProgramData\", @"C:\Users\Public\", @"C:\Windows\Temp\", @"C:\Intel\", @"C:\Recovery\", @"C:\$Recycle.Bin\"]);
let _rar_names    = dynamic(["rar.exe","rar32.exe","winrar.exe","r.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has " a "        // rar add command
// Either the binary is named rar/winrar/r/rar32, OR cmdline carries the rar password+volume signature regardless of name (renamed binary)
| where (FileName in~ (_rar_names))
     or (ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ ("Rar.exe","WinRAR.exe"))
     or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-hp\S+.+\s-v\d+")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-hp[\S]{4,}"   // password flag with non-empty password

| extend StagingHit = iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any (_stage_paths)
                       or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_stage_paths)
                       or FolderPath has_any (_stage_paths), true, false)
| extend RenamedRar = iff(FileName !in~ ("rar.exe","winrar.exe")
                       and ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ ("Rar.exe","WinRAR.exe"), true, false)
| extend SplitArchive = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-v\d+[kmg]?"
| where StagingHit or RenamedRar or SplitArchive
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          BinaryOnDisk = FileName, OriginalName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256,

status: experimental
description: Detects sc.exe being used to register a Windows service whose binary lives in a writeable non-system directory (ProgramData, Users\Public, Windows\Temp, PerfLogs). This is the standard service-installation step used by every Agrius (Pink Sandstorm / AMERICIUM / Agonizing Serpens) wiper and ransomware payload — Apostle, DEADWOOD, Fantasy, MultiLayer, Moneybird, IPsecHelper, and BiBi-Windows.

// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(
    RemoteUrl has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and RemoteIP == PrevIP
| where datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=Timestamp, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime),
          DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, LowPrivUrl=PrevUrl, AdminUrl=RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by AdminEventTime desc

| eval delay_sec = round(child_spawn_time - first_inbound, 1)

ucs.kql:
// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ListenerPorts = make_set(ListenerPort, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, ParentPid, SHA256
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, FirstInbound)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,
          DelaySec, ListenerPorts, SrcIps, DistinctSrcIps, ParentPid, SHA256
| order by ChildTime desc

ucs.kql:
// Ajax Security Team 'Stealer' — non-browser process copying browser credential stores
let BrowserBins   = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","setup.exe","msiexec.exe","OneDrive.exe","backgroundtaskhost.exe"]);
let BrowserPaths  = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\", @"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\", @"\Opera Software\", @"\BraveSoftware\"]);
let CredFiles     = dynamic(["login data","web data","cookies","logins.json","key3.db","key4.db","signons.sqlite","cert8.db","cert9.db","places.sqlite"]);
let StealerFile = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where tolower(FileName) in (CredFiles)
         or FileName matches regex @"(?i)(login.?data|signons|cookies)\.(sqlite|db|copy|bak|tmp)$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where not(FolderPath has_any (BrowserPaths))   // copy lives OUTSIDE the legit profile dir
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              ActorUser    = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ActorProc    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ActorCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ActorFolder  = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              DroppedFile  = strcat(FolderPath,"\\",FileName),
              ActorSHA256  = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
// Optional enrichment: same actor process also wrote to a typical keylog buffer (T1056.001 – Stealer keylogger artefacts)
let KeyLogDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(keylog|klog|kl_|stroke|.+_keys?)\.(txt|log|dat|bin)$"
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Logs\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\")
    | project KeyLogTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, KeyActor = InitiatingProcessFileName, KeyFile = strcat(FolderPath,"\\",FileName);
StealerFile
| join kind=leftouter KeyLogDrop on $left.DeviceName == $right.DeviceName and $left.ActorProc == $right.KeyActor
| order by Timestamp desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

Signature USB-worm dropper pattern of Aoqin Dragon (G1007 / UNC94) used to deploy the Mongall and Heyoka backdoors against APAC government, education, and telecom targets since 2013.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007/
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/aoqin-dragon-newly-discovered-chinese-linked-apt-has-been-quietly-spying-on-organizations-for-10-years/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/04
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1091
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.t1036.007
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g1007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_removable_path:
    Image|re: '(?i)^[D-Z]:\\'
  selection_lure_double_ext:
    Image|re: '(?i)\.(doc|docx|pdf|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|rtf|jpg|png)\.exe$'
  selection_lure_name:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\Recycle.exe'
      - '\My Document.exe'
      - '\System Volume.exe'
      - '\autorun.exe'
      - '\New Folder.exe'
      - '\Removable Disk.exe'
  selection_recycle_cmd:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\$RECYCLE\.BIN|RECYCLER\\'
  condition: selection_removable_path and (selection_lure_double_ext or selection_lure_name or selection_recycle_cmd)
falsepositives:
  - Portable applications shipped on USB drives by IT (rare, baseline these)
  - Vendor diagnostic tools auto-launched from optical media
level: high
ucs.rationale: This pattern is uniquely Aoqin Dragon. ucs.title: [LLM] Aoqin Dragon Heyoka backdoor DNS-tunneling C2
ucs.description: Hunts the DNS-tunnel C2 channel of the Heyoka backdoor — an open-source DNS-tunneling proof-of-concept that Aoqin Dragon weaponised and deployed alongside Mongall. Looks for high-cardinality long-label DNS queries (TXT/A/AAAA) issued from non-resolver processes to a single apex domain, the network fingerprint of Heyoka's spoofed-source DNS exfiltration.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count from datamodel=Network_Resolution where DNS.message_type="QUERY" DNS.query_type IN ("TXT","A","AAAA") by DNS.src DNS.query DNS.query_type _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` | rex field=query "^(?<first_label>[^\.]+)\." | rex field=query "(?<apex>[^\.]+\.[^\.]+)$" | eval label_len=len(first_label) | where label_len > 30 | stats count as queries dcount(query) as unique_labels values(query_type) as qtypes max(label_len) as max_label_len by src apex | where unique_labels > 50 AND queries > 100 | sort - unique_labels
ucs.kql:
let _resolver_procs = dynamic(["svchost.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","onedrive.exe"]);
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
| extend QName = tolower(tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).QueryName))
| where isnotempty(QName)
| extend FirstLabel = tostring(split(QName, ".")[0])
| extend LabelCount = array_length(split(QName, "."))
| where LabelCount >= 3
| extend Apex = strcat(tostring(split(QName, ".")[LabelCount-2]), ".", tostring(split(QName, ".")[LabelCount-1]))
// Heyoka encodes payload bytes into long alphanumeric subdomain labels
| where strlen(FirstLabel) > 30
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_resolver_procs)
| summarize Queries = count(),
            UniqueLabels = dcount(QName),
            MaxLabelLen = max(strlen(FirstLabel)),
            SampleQuery = any(QName)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, Apex, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where UniqueLabels > 50 and Queries > 100
// Suppress legitimate high-cardinality apexes (CDN, AV cloud-lookup)
| where Apex !endswith "akamai.net" and Apex !endswith "cloudfront.net"
     and Apex !endswith "trendmicro.com" and Apex !endswith "mcafee.com"
     and Apex !endswith "microsoft.com" and Apex !endswith "windows.com"
     and Apex !endswith "office.com" and Apex !endswith "office365.com"
| order by UniqueLabels desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let _resolver_hosts = dynamic(["akamai.net","cloudfront.net","trendmicro.com","mcafee.com","microsoft.com","windows.com","office.com","office365.com","googleusercontent.com"]);
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where QueryType in ("TXT","A","AAAA","1","16","28")
| where isnotempty(Name)
| extend QName = tolower(Name)
| extend FirstLabel = tostring(split(QName, ".")[0])
| extend LabelCount = array_length(split(QName, "."))
| where LabelCount >= 3
| extend Apex = strcat(tostring(split(QName, ".")[LabelCount-2]), ".", tostring(split(QName, ".")[LabelCount-1]))
| where strlen(FirstLabel) > 30
| where not(Apex has_any (_resolver_hosts))
| summarize Queries = count(),
            UniqueLabels = dcount(QName),
            MaxLabelLen = max(strlen(FirstLabel)),
            QueryTypes = make_set(QueryType, 5),
            SampleQuery = any(QName)
            by ClientIP, Computer, Apex, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where UniqueLabels > 50 and Queries > 100
| order by UniqueLabels desc
ucs.rationale: Aoqin Dragon's documented backdoor toolkit centres on Heyoka, a public DNS-tunneling PoC the group customised (T1587.001 in the actor's MITRE profile). Heyoka's distinguishing feature is encoding C2 traffic into long base32-style subdomain labels under an attacker-controlled apex, producing the high-unique-label / long-first-label / non-resolver-process fingerprint this hunt anchors on. ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgr = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","pnpm.exe","pnpm","yarn.exe","yarn","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","nuget.exe","dotnet.exe","code.exe","cursor.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3.exe","python3","pwsh.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","dash","curl.exe","wget.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","api.nuget.org","nuget.org","marketplace.visualstudio.com","open-vsx.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","ghcr.io","go.dev","crates.io","rubygems.org"]);
let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," add ","restore","--install-extension"," ci ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
         or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | extend HostOnly = tolower(tostring(split(RemoteUrl, "/")[0]))
    | where not(HostOnly in~ (RegistryAllow))
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".npmjs.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pypi.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pythonhosted.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".yarnpkg.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".nuget.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".visualstudio.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".github.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".githubusercontent.com")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChildProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ChildCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
Installs
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId, AccountName
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, InstallTime)
| summarize InstallTime = min(InstallTime),
            EgressTime = min(EgressTime),
            DelaySec   = min(DelaySec),
            RemoteHits = dcount(strcat(RemoteIP,":",tostring(RemotePort))),
            SampleRemoteUrl = any(RemoteUrl),
            SampleRemoteIP  = any(RemoteIP),
            SamplePkgCmd    = any(PkgCmd),
            SampleChildCmd  = any(ChildCmd)
         by DeviceName, AccountName, PkgMgr, ChildProc, ChildParent
| order by EgressTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);

let InstallSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,

              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,

let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"

| extend CredHit = iif(isnotempty(AccessFile) and FileTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow), AccessFile, "")

ucs.title: [LLM] Aquatic Panda Log4Shell exploitation of VMware Horizon Tomcat spawning recon LOLBins
ucs.description: Hunts the exact post-exploitation chain CrowdStrike OverWatch attributed to Aquatic Panda (G0143) in December 2021: Log4Shell against VMware Horizon causes the Apache Tomcat service (ws_TomcatService.exe / java.exe under the Horizon Server path) to spawn recon LOLBins (whoami, hostname, ping, net, systeminfo, tasklist) and PowerShell/cmd, followed by WMIC and rundll32. description: Detects the post-exploitation hands-on-keyboard activity attributed to Aquatic Panda (G0143) following Log4Shell exploitation of VMware Horizon, where ws_TomcatService.exe / java.exe spawns recon LOLBins, cmd.exe and PowerShell.

      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'

      - '\hostname.exe'
      - '\net.exe'

      - '\ping.exe'

ucs.rationale: Java/Tomcat under a Horizon Server path is virtually never a legitimate parent of cmd.exe, powershell.exe, whoami, net, or rundll32. ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker
    | project ShellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FileName,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildHash   = SHA256,
              ChildPath   = FolderPath;
let RuntimeEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
RuntimeShells
| join kind=inner RuntimeEgress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)
| summarize EgressIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            EgressUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            FirstEgress = min(EgressTime),
            LastEgress  = max(EgressTime)
            by ShellTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildHash, ChildPath
| order by ShellTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","arc.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let SystemBins = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseNdr.exe","CSFalconService.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredFileNames = dynamic(["Login Data","Login Data For Account","Cookies","Web Data","Local State","logins.json","key3.db","key4.db","cert8.db","cert9.db","signons.sqlite"]);
let CredFolderTokens = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\",@"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",@"\Opera Software\Opera Stable\",@"\Vivaldi\User Data\",@"/.config/google-chrome/",@"/.config/chromium/",@"/.mozilla/firefox/"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
        or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessId)
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredFile = FolderPath, CredName = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstFile = min(FileTime),
            FirstNet  = min(NetTime),
            DelaySec  = min(datetime_diff('second', NetTime, FileTime)),
            CredFiles = make_set(strcat(CredFile, CredName), 25),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            RemoteUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            RemotePorts = make_set(RemotePort, 25),
            EgressCount = count()
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= 600
| order by FirstFile desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","rubygems.org","proxy.golang.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","nodejs.org","npmmirror.com"]);
let CredPaths = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",@"\.aws\credentials",@"\.ssh\id_",@"\.npmrc",@"\.docker\config.json",@"\.gitconfig",@".config/gh/hosts.yml"]);
let InstallSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallTime = Timestamp,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildFile = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isempty(RemoteUrl) or not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, NetTime = Timestamp,
              EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FolderPath has_any (CredPaths)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    | project DeviceId, FileTime = Timestamp,
              AccessProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              AccessFile = FolderPath;
InstallSpawns
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow)
| join kind=leftouter CredAccess on DeviceId
| extend CredHit = iif(isnotempty(AccessFile) and FileTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow), AccessFile, "")
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| project InstallTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd,
          NetTime, DelaySec, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, EgressProcess,
          CredHit
| summarize arg_min(InstallTime, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentFile, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by InstallTime desc

let _server_parents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","java.exe","java","javaw.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nginx.exe","nginx","xrdp","xrdp-sesman","portainer.exe","portainer","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek-tui","n8n.exe","n8n","flowise","ruby.exe","ruby","perl","go","php-fpm"]);

    | where FileName in~ (_shells_lolbins)

              NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,

_spawn

let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";

    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker

              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","arc.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let SystemBins = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseNdr.exe","CSFalconService.exe","explorer.exe"]);

let CredFolderTokens = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\",@"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",@"\Opera Software\Opera Stable\",@"\Vivaldi\User Data\",@"/.config/google-chrome/",@"/.config/chromium/",@"/.mozilla/firefox/"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
        or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessId)
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredFile = FolderPath, CredName = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstFile = min(FileTime),
            FirstNet  = min(NetTime),
            DelaySec  = min(datetime_diff('second', NetTime, FileTime)),
            CredFiles = make_set(strcat(CredFile, CredName), 25),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            RemoteUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            RemotePorts = make_set(RemotePort, 25),
            EgressCount = count()
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= 600
| order by FirstFile desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","rubygems.org","proxy.golang.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","nodejs.org","npmmirror.com"]);
let CredPaths = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",@"\.aws\credentials",@"\.ssh\id_",@"\.npmrc",@"\.docker\config.json",@"\.gitconfig",@".config/gh/hosts.yml"]);
let InstallSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallTime = Timestamp,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildFile = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isempty(RemoteUrl) or not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, NetTime = Timestamp,
              EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FolderPath has_any (CredPaths)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    | project DeviceId, FileTime = Timestamp,
              AccessProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              AccessFile = FolderPath;
InstallSpawns
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow)
| join kind=leftouter CredAccess on DeviceId
| extend CredHit = iif(isnotempty(AccessFile) and FileTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow), AccessFile, "")
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| project InstallTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd,
          NetTime, DelaySec, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, EgressProcess,
          CredHit
| summarize arg_min(InstallTime, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentFile, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by InstallTime desc

ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as install_time values(Processes.process) as install_cmd values(Processes.user) as install_user values(Processes.process_name) as install_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("npm.exe","npm","npx.exe","npx","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","cargo.exe","cargo") AND (Processes.process="*install*" OR Processes.process="*add *" OR Processes.process="* test*" OR Processes.process="*preinstall*" OR Processes.process="*postinstall*" OR Processes.process="*ci *") by Processes.dest Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as src | join type=inner src [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as egress_time values(All_Traffic.dest) as c2_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as c2_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as c2_port values(All_Traffic.app) as egress_app from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category="external" AND NOT (All_Traffic.dest IN ("registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","npmjs.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.python.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","jsdelivr.net","unpkg.com","ghcr.io","yarnpkg.com") OR All_Traffic.dest IN ("<registry_allowlist>")) by All_Traffic.src ] | where egress_time >= install_time AND egress_time <= install_time + 300 | eval delay_sec=egress_time-install_time | stats min(install_time) as firstInstall max(egress_time) as lastEgress dc(c2_dest) as distinct_dests values(c2_dest) as c2_dests values(c2_ip) as c2_ips values(c2_port) as c2_ports values(egress_app) as egress_apps values(install_cmd) as install_cmds values(install_user) as users values(install_proc) as install_procs min(delay_sec) as min_delay by src | where distinct_dests >= 1 | convert ctime(firstInstall) ctime(lastEgress) | sort 0 -firstInstall
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npx.exe","npx","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","cargo.exe","cargo"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","npmjs.com","yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.python.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","jsdelivr.net","unpkg.com","ghcr.io"]);
let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install","add "," test"," ci ","preinstall","postinstall")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallProc = FileName, InstallCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              InstallPGuid = ProcessUniqueId;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend RemoteHost = tolower(coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP))
    | where not (RemoteHost has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where not (RemoteHost endswith ".github.io")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, RemoteHost;
Installs
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, InstallTime)
| summarize FirstInstall = min(InstallTime), LastEgress = max(EgressTime),
            MinDelay = min(DelaySec), DistinctDests = dcount(RemoteHost),
            Dests = make_set(RemoteHost, 20),
            EgressInitiators = make_set(EgressInitiator, 10),
            SampleInstallCmd = any(InstallCmd), SampleEgressCmd = any(EgressCmd)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InstallProc
| where DistinctDests >= 1
| order by FirstInstall desc

ucs.title: [LLM] BRONZE BUTLER (Tick) — Daserf/xxmm DLL side-loading via signed-binary proxy in user-writable paths
ucs.description: Hunts BRONZE BUTLER's signature loader chain: a legitimately signed third-party binary (commonly a Symantec, Trend Micro, Hewlett-Packard, or Kaspersky utility) is dropped into AppData/ProgramData/Public/Temp and used to sideload a co-resident malicious DLL (Daserf, xxmm/Minzen, Datper). This T1574.001 + T1036.005 + T1027 chain is one of Tick's most consistent fingerprints across a decade of intrusions in Japan.

// BRONZE BUTLER / Tick — signed legit binary side-loading from user-writable path
let _suspicious_paths = dynamic([@"\\AppData\\", @"\\ProgramData\\", @"\\Users\\Public\\", @"\\Windows\\Temp\\", @"\\Downloads\\"]);
let _vendor_decoys = dynamic(["Symantec","Trend Micro","Kaspersky","Hewlett-Packard","HP Inc.","Hewlett Packard","Sourcenext","Lhaplus","NEC","Fujitsu","Justsystems","Sky Co.,LTD."]);
let SignedBinaryRunFromUserPath =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any (_vendor_decoys)
         or ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any (_vendor_decoys)
    | where FolderPath has_any (_suspicious_paths)
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files") and not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ProcCompany = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              ParentCompany = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName;
// Side-loaded DLL = different SHA256, same folder, loaded by the signed proxy
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_suspicious_paths)
| where FolderPath =~ InitiatingProcessFolderPath           // co-resident DLL drop

let PkgInstallChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"

    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)

// BackdoorDiplomacy webshell footprint — IIS/Exchange w3wp spawning hands-on-keyboard recon
let RecentDays = 7d;
let ReconBins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","nltest.exe","hostname.exe","quser.exe","wmic.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe"]);
let WebHostParents = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(RecentDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (WebHostParents)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
// noise filter — IIS app-pool identities running benign single-shot health checks
| where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("HealthMailbox","MSExchangeHM"))
| summarize ChildCount = dcount(FileName),
            DistinctChildren = make_set(FileName, 25),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            ParentCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            AppPoolUser = any(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where ChildCount >= 2          // ≥2 distinct LOLBins from the same w3wp in 1h = hands-on-keyboard, not single ASP.NET callout
| order by FirstSeen desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

// Edge zero-day post-exploit — service process spawning shell/ingress LOLBin on Linux/macOS
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let _WebServerProcs = dynamic([
    "httpd","nginx","apache2","java","tomcat","sslmgr","useridd",
    "authd","mifs","node","python","python3","sshd","pan_comm_mgr",
    "panlogd","catalina.sh","ws_TomcatService.sh"]);
let _ShellChildren = dynamic([
    "bash","sh","csh","zsh","dash","ksh","tcsh","python","python3",
    "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat","busybox","gawk"]);
let _AutomationParents = dynamic([
    "puppet","ansible-playbook","chef-client","salt-minion","cron","crond","systemd"]);
let ShellSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OSPlatform in ("Linux","macOS")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | where FileName in~ (_ShellChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ (_AutomationParents)
    | where ProcessCommandLine !has " --version"
        and ProcessCommandLine !has " -V"
        and not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\bstatus\b")
        and ProcessCommandLine !has "healthcheck"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc  = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              FolderPath, SHA256;
// Corroborating signal — webshell/script drop into a web root by the same kind of service process
let WebshellDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has_any (
        @"/mi/tomcat/webapps/", @"/var/www/", @"/usr/share/nginx/html/",
        @"/opt/pan/", @"/var/panlogs/", @"/opt/tomcat/webapps/",
        @"/srv/www/", @"/htdocs/")
    | where FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName endswith ".jspx"
         or FileName endswith ".php" or FileName endswith ".aspx"
         or FileName endswith ".sh"  or FileName endswith ".py"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_WebServerProcs)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DroppedFile = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath, DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ShellSpawns
| join kind=leftouter WebshellDrops on DeviceId
| extend CorroboratingDropMin = iff(isnotempty(DropTime), datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, DropTime), int(null))
| where isnull(CorroboratingDropMin) or abs(CorroboratingDropMin) <= 10
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentProc, ParentCmd, ChildProc, ChildCmd, FolderPath, SHA256, CorroboratingDropMin, DroppedFile, DropPath, DroppedBy
| order by Timestamp desc

let CredFileNames = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc",".netrc",".env","credentials","credentials.json","id_rsa","id_ed25519",".gitconfig","config.json"]);

let PkgInstallChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentName=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildName=FileName,

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackByte BYOVD: RTCore64.sys (MSI Afterburner) driver dropped to disable EDR
ucs.description: Hunts BlackByte's signature 'Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver' tradecraft — the actor drops the legitimately-signed MSI Afterburner driver RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) and abuses its IOCTL interface to terminate EDR/AV processes from kernel-mode before launching encryption. let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","arc.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let SystemBins = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseNdr.exe","CSFalconService.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredFileNames = dynamic(["Login Data","Login Data For Account","Cookies","Web Data","Local State","logins.json","key3.db","key4.db","cert8.db","cert9.db","signons.sqlite"]);
let CredFolderTokens = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\",@"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",@"\Opera Software\Opera Stable\",@"\Vivaldi\User Data\",@"/.config/google-chrome/",@"/.config/chromium/",@"/.mozilla/firefox/"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents

    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")

    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredFile = FolderPath, CredName = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")

CredReads

| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)

            EgressCount = count()

// BlackTech / Palmerworm DLL side-load — signed third-party loader running from user-writable path AND loading a DLL co-located in that path.
let lookback = 7d;
let _user_writable = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\temp\", @"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\perflogs\"]);
let _abused_loaders = dynamic([
    "acrord32.exe","acrobroker.exe","itunes.exe","ituneshelper.exe",
    "javaw.exe","jusched.exe","plugin_host.exe","presentationhost.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","googleupdate.exe","notepad++.exe","vmtoolsd.exe",
    "tmdbg.exe","coreserviceshell.exe","avp.exe","egui.exe",
    "hkcmd.exe","igfxtray.exe","setup.exe","sandboxie.exe"]);
