| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (_abused_loaders)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_user_writable)
| where FolderPath has_any (_user_writable)
// DLL is dropped next to (or one level under) the abused signed binary — classic search-order hijack
| extend _loaderDir = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath), _dllDir = tolower(FolderPath)
| where _dllDir == _loaderDir or _dllDir startswith _loaderDir
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files") and not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where tolower(FileName) in (_abused_loaders)
    | project DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId = ProcessId, ProcessCreationTime, ProcessCommandLine, AccountName, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession
  ) on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LegitBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LegitPath   = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          LegitSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          SideLoadDLL = FileName,
          DllPath     = FolderPath,
          DllSHA256   = SHA256,

ucs.title: [LLM] Blue Mockingbird COR_PROFILER DLL hijack persistence (Monero crypto-mining loader)
ucs.description: Hunts for the actor's signature persistence trick — setting machine-wide COR_ENABLE_PROFILING / COR_PROFILER / COR_PROFILER_PATH registry values (or environment variables) so that any .NET process loads a Blue Mockingbird XMRig DLL (typically wercplsupporte.dll / wercplsupportes.dll). Red Canary observed this exact behaviour as the actor's primary boot persistence mechanism.

ucs.kql:
// Blue Mockingbird (G0108) — COR_PROFILER persistence loader
let _profiler_values = dynamic(["COR_ENABLE_PROFILING","COR_PROFILER","COR_PROFILER_PATH","COR_PROFILER_PATH_32","COR_PROFILER_PATH_64"]);
let _known_profilers = dynamic([
  @"C:\Program Files\dotnet\",
  @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\",
  @"C:\Windows\System32\inetsrv\",
  @"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Application Insights\",
  @"C:\Program Files\IIS\Microsoft Web Deploy"]);
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\Microsoft\.NETFramework", @"\Environment")
| where RegistryValueName in~ (_profiler_values)
// Blue Mockingbird flips profiling on machine-wide and points it at a DLL outside the standard profiler dirs
| extend Suspicious =
    (RegistryValueName =~ "COR_ENABLE_PROFILING" and RegistryValueData == "1")
    or (RegistryValueName =~ "COR_PROFILER"        and RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)^\{[A-F0-9\-]{36}\}$")
    or (RegistryValueName startswith_cs "COR_PROFILER_PATH"
        and RegistryValueData endswith ".dll"
        and not(RegistryValueData has_any (_known_profilers)))
| where Suspicious
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","setup.exe","vs_installer.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.kql:
// Blue Mockingbird (G0108) — Telerik (CVE-2019-18935) → w3wp.exe LOLBin chain → mining DLL execution
let _lookback = 7d;
let _window = 5m;
let _mining_dll_signals = dynamic([
  "wercplsupport", "wercplsupporte", "wercplsupportes",  // observed Blue Mockingbird DLL names
  "xmrig", "monero", "stratum+tcp", "--donate-level", "-o pool.", "cryptonight"]);
let _drop_paths = dynamic([
  @"\inetpub\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\"]);
// 1. w3wp.exe spawning a LOLBin (Telerik exploit yields code-exec under IIS app-pool identity)
let WebshellSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(_lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","regsvr32.exe",
                          "rundll32.exe","wmic.exe","sc.exe","net.exe","net1.exe",
                          "certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe")
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SpawnAccount = AccountName,
              SpawnedBin   = FileName,
              SpawnedCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              IISCmd       = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// 2. regsvr32/rundll32/wmic invoking a DLL from a drop path or named like the actor's loader
let MinerInvoke = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(_lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has ".dll"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any (_drop_paths))
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (_mining_dll_signals)
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has "process call create"
             and ProcessCommandLine has "regsvr32")
    | project MinerTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              MinerBin = FileName, MinerCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              MinerParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
// 3. Same host, mining invocation within 5 minutes of the IIS webshell spawn
WebshellSpawn
| join kind=inner MinerInvoke on DeviceId
| where MinerTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + _window)
| project SpawnTime, MinerTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', MinerTime, SpawnTime),
          DeviceName, SpawnAccount,
          IISCmd, SpawnedBin, SpawnedCmd,
          MinerBin, MinerCmd, MinerParent
| order by SpawnTime desc

let ReconBins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","arp.exe","hostname.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","wmic.exe"]);
let ReconCmds = dynamic(["whoami","systeminfo","net user","net group","net localgroup administrators","nltest /domain_trusts","nltest /dclist","tasklist","ipconfig /all","query user","net view","arp -a","route print"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any (ReconCmds)
| extend AppPool = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| summarize ReconHits = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(FileName),
            Children  = make_set(FileName, 32),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            User      = any(AccountName)
            by DeviceName, AppPool
| where ReconHits >= 2 and DistinctChildren >= 2          // 1 hit = noise; chained recon = web-shell driving
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Tortoiseshell/CURIUM IIS web-shell recon — Sentinel port (SecurityEvent 4688)
let ReconBins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","quser.exe","query.exe","arp.exe","hostname.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","wmic.exe"]);
let ReconCmds = dynamic(["whoami","systeminfo","net user","net group","net localgroup administrators","nltest /domain_trusts","nltest /dclist","tasklist","ipconfig /all","query user","net view","arp -a"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         ChildLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentLeaf == "w3wp.exe"
| where ChildLeaf in (ReconBins)
   or CommandLine has_any (ReconCmds)
| summarize ReconHits = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(ChildLeaf),
            Children = make_set(ChildLeaf, 32),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
            Account  = any(Account)
            by Computer, ParentProcessName
| where ReconHits >= 2 and DistinctChildren >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

status: experimental
description: Detects w3wp.exe spawning native Windows discovery utilities consistent with Tortoiseshell/CURIUM Backdoor.Syskit web-shell hands-on-keyboard activity against compromised IT-service-provider OWA/IIS servers.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/blogs/threat-intelligence/tortoiseshell-apt-supply-chain
author: SOC Detection Engineering

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'

      - '\tasklist.exe'

      - '\arp.exe'
      - '\hostname.exe'
      - '\reg.exe'

      - '\wmic.exe'

      - 'net localgroup administrators'
      - 'nltest /domain_trusts'
      - 'tasklist'
      - 'ipconfig /all'

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgr = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","pnpm.exe","pnpm","yarn.exe","yarn","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","nuget.exe","dotnet.exe","code.exe","cursor.exe"]);

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," add ","restore","--install-extension"," ci ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)

| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as spawnTime values(Processes.process_command_line) as childCmd values(Processes.parent_process) as parentCmd values(Processes.process_path) as childPath from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","node","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pip.exe","pip","pip3","composer","composer.phar") OR Processes.parent_process IN ("*npm install*","*npm ci*","*npx *","*yarn install*","*pnpm install*","*pip install*","*composer install*","*composer require*","*lifecycle*preinstall*","*lifecycle*postinstall*")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","bash.exe","sh","sh.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","bun","bun.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe") OR Processes.process_command_line="*oven-sh/bun*" OR Processes.process_command_line="*releases/download*" OR Processes.process_command_line="*raw.githubusercontent.com*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_command_line Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rename host as src
| join type=inner src [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as egressTime values(All_Traffic.dest_host) as destHost values(All_Traffic.dest) as destIp values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as destPort from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal" AND NOT (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","repo.packagist.org","packagist.org") OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.npmjs.org" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.pypi.org") by All_Traffic.src _time | rename All_Traffic.src as src | fields src egressTime destHost destIp destPort]
| where egressTime>=spawnTime AND egressTime<=relative_time(spawnTime,"+5m")
| stats min(spawnTime) as firstSpawn dc(destHost) as uniqueDests values(destHost) as destHosts values(destIp) as destIps values(parent_process_name) as parents values(process_name) as children values(process_command_line) as childCmds by src user
| where uniqueDests>=1
| convert ctime(firstSpawn) as firstSpawn
| sort - firstSpawn
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","python.exe","python3","pip.exe","pip3","composer","composer.phar"]);
let PkgMgrCmdHints = dynamic(["npm install","npm ci","npx ","yarn install","pnpm install","pip install","composer install","composer require","preinstall","postinstall","lifecycle"]);
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","bash.exe","sh","sh.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bun","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","repo.packagist.org","packagist.org"]);
let InstallSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents))
         or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("oven-sh/bun","releases/download","raw.githubusercontent.com","curl -s","wget -q","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage=FolderPath,
              ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc=FileName;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl !in~ (RegistryHosts)
    | where not(RemoteUrl endswith ".npmjs.org" or RemoteUrl endswith ".pypi.org" or RemoteUrl endswith "pythonhosted.org" or RemoteUrl endswith "packagist.org")
    | project EgressTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              EgressUrl=RemoteUrl, EgressIP=RemoteIP, EgressPort=RemotePort,
              EgressInitiator=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressInitiatorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize FirstSpawn=min(SpawnTime),
            FirstEgress=min(EgressTime),
            UniqueDestHosts=dcount(EgressUrl),
            DestHosts=make_set(EgressUrl, 25),
            DestIPs=make_set(EgressIP, 25),
            EgressInitiators=make_set(EgressInitiator, 10)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentCmd, ChildProc, ChildCmd
| where UniqueDestHosts >= 1     // any non-registry public destination inside the install window
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstEgress, FirstSpawn)
| order by FirstSpawn desc

ucs.kql:
let WindowSec = 300;
let SecretFilePatterns = dynamic([@"\.npmrc", @"\.pypirc", @"\.aws\credentials", @"\.aws\config", @"\.ssh\id_", @"\.kube\config", @"\.docker\config.json", @"\.git-credentials", @"\.gitconfig", @"\.env", @"\.netrc", @"\.vault-token", "NPM_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "pypi-token"]);
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","gem.exe","bundle.exe"]);
let PkgProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgrs) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project PkgTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgFile = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              PkgParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let SecretReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
       or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
       or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe")
    | extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, @"\", FileName)
    | where FullPath has_any (SecretFilePatterns)
    | project SecretTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ReaderName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SecretPath = FullPath;
let Beacons = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
       or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
       or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, BeaconName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
PkgProcs
| join kind=inner SecretReads on DeviceId
| where SecretTime between (PkgTime .. PkgTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| summarize SecretCount = dcount(SecretPath),
            Secrets = make_set(SecretPath, 20),
            FirstSecretTime = min(SecretTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, PkgTime, PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd
| where SecretCount >= 3
| join kind=inner Beacons on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (PkgTime .. PkgTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| summarize C2_IPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 20),
            C2_Urls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20),
            FirstNetTime = min(NetTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, PkgTime, PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd, SecretCount, Secrets
| project Timestamp = PkgTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd,
          SecretCount, Secrets,
          InstallToSecretSec = datetime_diff('second', FirstNetTime, PkgTime),
          C2_IPs, C2_Urls
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Package-manager install hook spawns interpreter that beacons to non-registry host within 120s
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as proc_time values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","composer.phar","composer","php.exe","php","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nuget.exe","pip","pip3","pip.exe","python.exe","python","python3") Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","node","bun.exe","bun","python.exe","python","python3","php.exe","php","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","sh","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| rename process_id as install_pid
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as net_time values(All_Traffic.dest) as c2_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as c2_ip values(All_Traffic.app) as net_app from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,53,8080,8443) NOT (All_Traffic.dest IN ("registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","api.nuget.org","www.nuget.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.org","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com")) by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_ip All_Traffic.process_id host
    | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")`
    | rename src as dest process_id as install_pid
]
| eval delay_sec = round((net_time - proc_time),0)
| where delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec <= 120
| where NOT match(c2_dest, "(?i)(npmjs|yarnpkg|packagist|nuget|pythonhosted|githubusercontent|github\.com|microsoft\.com|google\.com|amazonaws\.com)$")
| stats min(proc_time) as install_time min(net_time) as c2_time values(image) as binary values(parent_cmd) as install_cmd values(c2_dest) as c2_domain values(c2_ip) as c2_ip dc(c2_dest) as c2_count by dest user process_name parent_process_name
| where c2_count >= 1
| convert ctime(install_time) ctime(c2_time)
| `security_content_ctime(install_time)`
ucs.kql:
let Window = 120s;
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","composer","composer.phar","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nuget.exe","pip","pip3","pip.exe","python.exe","python","python3"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["node.exe","node","bun.exe","bun","python.exe","python","python3","php.exe","php","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","sh","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","api.nuget.org","www.nuget.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.org","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","deb.debian.org","security.ubuntu.com"]);
let KnownBadIOC = dynamic(["m-kosche.com","t.m-kosche.com","git-service.com","check.git-service.com","flipboxstudio.info","sportsontheweb.net","aab.sportsontheweb.net","moika.tech","oob.moika.tech","cloudplatform-single-spa.io","t-in-one.io","filev2.getsession.org"]);
let InstallSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InstallParent    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InterpreterImage = FolderPath,
              InterpreterCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              InterpreterPid   = ProcessId,
              InterpreterName  = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend Domain = tolower(tostring(RemoteUrl))
    | where Domain !in~ (RegistryAllow)
    | where not(Domain has_any (RegistryAllow))
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              EgressPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              EgressImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, $left.InterpreterPid == $right.EgressPid
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime)
| extend IsKnownIOC = RemoteUrl has_any (KnownBadIOC)
| summarize SpawnTime = min(SpawnTime), FirstBeacon = min(NetTime),
            Domains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            IPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
            InstallParent = any(InstallParent),
            InstallCmd = any(InstallParentCmd),
            InterpCmd = any(InterpreterCmd),
            MinDelaySec = min(DelaySec),
            IocHit = max(toint(IsKnownIOC))
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InterpreterName, InterpreterPid
| extend Severity = case(IocHit == 1, "High", "Medium")
| order by SpawnTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Carbanak (FIN7/Cobalt Group) service-name masquerade — DLL persistence in non-System32 paths
ucs.description: Hunts the Carbanak group's signature persistence: registering a Windows service whose name impersonates legitimate Microsoft services (e.g. 'Sysmain', 'WmiPrvSE', 'WindowsService', 'DefenderUpdate') but whose ImagePath points to a DLL/EXE under AppData, ProgramData, Public, PerfLogs, or %TEMP% — almost always invoked through rundll32.exe. Mandiant/Kaspersky reporting on Carbanak v3 / Anunak and the Carbanak source-code leak repeatedly highlight this exact masquerade-then-rundll32 chain.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as ImagePath values(Registry.process_name) as InstallProc values(Registry.user) as InstallUser from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" AND Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath" AND (Registry.registry_value_data="*\\AppData\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\$Recycle.Bin\\*") AND (Registry.registry_value_data="*rundll32*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*.dll*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*.exe*") by host Registry.registry_path | rex field=Registry.registry_path "Services\\\\(?<ServiceName>[^\\\\]+)" | search ServiceName IN ("Sysmain","SysMain","WmiPrvSE","WindowsService","WindowsManagement","DefenderUpdate","Update","WindowsUpdate","WindowsHelper","NetSvc","NetSvcs","SystemHelper","WinSrv","WinSvc","svchost") OR match(ServiceName,"^[A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z][a-z]+$") | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | table firstTime,lastTime,host,ServiceName,ImagePath,InstallProc,InstallUser
ucs.kql:
// Carbanak / FIN7 service-name masquerade with DLL/EXE in non-System32 path
let _suspect_paths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\", @"\Intel\Logs\"]);
let _masqueraded_service_names = dynamic(["Sysmain","SysMain","WmiPrvSE","WindowsService","WindowsManagement","WindowsHelper","WinSrv","WinSvc","NetSvc","NetSvcs","DefenderUpdate","WindowsUpdate","Update","SystemHelper","svchost"]);
let ServiceInstalls = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where ActionType == "RegistryValueSet"
    | where RegistryKey has @"\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (_suspect_paths)
    | extend ServiceName = extract(@"(?i)Services\\([^\\]+)(\\ImagePath)?$", 1, RegistryKey)
    | where ServiceName in~ (_masqueraded_service_names)
        or ServiceName matches regex @"^[A-Z][a-z]{1,8}[A-Z][a-z]{1,8}$"   // CamelCase impersonation
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ServiceName, ImagePath = RegistryValueData,
              InstallerProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InstallerCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InstallerUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
// Optional confirmation: rundll32 spawned from the same suspect path within 24h
let Rundll32Exec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_suspect_paths)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.dll['\"]?\s*[,\s]\s*\w+"  // calls an exported function
    | project DeviceName, RunTime = Timestamp, RunCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RunSHA256 = SHA256;
ServiceInstalls
| join kind=leftouter Rundll32Exec on DeviceName
| where isnull(RunTime) or RunTime between (Timestamp - 24h .. Timestamp + 24h)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ServiceName, ImagePath, InstallerProc, InstallerCmd, InstallerUser, RunTime, RunCmd, RunSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Carbanak / FIN7 service-name masquerade — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 7045 (service install) + 4688 (rundll32)
let _suspect_paths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\"]);
let _masqueraded_service_names = dynamic(["Sysmain","SysMain","WmiPrvSE","WindowsService","WindowsManagement","WindowsHelper","WinSrv","WinSvc","NetSvc","NetSvcs","DefenderUpdate","WindowsUpdate","SystemHelper","svchost"]);
let ServiceInstalls = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where EventID == 7045                                        // service installed
    | extend SvcName  = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[0]),
             ImagePath = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[1])
    | where isnotempty(ImagePath)
    | where ImagePath has_any (_suspect_paths)
    | where SvcName in~ (_masqueraded_service_names)
        or SvcName matches regex @"^[A-Z][a-z]{1,8}[A-Z][a-z]{1,8}$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcName, ImagePath, Account = SubjectUserName;
let Rundll32Exec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (_suspect_paths)
    | where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.dll['\"]?\s*[,\s]\s*\w+"
    | project Computer, RunTime = TimeGenerated, RunCmd = CommandLine, RunUser = Account;
ServiceInstalls
| join kind=leftouter Rundll32Exec on Computer
| where isnull(RunTime) or RunTime between (TimeGenerated - 24h .. TimeGenerated + 24h)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcName, ImagePath, Account, RunTime, RunCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 7c4a93ac-ca5b-4b7f-9b8a-5b6e0f7c8d11
status: experimental
description: Detects Windows service installation where the service name impersonates legitimate Microsoft services (Sysmain, WmiPrvSE, WindowsService, etc.) and the ImagePath points to AppData/ProgramData/Public/Temp — Carbanak's signature persistence pattern.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008/
  - https://securelist.com/the-great-bank-robbery-the-carbanak-apt/68732/

  - attack.t1036.004
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0008
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system
detection:
  selection_event:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
  selection_path:
    ImagePath|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\$Recycle.Bin\'
  selection_name:
    ServiceName:
      - 'Sysmain'
      - 'SysMain'
      - 'WmiPrvSE'
      - 'WindowsService'
      - 'WindowsManagement'
      - 'WindowsHelper'
      - 'DefenderUpdate'
      - 'WindowsUpdate'
      - 'SystemHelper'
      - 'svchost'
      - 'NetSvc'
      - 'NetSvcs'
  condition: selection_event and selection_path and selection_name

  - Custom enterprise software that installs into ProgramData (validate by SHA256 + signer)
level: high
ucs.rationale: Generic 'service installed' detections fire dozens of times a day in any enterprise. This rule is bound to the THREE elements that together are nearly unique to Carbanak/Anunak/FIN7's loader: (1) service name impersonates a built-in Windows service, (2) ImagePath lives outside System32 in a writable user-context directory, and (3) the binary on the other end of the ImagePath is invoked via rundll3

ucs.title: [LLM] Carbanak / FIN7 unauthorised remote-admin tool deployment (Ammyy Admin, RMS, TeamViewer) chained from Office or scripting host
ucs.description: Hunts Carbanak's hallmark hands-on-keyboard tooling: the deployment of Ammyy Admin (AA_v3.exe), Remote Manipulator System (rfusclient.exe / rutserv.exe / r_server.exe), or unauthorised TeamViewer/AnyDesk binaries dropped to user-writable paths and launched from an Office or script-host parent. Carbanak/FIN7 has consistently used Ammyy and RMS as their primary RAT layer for fraudulent SWIFT/ATM operations against banks (Kaspersky, Group-IB, Europol — Cobalt Group reports).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as path values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AA_v3.exe","AA_v4.exe","AA_v5.exe","AA_v6.exe","AA_v7.exe","ammyy.exe","ammyy_admin.exe","AmmyyService.exe","rfusclient.exe","rutserv.exe","r_server.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","atera.exe") OR Processes.original_file_name IN ("AA.exe","rfusclient.exe","rutserv.exe","TeamViewer.exe","AnyDesk.exe")) by host Processes.process_name Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search (path="*\\AppData\\*" OR path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR path="*\\Temp\\*" OR path="*\\Downloads\\*") OR parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","hh.exe","regsvr32.exe") | table firstTime,lastTime,host,user,process_name,path,parent_process_name,parent_cmd,cmdline
ucs.kql:
// Carbanak/FIN7 RAT deployment — Ammyy / RMS / TeamViewer / AnyDesk launched from suspect parent or path
let _rat_filenames = dynamic([
    "AA_v3.exe","AA_v4.exe","AA_v5.exe","AA_v6.exe","AA_v7.exe",
    "ammyy.exe","ammyy_admin.exe","AmmyyService.exe",
    "rfusclient.exe","rutserv.exe","r_server.exe",
    "RemoteUtilities.exe","AnyDesk.exe",
    "TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Desktop.exe","tv_w32.exe","tv_x64.exe",
    "ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","AteraAgent.exe"]);
let _rat_products = dynamic(["Ammyy","Remote Manipulator System","Remote Utilities","TeamViewer","AnyDesk","ScreenConnect","Atera"]);
let _suspect_paths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\PerfLogs\"]);
let _suspect_parents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","hh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
// Identify the RAT either by filename, original name, or product metadata
| where FileName in~ (_rat_filenames)
    or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ (_rat_filenames)
    or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has_any (_rat_products)
// Constrain to deployment context: dropped path OR launched by Office/scripting host
| where FolderPath has_any (_suspect_paths)
    or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_suspect_paths)
    or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_suspect_parents)
// Exclude any sanctioned IT staging path the org has whitelisted
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\TeamViewer\"   // tune to org-approved deployments
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\TeamViewer\"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          RAT          = FileName,
          RatProduct   = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
          RatPath      = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd     = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256  = SHA256,
          ParentImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentPath   = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentUser   = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          IsRemoteSession = AdditionalFields
| order by Timestamp desc

let _suspect_paths   = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\PerfLogs\"]);

ImProcessCreate

| where TargetProcessName has_any (_suspect_paths)
    or ParentProcessName has_any (_suspect_parents)
| where TargetProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files\TeamViewer\"
| where TargetProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\TeamViewer\"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,

title: Carbanak/FIN7 Remote Admin Tool Drop & Execute from Office or Scripting Host
id: 9b1e7f30-3a52-4d62-9c7d-2c2b6e7e0f44
status: experimental
description: Detects Ammyy Admin, Remote Manipulator System (RMS), unsanctioned TeamViewer/AnyDesk, or ScreenConnect/Atera launched from a user-writable path or spawned by an Office app or script host — the long-running Carbanak/FIN7 hands-on-keyboard pattern.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:

  - attack.t1219
  - attack.g0008
  - attack.g0046
  - attack.g0080
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rat:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AA_v3.exe'
      - '\AA_v4.exe'
      - '\AA_v5.exe'
      - '\AA_v6.exe'
      - '\AA_v7.exe'
      - '\ammyy.exe'
      - '\ammyy_admin.exe'

      - '\tv_x64.exe'

  selection_context:
    - Image|contains:
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\ProgramData\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '\Downloads\'
    - ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\winword.exe'

        - '\cscript.exe'

ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as proc_time values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_name values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","wsl.exe") by host Processes.process_name Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename process_id as proc_id | join type=inner host proc_id [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as net_time values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest="*.workers.dev" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.trycloudflare.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.supabase.co" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.pages.dev" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.web.app" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.r2.dev" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.vercel.app" OR All_Traffic.dest="raw.githubusercontent.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="gist.githubusercontent.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.replit.app" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.glitch.me") by host All_Traffic.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | rename process_id as proc_id] | eval delay_sec = net_time - proc_time | where delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec <= 300 | eval install_context = if(match(cmd,"(?i)preinstall|postinstall|npm\s+install|yarn\s+add|pip\s+install|gem\s+install|cargo\s+install|setup\.py"),1,0) | table proc_time delay_sec host user process_name cmd parent_name parent_cmd dest dest_port install_context | sort - proc_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;     // empirical: legitimate post-install fetches usually complete in <5m, beyond that the parent/child PID linkage gets noisy
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash.exe","wsl.exe"]);
let EdgeDomains = dynamic([".workers.dev",".trycloudflare.com",".supabase.co",".pages.dev",".web.app",".r2.dev",".vercel.app",".replit.app",".glitch.me",".onrender.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","bitbucket.org/raw"]);
let InstallHints = dynamic(["preinstall","postinstall","install.js","setup.py","pip install","npm install","yarn add","gem install","cargo install"]);
let ProcStart = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ScriptHost  = FileName,
              ScriptCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              ProcSHA256  = SHA256,
              ProcId      = ProcessId,
              IsRemoteSession = IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (EdgeDomains)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressProcId = InitiatingProcessId;
ProcStart
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, $left.ProcId == $right.EgressProcId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| extend InstallContext = iff(ParentCmd has_any (InstallHints) or ScriptCmd has_any (InstallHints), "install-hook", "runtime")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime), HitCount = count(),
            DistinctDomains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            SampleScriptCmd = any(ScriptCmd),
            SampleParentCmd = any(ParentCmd),
            arg_min(DelaySec, *)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ScriptHost, InstallContext
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Chimera 'Skeleton Key' DC authentication patching via Mimikatz on domain controllers (Operation Skeleton Key)
ucs.description: Hunts for the signature Chimera tradecraft documented by CyCraft and NCC Group: injecting Mimikatz into LSASS on a Domain Controller to install a skeleton-key master password, alongside the NTDS.dit theft pattern (vssadmin/ntdsutil 'IFM') Chimera staged before the patch. This pair is what defines G0114's intrusions against Taiwanese semiconductor and APAC airline targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.dest_category="domain_controller" OR Processes.dest="*DC*") AND ((Processes.process="*misc::skeleton*" OR Processes.process="*sekurlsa::logonpasswords*" OR Processes.process="*lsadump::lsa*/patch*" OR Processes.process="*lsadump::dcsync*") OR (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" AND Processes.process="*ifm*" AND Processes.process="*create full*") OR (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*create shadow*" AND Processes.process="*systemroot*") OR (Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" AND Processes.process="*MiniDump*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | sort 0 - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let DCs = DeviceInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OSPlatform startswith "WindowsServer"
    | where DeviceName has_any ("DC","-AD-","PDC","BDC") or RegistryDeviceTag has "DomainController"
    | summarize by DeviceId;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeviceId in (DCs)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where
    // Skeleton-key / LSASS credential patching indicators (Mimikatz commands)
    (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("misc::skeleton","sekurlsa::logonpasswords",
                                 "sekurlsa::pth","lsadump::dcsync","lsadump::lsa /patch"))
    // NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM (Chimera-documented)
    or (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
        and ProcessCommandLine has "ifm"
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create full","create rodc"))
    // VSS shadow against system volume to stage NTDS extraction
    or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"
        and ProcessCommandLine has "create shadow"
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\systemroot","C:\\","\\windows"))
    // LSASS minidump via comsvcs.dll (Chimera + Cobalt Strike standard)
    or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
        and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
        and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          IsRemoteSession = InitiatingProcessLogonId,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let DCs = DeviceInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OSPlatform startswith "WindowsServer"
    | where DeviceName has_any ("DC","-AD-","PDC","BDC") or RegistryDeviceTag has "DomainController"

SecurityEvent

| where EventID == 4688
| where Computer in (DCs) or Computer has_any ("DC","-AD-")

    or (NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"

| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine,

description: Detects Mimikatz skeleton-key, DCSync, ntdsutil IFM, VSS-of-system, or comsvcs.dll LSASS minidump on a DC \u2014 the credential-access chain attributed to Chimera (G0114) by CyCraft and NCC Group.

logsource:

detection:

ucs.kql:
// Cleaver / Operation Cleaver tooling — known binaries on disk or in execution
let _cleaver_binaries = dynamic([
    "jasus.exe",          // ARP poisoner - Cleaver custom
    "tinyzbot.exe",       // TinyZBot backdoor - Cleaver custom
    "wce.exe",            // Windows Credential Editor - Cleaver favourite
    "cain.exe",           // Cain & Abel - paired with Jasus for AiTM
    "netc.exe",
    "netcrawler.exe",     // Net Crawler propagator
    "smartftp.exe"        // exfil tooling abused by Cleaver
]);
let _cleaver_cmd_markers = dynamic([
    "jasus", "ZhoperCmd", "tinyzbot", "-arp -spoof", "net crawler"
]);
// Branch A — process execution
let _proc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ (_cleaver_binaries)
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any (_cleaver_cmd_markers)
       or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_cleaver_binaries)
    | extend Source = "ProcessExec"
    | project Timestamp, Source, DeviceName, AccountName,
              FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName;
// Branch B — file write to disk (catches drop before first run)

    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")

    | extend Source = "FileWrite"
    | project Timestamp, Source, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,

ucs.title: [LLM] Confucius lure-doc chain: Office template injection / Equation Editor spawning mshta.exe or PowerShell to fetch remote payload
ucs.description: Hunts Confucius's signature initial-access-to-execution chain: a weaponised Office document (often Pakistan/India military or diplomatic-themed) abuses remote template injection (T1221) or CVE-2017-11882 in Equation Editor (eqnedt32.exe) to spawn mshta.exe or PowerShell with an external URL, downloading the next-stage RAT (Warzone, Quasar, or Confucius's bespoke loaders). This combination of Office parent + LOLBin child + outbound HTTP is the most consistent fingerprint of G0142 across TrendMicro/Uptycs reporting (2017-2021).
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where match(cmdline,"(?i)https?:\/\/|\\\\[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\\") OR match(cmdline,"(?i)(DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|FromBase64String|-enc(?:odedcommand)?|hta:|javascript:|vbscript:)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let ScriptingChildren = dynamic(["mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChain = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptingChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|\\\\[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\\|hta:|javascript:|vbscript:|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|IEX|FromBase64String|-enc(odedcommand)?\s)"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildSHA256 = SHA256;
// Enrich with the immediate outbound connection from that child process within 2 minutes
SuspiciousChain
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort

| where isnull(NetTime) or (NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 2m))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, ParentCmd, Child, ChildCmd, ChildSHA256, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc

description: Detects the Confucius (G0142) initial-access chain where a weaponised Office document (template injection T1221 or CVE-2017-11882 via eqnedt32.exe) spawns mshta/PowerShell/wscript with an embedded remote URL or download primitive.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/21/h/confucius-uses-pegasus-spyware-related-lures-to-target-pakistani-military.html
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1221
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0142
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  selection_payload:
    CommandLine|re|i:
      - 'https?://'
      - 'hta:'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '\bIEX\b'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-enc(odedcommand)?\s'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise macros that fetch remote content (rare; should be allow-listed by hash)
  - IT-managed mshta-driven onboarding scripts launched from Office
level: high
ucs.rationale: Confucius's tradecraft is unusually consistent: TrendMicro (Feb 2018, Aug 2021) and Uptycs (Jan 2021) all document the same chain — RTF/DOCX lure exploiting CVE-2017-11882 in Microsoft Equation Editor (eqnedt32.exe) or using OOXML remote-template injection (T1221), which spawns mshta.exe / PowerShell to retrieve their second-stage loaders (sometimes Warzone or Quasar variants). ucs.title: [LLM] Confucius staged exfil: archive of user docs followed by HTTPS upload to public cloud storage by non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts the Confucius collection-and-exfiltration tail: their custom RATs (and SunBird/Hornbill on mobile-adjacent endpoints) stage data into archives, then exfiltrate to legitimate web services (T1567.002) — Mega, Dropbox, OneDrive personal, Google Drive, anonfiles, transfer.sh — to blend with normal traffic. The actor specifically prefers cloud-storage exfil over custom C2 to evade egress filtering in South Asian government networks.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as dest values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_port values(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.app IN ("ssl","http","https") AND (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("*.mega.nz","*.mega.co.nz","*.dropbox.com","*.dropboxusercontent.com","*.googleapis.com","*.anonfiles.com","*.transfer.sh","*.bashupload.com","*.gofile.io","*.pixeldrain.com","*.file.io","*.send.tresorit.com") OR All_Traffic.url IN ("*mega.nz*","*dropbox*","*anonfiles*","*transfer.sh*","*gofile.io*"))) by All_Traffic.src host All_Traffic.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | where process_name!="" AND NOT match(process_name,"(?i)(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|safari|onedrive|teams|outlook|onedrivestandaloneupdater)\.exe$") | join type=outer host process_name [| tstats `summariesonly` count as archive_count values(Filesystem.file_path) as staged_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.zip","*.rar","*.7z","*.cab","*.tar","*.gz") AND Filesystem.action="created" by Filesystem.dest host Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | rename Filesystem.dest as src] | where archive_count>=1 OR bytes_out>1048576 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CloudExfilDomains = dynamic([
    "mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz",
    "dropbox.com","content.dropboxapi.com","dl.dropboxusercontent.com",
    "anonfiles.com","bayfiles.com","transfer.sh","bashupload.com",
    "gofile.io","pixeldrain.com","file.io","send.tresorit.com",
    "upload.box.com","uguu.se","catbox.moe"
]);
let BrowserOrSyncClients = dynamic([
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","teams.exe","outlook.exe",
    "googledrivesync.exe","dropbox.exe","megasync.exe"
]);
// Step 1: archive staging on the host within the last 24h
let ArchiveStaging = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(zip|rar|7z|cab|tar|gz|tar\.gz|tgz)$"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserOrSyncClients)
    | summarize ArchiveCount = count(),
                ArchiveSamples = make_set(FileName, 5),
                FirstStaged = min(Timestamp),
                LastStaged = max(Timestamp)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountName
    | where ArchiveCount >= 1;
// Step 2: same non-browser process talks to a cloud-exfil host
let CloudUpload = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserOrSyncClients)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend MatchedDomain = tostring(extract(@"(?i)([a-z0-9-]+\.(?:mega\.(?:nz|co\.nz)|userstorage\.mega\.co\.nz|dropbox\.com|dropboxapi\.com|dropboxusercontent\.com|anonfiles\.com|bayfiles\.com|transfer\.sh|bashupload\.com|gofile\.io|pixeldrain\.com|file\.io|tresorit\.com|box\.com|uguu\.se|catbox\.moe))", 1, RemoteUrl))
    | where isnotempty(MatchedDomain)
    | summarize ConnCount = count(),
                Hosts = make_set(MatchedDomain, 5),
                FirstUpload = min(Timestamp),
                LastUpload = max(Timestamp)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
// Step 3: same process did both — that's the alert
ArchiveStaging
| join kind=inner CloudUpload on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where LastStaged < LastUpload          // staging happened before upload
| project DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          Process = InitiatingProcessFileName, ProcessHash = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          ArchiveCount, ArchiveSamples, FirstStaged, LastStaged,
          ConnCount, ExfilHosts = Hosts, FirstUpload, LastUpload,
          DwellSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastUpload, LastStaged)
| order by LastUpload desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CloudExfilHostRegex = @"(?i)([a-z0-9-]+\.(?:mega\.(?:nz|co\.nz)|dropbox\.com|dropboxapi\.com|dropboxusercontent\.com|anonfiles\.com|bayfiles\.com|transfer\.sh|bashupload\.com|gofile\.io|pixeldrain\.com|file\.io|tresorit\.com|box\.com|uguu\.se|catbox\.moe))";
let BrowserOrSyncClients = dynamic([
    "chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe",
    "onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","teams.exe","outlook.exe",
    "googledrivesync.exe","dropbox.exe","megasync.exe"
]);
let ArchiveStaging = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(zip|rar|7z|cab|tar|gz|tgz)$"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | extend ActingBin = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ActingBin !in (BrowserOrSyncClients)
    | summarize ArchiveCount = count(),
                ArchiveSamples = make_set(TargetFileName, 5),
                LastStaged = max(TimeGenerated)
                by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingBin;
let CloudUpload = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where isnotempty(Url)
    | where Url matches regex CloudExfilHostRegex
    | extend ActingBin = tolower(tostring(split(coalesce(SrcUsername, ""), "\\")[-1]))   // best-effort if process name unavailable
    | summarize ConnCount = count(),
                ExfilHost = make_set(extract(CloudExfilHostRegex, 1, Url), 5),
                LastUpload = max(TimeGenerated),
                BytesOut = sum(NetworkBytes)
                by DvcHostname, SrcUsername;
ArchiveStaging
| join kind=inner CloudUpload on DvcHostname
| where LastStaged < LastUpload
| project DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingBin,
          ArchiveCount, ArchiveSamples, LastStaged,
          ConnCount, ExfilHost, BytesOut, LastUpload,
          DwellSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastUpload, LastStaged)
| order by LastUpload desc

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Brand-Impersonation Domain Fetch Followed by User-Context Loader Within 10 Minutes
ucs.splunk:
``` Brand-impersonation domain contact + user-context loader within 10 min (joint pattern across THN/BleepingComputer/Microsoft/ESET/Cyber Security News briefings) ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS dl_time
    values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
      AND (
           All_Traffic.dest="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecode*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*anthropic-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openai-*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*huggingface-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openclaw*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*download-version.1-5-8*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecodedoc*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*macclean*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mac-storage-guide*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*csec-c2-server*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*steamhostserver*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*serverconect*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*transcloud*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*recargapopular*" OR All_Traffic.url="*.msixbundle*"
        OR All_Traffic.url="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.url="*download-version.1-5-8*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest IN (<brand_lookalike_domain_list>)
        OR All_Traffic.dest_ip IN (<c2_ip_list>)
      )
    by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| rename src AS host
| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time
        values(Processes.process_name) AS child_proc values(Processes.process) AS child_cmd
        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh")
          AND Processes.user!="*$"
        by Processes.dest Processes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
     | rename dest AS host]
| eval delta_sec = exec_time - dl_time
| where delta_sec >= 0 AND delta_sec <= 600
| table host user dl_time exec_time delta_sec dl_app dl_dest dl_url dl_ip parent_proc child_proc child_cmd child_hash
| sort - dl_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";

let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)

description: Detects archive utilities (rar/winrar/7z) spawned non-interactively by script-host or LOLBin parents with password and/or split-volume flags, matching CopyKittens (G0052) pre-exfil staging tradecraft from Operation Wilted Tulip.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0052/
  - https://www.clearskysec.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Operation_Wilted_Tulip.pdf
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.t1560.003
  - attack.g0052
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rar.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\7za.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wmiprvse.exe'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -hp'
      - ' -p'
      - ' -v'
      - ' -m5'
      - ' -ssw'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_parent and selection_flags and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Backup or DLP agents that legitimately call rar/7z from a service wrapper (whitelist by parent path / signing cert)
  - IT-driven scripted archive jobs (whitelist scheduled-task service accounts)
level: high
ucs.rationale: ClearSky's Wilted Tulip report explicitly calls out CopyKittens using RAR with password and split-volume flags, driven by their PowerShell/cmd-based implants (Matryoshka, Vminst), to chunk and password-protect staged data before exfiltration to CDN-fronted infrastructure (T1090). Hunting RAR/7z alone is too noisy; constraining the parent to script-hosts / LOLBins eliminates the IT-admin and user-d

_field_issues.message: `HasSplitFlag` is not a canonical column of DeviceProcessEvents.

_sentinel_field_issues.message: `HasSplitFlag` is not a canonical column of SecurityEvent.

_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Brand-Impersonation Domain Fetch Followed by User-Context Loader Within 10 Minutes
ucs.splunk:
``` Brand-impersonation domain contact + user-context loader within 10 min (joint pattern across THN/BleepingComputer/Microsoft/ESET/Cyber Security News briefings) ```
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS dl_time
    values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
      AND (
           All_Traffic.dest="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecode*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*anthropic-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openai-*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*huggingface-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openclaw*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*download-version.1-5-8*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecodedoc*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*macclean*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mac-storage-guide*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*csec-c2-server*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*steamhostserver*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*serverconect*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*transcloud*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*recargapopular*" OR All_Traffic.url="*.msixbundle*"
        OR All_Traffic.url="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.url="*download-version.1-5-8*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest IN (<brand_lookalike_domain_list>)
        OR All_Traffic.dest_ip IN (<c2_ip_list>)
      )
    by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| rename src AS host
| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time
        values(Processes.process_name) AS child_proc values(Processes.process) AS child_cmd
        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh")
          AND Processes.user!="*$"
        by Processes.dest Processes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
     | rename dest AS host]
| eval delta_sec = exec_time - dl_time
| where delta_sec >= 0 AND delta_sec <= 600
| table host user dl_time exec_time delta_sec dl_app dl_dest dl_url dl_ip parent_proc child_proc child_cmd child_hash
| sort - dl_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc
