ucs.title: [LLM] FIN8 Sardonic loader chain — Office macro spawns obfuscated PowerShell that invokes WMI Win32_Process for lateral execution
ucs.description: Targets FIN8's repeatable post-phishing chain: malicious Office document spawns highly-obfuscated PowerShell (heavy `^` / backtick / format-string evasion characteristic of FIN8 reported by FireEye 2017 and Symantec 2023), which then uses WMI (`Win32_Process.Create` against a remote node) to stage the Sardonic backdoor. The combination of macro→PowerShell→remote-WMI in one process tree is a FIN8 fingerprint, distinct from FIN7 (which prefers JavaScript/MSHTA) and most ransomware affiliates.

ucs.kql:
let lookback = 14d;
let office_parents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let ObfPS = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (office_parents)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | extend cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
    | where cmd matches regex @"(\^|`|\$\{[a-z]\}|-e[nc]+ |frombase64string|::(\w+)\(['\x22][a-z]{0,3}['\x22])"
       or cmd has_any ("hidden","-nop","bypass","downloadstring","iex","invoke-expression")
    | project PsTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PsPid = ProcessId, PsCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              MacroParent = InitiatingProcessFileName, MacroParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("process call create","/node:","win32_process"))
   or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Invoke-WmiMethod","Get-WmiObject","Win32_Process","-ComputerName"))
   or (FileName =~ "WmiPrvSE.exe")
| join kind=inner ObfPS on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.PsPid
| where Timestamp between (PsTime .. PsTime + 10m)
| project DeviceName, AccountName, MacroTime = PsTime,
          MacroParent, PsCmd,
          WmiTime = Timestamp, WmiBin = FileName, WmiCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by MacroTime desc

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;

let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);

let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)

          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)

ucs.title: [LLM] Ferocious Kitten (G0137) RTLO masquerade — U+202E in dropped filenames
ucs.description: Hunts for files dropped to disk whose name contains the Right-to-Left Override character (U+202E). This is a hallmark of Ferocious Kitten / MarkiRAT lures (per Kaspersky, June 2021), which abuse RTLO to render an executable as 'document_fdp.exe' visually flipping to 'document_exe.pdf' so Persian-speaking targets (activists, dissidents inside Iran) double-click what looks like a benign PDF/JPG/DOC.

| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` 
| eval rtlo_in_name=if(match(file_name, "\x{202e}"), 1, 0) 
| eval rtlo_in_path=if(match(file_path, "\x{202e}"), 1, 0) 
| where rtlo_in_name=1 OR rtlo_in_path=1 
| eval is_executable=if(match(lower(file_name), "\.(exe|scr|com|cpl|hta|js|vbs|lnk|bat|jar)$"), 1, 0) 
| where is_executable=1 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

let ExecExt = dynamic([".exe",".scr",".com",".cpl",".hta",".js",".vbs",".lnk",".bat",".jar",".ps1"]);

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,

          Dropper = InitiatingProcessFileName,

// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.

// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to

let LookbackDays = 7d;

    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",

    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")

| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)

   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"

                          1)

| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

ucs.kql:
// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ListenerPorts = make_set(ListenerPort, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, ParentPid, SHA256
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, FirstInbound)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,
          DelaySec, ListenerPorts, SrcIps, DistinctSrcIps, ParentPid, SHA256
| order by ChildTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Gallmaker DDE-borne Office macro-less execution spawning PowerShell reverse-shell tradecraft
ucs.description: Hunts Gallmaker's signature delivery chain: weaponized Office documents (geopolitical/defense lures) abusing the DDE protocol (T1559.002) instead of macros, where WINWORD/EXCEL spawn cmd.exe or powershell.exe with reverse-shell-style command lines (System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient, hidden window, encoded). This combination — DDE-as-execution + PowerShell reverse shell + Middle East defense targeting — is Gallmaker's documented tradecraft (Symantec, Oct 2018), distinct from generic macro-borne phishing.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(cmdline, "(?i)(TCPClient|System\.Net\.Sockets|GetStream|StreamReader|StreamWriter|-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?|-nop|-noni|-enc(odedcommand)?|FromBase64String|IEX|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|DownloadFile|cmd\.exe\s*/[ck])") | eval gallmaker_score = if(match(cmdline,"(?i)TCPClient|System\.Net\.Sockets"),3,0) + if(match(cmdline,"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"),1,0) + if(match(cmdline,"(?i)-enc(odedcommand)?|FromBase64String"),2,0) + if(match(cmdline,"(?i)IEX|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString"),1,0) | where gallmaker_score >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - gallmaker_score, - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Gallmaker (G0084) — Office DDE → PowerShell reverse-shell chain
let Lookback = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let ShellChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (ShellChildren)
// Gallmaker's reverse-shell PowerShell tradecraft + classic obfuscation flags
| extend cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend RevShellSig = cmd has_any ("tcpclient", "system.net.sockets", "getstream", "streamreader", "streamwriter")
| extend HiddenWin   = cmd matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| extend EncodedCmd  = cmd has_any ("-enc ", "-encodedcommand", "-ec ", "frombase64string")
| extend Downloader  = cmd has_any ("downloadstring", "downloadfile", "invoke-webrequest", "iwr ", "iex ", "invoke-expression")
| extend NoProfile   = cmd has_any ("-nop", "-noprofile", "-noni", "-noninteractive")
| extend GallmakerScore = toint(RevShellSig)*3 + toint(HiddenWin) + toint(EncodedCmd)*2 + toint(Downloader) + toint(NoProfile)
| where GallmakerScore >= 2 or RevShellSig == true   // RevShell alone is enough
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256 = SHA256,
          IsRemoteSession = InitiatingProcessTokenElevation,
          GallmakerScore, RevShellSig, HiddenWin, EncodedCmd, Downloader
| order by GallmakerScore desc, Timestamp desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Gallmaker DDE-Borne Office Spawning PowerShell Reverse-Shell Tradecraft
id: 6f9d2c1a-4b8e-4a2c-9c1d-b5a8f3d2e1a4
status: experimental
description: Detects Gallmaker (G0084) signature chain — Microsoft Office process spawning a script interpreter with command-line markers of a PowerShell reverse shell, hidden window, base64 encoding, or in-memory downloader, consistent with the DDE-protocol abuse documented by Symantec (Oct 2018).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0084/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/threat-intelligence/gallmaker-attack-group
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1559.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0084
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_revshell:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'TCPClient'
      - 'System.Net.Sockets'
      - 'GetStream'
      - 'StreamReader'
      - 'StreamWriter'
  selection_evasion:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and (selection_revshell or selection_evasion)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT scripts launched from Office add-ins (rare; should be allowlisted by parent path/SHA256)
  - Security training / red-team exercises
level: high
ucs.rationale: Gallmaker is uniquely characterized in public reporting (Symantec, Oct 2018) for forgoing custom malware and instead weaponizing Office documents that abuse the DDE protocol (T1559.002) to spawn PowerShell reverse shells against Middle Eastern defense, military, and government entities. Generic 'Office spawns PowerShell' rules over-fire on macro phishing of every flavor; this rule narrows on Gallm

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker
    | project ShellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FileName,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildHash   = SHA256,
              ChildPath   = FolderPath;
let RuntimeEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
RuntimeShells
| join kind=inner RuntimeEgress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)
| summarize EgressIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            EgressUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            FirstEgress = min(EgressTime),
            LastEgress  = max(EgressTime)
            by ShellTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildHash, ChildPath
| order by ShellTime desc

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;
let DevTools = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","node.exe","node","cargo.exe","cargo","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","python.exe","python","python3","ruby.exe","ruby","gem.exe","gem","go.exe","go"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","rubygems.org","proxy.golang.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","nodejs.org","npmmirror.com"]);
let CredPaths = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles",@"\.aws\credentials",@"\.ssh\id_",@"\.npmrc",@"\.docker\config.json",@"\.gitconfig",@".config/gh/hosts.yml"]);
let InstallSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DevTools)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","cookies.sqlite","logins.json",".aws/credentials",".ssh/id_",".npmrc")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallTime = Timestamp,
              ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildFile = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isempty(RemoteUrl) or not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeviceId, NetTime = Timestamp,
              EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FolderPath has_any (CredPaths)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe")
    | project DeviceId, FileTime = Timestamp,
              AccessProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              AccessFile = FolderPath;
InstallSpawns
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow)
| join kind=leftouter CredAccess on DeviceId
| extend CredHit = iif(isnotempty(AccessFile) and FileTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationWindow), AccessFile, "")
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, InstallTime)
| project InstallTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile, ChildFile, ChildCmd,
          NetTime, DelaySec, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, EgressProcess,
          CredHit
| summarize arg_min(InstallTime, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentFile, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by InstallTime desc

ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npx.exe","npx","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","cargo.exe","cargo"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","npmjs.com","yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.python.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","jsdelivr.net","unpkg.com","ghcr.io"]);
let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install","add "," test"," ci ","preinstall","postinstall")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallProc = FileName, InstallCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              InstallPGuid = ProcessUniqueId;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend RemoteHost = tolower(coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP))
    | where not (RemoteHost has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where not (RemoteHost endswith ".github.io")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, RemoteHost;
Installs
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, InstallTime)
| summarize FirstInstall = min(InstallTime), LastEgress = max(EgressTime),
            MinDelay = min(DelaySec), DistinctDests = dcount(RemoteHost),
            Dests = make_set(RemoteHost, 20),
            EgressInitiators = make_set(EgressInitiator, 10),
            SampleInstallCmd = any(InstallCmd), SampleEgressCmd = any(EgressCmd)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InstallProc
| where DistinctDests >= 1
| order by FirstInstall desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","python.exe","python3","pip.exe","pip3","composer","composer.phar"]);
let PkgMgrCmdHints = dynamic(["npm install","npm ci","npx ","yarn install","pnpm install","pip install","composer install","composer require","preinstall","postinstall","lifecycle"]);
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","bash.exe","sh","sh.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bun","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","repo.packagist.org","packagist.org"]);
let InstallSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents))
         or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("oven-sh/bun","releases/download","raw.githubusercontent.com","curl -s","wget -q","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage=FolderPath,
              ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc=FileName;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl !in~ (RegistryHosts)
    | where not(RemoteUrl endswith ".npmjs.org" or RemoteUrl endswith ".pypi.org" or RemoteUrl endswith "pythonhosted.org" or RemoteUrl endswith "packagist.org")
    | project EgressTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              EgressUrl=RemoteUrl, EgressIP=RemoteIP, EgressPort=RemotePort,
              EgressInitiator=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressInitiatorCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize FirstSpawn=min(SpawnTime),
            FirstEgress=min(EgressTime),
            UniqueDestHosts=dcount(EgressUrl),
            DestHosts=make_set(EgressUrl, 25),
            DestIPs=make_set(EgressIP, 25),
            EgressInitiators=make_set(EgressInitiator, 10)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentCmd, ChildProc, ChildCmd
| where UniqueDestHosts >= 1     // any non-registry public destination inside the install window
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstEgress, FirstSpawn)
| order by FirstSpawn desc

ucs.kql:
let _server_parents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","java.exe","java","javaw.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nginx.exe","nginx","xrdp","xrdp-sesman","portainer.exe","portainer","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek-tui","n8n.exe","n8n","flowise","ruby.exe","ruby","perl","go","php-fpm"]);
let _shells_lolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let _build_noise = @"(?i)(npm\s+(test|install|run|ci)|cargo\s+(test|build|run)|gradle\s|mvn\s+(install|test|package)|pip\s+install|go\s+test|jest|pytest|eslint|prettier|webpack)";
let _cradle = @"(?i)(base64\s+-d|/dev/tcp/|bash\s+-i|powershell\s+-(e|enc)|FromBase64String|IEX |Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|certutil\s+-urlcache|wget\s+http|curl\s+-s\s+http)";
let _spawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_server_parents)
    | where FileName in~ (_shells_lolbins)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where not(ProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId,
              SHA256;
let _egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionAttempt")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
_spawn
| join kind=leftouter _egress on DeviceId, $left.ChildPid == $right.NetPid
| extend EgressWithinWindow = iif(isnotnull(NetTime) and datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime) between (0 .. 300), true, false)
| extend SuspiciousCmd = ChildCmd matches regex _cradle
| where EgressWithinWindow or SuspiciousCmd
| project SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildPid, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, NetTime, EgressWithinWindow, SuspiciousCmd

ucs.title: [LLM] Group5 commodity RAT install chain — script/document parent drops EXE to AppData and self-registers Run key (njRAT / NanoCore)
ucs.description: Detects the canonical install footprint of njRAT and NanoCore — the two commodity RATs Citizen Lab tied to Group5's Syrian-opposition spearphishing campaigns. The detection ties together the spearphish-spawned dropper (script host, Office app, or installer) creating an .exe in AppData with the same binary being registered as HKCU Run/RunOnce persistence within minutes — the deterministic install pattern of both njRAT (HKCU\...\Run, AppData\Roaming) and NanoCore (HKCU\...\Run, AppData\Roaming\<GUID>\<random>.exe).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as drop_time values(Filesystem.file_path) as dropped_file values(Filesystem.file_name) as dropped_name values(Filesystem.process_name) as dropper_proc values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\*") AND Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","hh.exe","rundll32.exe") by Filesystem.dest | rename Filesystem.dest AS dest | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as reg_time values(Registry.registry_path) as reg_key values(Registry.registry_value_name) as reg_value_name values(Registry.registry_value_data) as reg_value_data values(Registry.process_name) as reg_writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.action=modified AND (Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce*") AND (Registry.registry_value_data="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\AppData\\Local\\*") AND Registry.registry_value_data="*.exe" by Registry.dest | rename Registry.dest AS dest] | eval delay_sec = reg_time - drop_time | where delay_sec >= 0 AND delay_sec <= 600 | eval persisted_path_matches_drop = if(like(reg_value_data, "%".dropped_name."%"), 1, 0) | where persisted_path_matches_drop=1 | table drop_time, reg_time, delay_sec, dest, user, dropper_proc, dropped_file, reg_key, reg_value_name, reg_value_data, reg_writer | sort - drop_time
ucs.kql:
// Group5 — njRAT / NanoCore install chain: AppData drop + same-binary Run-key persistence within 10 minutes
let lookback = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","hh.exe","rundll32.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let DroppedExe = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\")
    | where FileName endswith ".exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"          // exclude machine accounts
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DroppedFolder = FolderPath, DroppedName = FileName,
              DroppedSHA256 = SHA256,
              DropperProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropperCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let RunKeyPersist = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (@"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
                                 @"\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce")
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\")
        and RegistryValueData endswith ".exe"
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              RegInitiator    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RegInitiatorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DroppedExe
| join kind=inner RunKeyPersist on DeviceId
| where RegTime between (DropTime .. DropTime + WindowMinutes)
| where RegistryValueData has DroppedName                       // persisted value points at the just-dropped binary
| project DropTime, RegTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', RegTime, DropTime),
          DeviceName, DropperUser,
          DropperProc, DropperCmd,
          DroppedFolder, DroppedName, DroppedSHA256,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          RegInitiator, RegInitiatorCmd
| order by DropTime desc

title: HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon Exchange Webshell Drop (ProxyLogon Post-Exploit)
id: 7b21a014-e8c4-4d9f-8a3e-2f4c1b6e7c01
status: experimental
description: Detects China Chopper-class ASPX/ASHX webshells written by the Exchange IIS worker (w3wp.exe) into OWA/ECP auth or aspnet_client paths — the signature post-ProxyLogon (CVE-2021-26855 chain) artefact attributed by Microsoft to HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon.

  selection_ext:

ucs.rationale: HAFNIUM's CVE-2021-26855 ProxyLogon chain ends with an authenticated arbitrary file write via the Exchange Unified Messaging service, dropping JScript China-Chopper webshells into OWA/ECP virtual directories. Microsoft's HAFNIUM advisory enumerated these exact paths (\aspnet_client\, \FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\) and named webshells (e.g., RedirSuiteServerProxy.aspx, XsIarR.aspx, OutlookEN.aspx).

let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 10m;
let EdgePorts = dynamic([443,4443,5000,8000,8080,6443]);
let EdgeIns = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ListeningConnectionCreated")
    | where LocalPort in (EdgePorts)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project EdgeTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,
              EdgeListenProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let PostExploit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("release_agent","/sys/fs/cgroup","bash -i","sh -i","/dev/tcp/","nc -e","nc.exe -e","reverse shell","python -c","Invoke-Expression","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand"))
         or FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","python","python3","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","nc","ncat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"

EdgeIns
| join kind=inner PostExploit on DeviceName

ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker
    | project ShellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FileName,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildHash   = SHA256,
              ChildPath   = FolderPath;
let RuntimeEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
RuntimeShells
| join kind=inner RuntimeEgress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)
| summarize EgressIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            EgressUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            FirstEgress = min(EgressTime),
            LastEgress  = max(EgressTime)
            by ShellTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildHash, ChildPath
| order by ShellTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","arc.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let SystemBins = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseNdr.exe","CSFalconService.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredFileNames = dynamic(["Login Data","Login Data For Account","Cookies","Web Data","Local State","logins.json","key3.db","key4.db","cert8.db","cert9.db","signons.sqlite"]);
let CredFolderTokens = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\",@"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",@"\Opera Software\Opera Stable\",@"\Vivaldi\User Data\",@"/.config/google-chrome/",@"/.config/chromium/",@"/.mozilla/firefox/"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
        or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessId)
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredFile = FolderPath, CredName = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstFile = min(FileTime),
            FirstNet  = min(NetTime),
            DelaySec  = min(datetime_diff('second', NetTime, FileTime)),
            CredFiles = make_set(strcat(CredFile, CredName), 25),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            RemoteUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            RemotePorts = make_set(RemotePort, 25),
            EgressCount = count()
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= 600
| order by FirstFile desc

``` Stage 2: privileged cloud action from a DIFFERENT src IP within 60 min ```
| join type=inner upn
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS act_time, values(All_Changes.src) AS act_src_ip, values(All_Changes.action) AS act_name, values(All_Changes.object) AS act_obj
        from datamodel=Change
        where All_Changes.object_category IN ("user","mailbox","application","role","device")
          AND All_Changes.action IN ("created","modified","granted","added")
          AND All_Changes.result="success"
        by All_Changes.user
     | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
     | rename user AS upn]
| where act_time >= auth_time AND act_time <= auth_time + 3600
| where auth_src_ip != act_src_ip
| iplocation auth_src_ip prefix=auth_
| iplocation act_src_ip prefix=act_
| where auth_Country != act_Country OR isnull(act_Country)

ucs.kql:
// Stage 1 — EvilTokens-style: successful device-code or OAuth consent sign-in
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Lookback = 7d;
let ConsentAuth =
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
         or AuthenticationRequirement =~ "deviceCode"
         or ApplicationId !in~ ("00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000","1fec8e78-bce4-4aaf-ab1b-5451cc387264")
            and isnotempty(ResourceDisplayName)
    | project AuthTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, AuthIp = IPAddress,
              AuthCountry = Country, AuthApp = ApplicationDisplayName, SessionId,
              AuthAsn = tostring(NetworkLocationDetails);
// Stage 2 — privileged cloud action from a different IP, ≤60 min later
let PrivAct =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials.",
        "Add owner to application.",
        "Add app role assignment to service principal.",
        "Consent to application.",
        "New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule",
        "Add-MailboxPermission",
        "FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull",
        "MailItemsAccessed",
        "Update user.","Add member to role.",
        "Register device.")
    | project ActTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn = AccountDisplayName, ActIp = IPAddress,
              ActCountry = CountryCode, ActionType, ObjectName = ObjectId, RawEventData;
ConsentAuth
| join kind=inner (PrivAct) on AccountUpn
| where ActTime between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + WindowMin)
| where tostring(AuthIp) != tostring(ActIp)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ActTime, AuthTime)
| summarize ActionCount = count(),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 25),
            FirstAct = min(ActTime),
            LastAct = max(ActTime),
            DistinctActIps = dcount(ActIp),
            ActIps = make_set(ActIp, 10),
            ActCountries = make_set(ActCountry, 10)
            by AuthTime, AccountUpn, AuthIp, AuthCountry, AuthApp, SessionId
| where ActionCount >= 1   // any single sensitive action from a new IP within 60m is alert-worthy
| order by FirstAct desc

ucs.title: [LLM] HEXANE (Lyceum) RDCMan credential theft via decrypt-rdcman.ps1
ucs.description: Hunts HEXANE's signature post-exploitation step: a PowerShell script (publicly tracked as decrypt-rdcman.ps1 / Get-RDCManCreds) that locates the Remote Desktop Connection Manager settings file and DPAPI-Unprotects stored RDP credentials, fueling the group's ME/Africa lateral movement against telecoms and oil & gas.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*decrypt-rdcman*" OR Processes.process="*Get-RDCManCreds*" OR Processes.process="*Unprotect-RDCMan*" OR Processes.process="*RDCMan.settings*" OR Processes.process="*Remote Desktop Connection Manager*" OR (Processes.process="*Unprotect*" AND Processes.process="*rdcman*") OR (Processes.process="*ProtectedData*" AND Processes.process="*.rdg*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="RDCMan.settings" OR Filesystem.file_path="*Remote Desktop Connection Manager*" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.rdg") AND (Filesystem.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="pwsh.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="cmd.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="wscript.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="cscript.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="mshta.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let _rdcman_keywords = dynamic(["decrypt-rdcman","Get-RDCManCreds","Unprotect-RDCMan","RDCMan.settings","Remote Desktop Connection Manager"]);
let ScriptHits =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_rdcman_keywords)
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "Unprotect" and ProcessCommandLine has "rdcman")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "ProtectedData" and ProcessCommandLine has ".rdg")
    | extend Source = "PowerShellScript"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
let FileTouches =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "RDCMan.settings" or FileName endswith ".rdg"
             or FolderPath has @"\Microsoft\Remote Desktop Connection Manager\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("rdcman.exe","mstsc.exe")
    | extend Source = "FileAccess"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName, Source,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              ParentCmd = "",
              SHA256;
union ScriptHits, FileTouches
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: HEXANE Lyceum RDCMan Credential Theft via decrypt-rdcman.ps1
id: 7c0e1d4d-0a2c-4b22-9f1f-8d2b3a4f5e10
status: experimental
description: Detects HEXANE/Lyceum's PowerShell-based theft of stored RDP credentials from Remote Desktop Connection Manager (RDCMan.settings / .rdg files) using DPAPI Unprotect calls.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001/
  - https://www.secureworks.com/research/lyceum-takes-center-stage-in-middle-east-campaign
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/04
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g1001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_kw:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'decrypt-rdcman'
      - 'Get-RDCManCreds'
      - 'Unprotect-RDCMan'
      - 'RDCMan.settings'
      - 'Remote Desktop Connection Manager'
  selection_pair_unprotect:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Unprotect'
      - 'rdcman'
  selection_pair_dpapi:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ProtectedData'
      - '.rdg'
  condition: selection_proc and (selection_kw or selection_pair_unprotect or selection_pair_dpapi)
falsepositives:
  - Authorized red-team simulating HEXANE TTPs
  - Admins legitimately exporting RDCMan credentials (rare; document and allowlist)
level: high
ucs.rationale: decrypt-rdcman.ps1 / Get-RDCManCreds is a tool family attributed publicly to HEXANE (Secureworks, ClearSky, Kaspersky) and used after foothold to harvest jump-host RDP credentials -- the first step in their telecom/oil-&-gas lateral movement. Generic PowerShell credential-theft rules miss this because the keyword set (RDCMan.settings, Unprotect-RDCMan) is narrow and seldom seen in legitimate admin

ucs.description: Hunts HEXANE's documented password-spraying tradecraft against externally exposed Exchange/Microsoft 365 of Middle East telecom, ISP, oil & gas and aviation tenants -- using basic/legacy auth protocols (IMAP4, POP3, Exchange ActiveSync, EWS, SMTP AUTH) where MFA is not enforced, with a low per-account try-rate spread across many users from a single IP/ASN.

ucs.kql:
let lookback = 1d;
let _legacy_clients = dynamic(["Other clients","IMAP4","POP3","Exchange ActiveSync","Authenticated SMTP","Exchange Web Services","Exchange Online PowerShell"]);
let _expected_countries = dynamic(["United Kingdom","United States"]);  // tune to org footprint
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where ClientAppUsed in (_legacy_clients)
| where Application has_any ("Office 365","Exchange","Outlook","Microsoft Office","Microsoft 365")
| summarize FailedUsers   = dcountif(AccountUpn, ErrorCode != 0),
            SuccessUsers  = dcountif(AccountUpn, ErrorCode == 0),
            TotalUsers    = dcount(AccountUpn),
            FailedAttempts = countif(ErrorCode != 0),
            SuccessAttempts = countif(ErrorCode == 0),
            ErrorCodes    = make_set(ErrorCode, 10),
            Apps          = make_set(Application, 10),
            Countries     = make_set(Country, 5),
            SampleUsers   = make_set(AccountUpn, 10),
            FirstSeen     = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen      = max(Timestamp)
            by IPAddress
| where TotalUsers >= 10                              // spray fan-out, not single-user brute force
| where FailedUsers >= 10
| where FailedAttempts >= 25                          // P95 baseline = ~6 fails/IP/day
| where Countries !has_any (_expected_countries)      // origin outside org footprint
| extend SuccessfulSpray = iif(SuccessUsers >= 1, "YES - investigate compromised account(s) immediately", "no")
| order by SuccessUsers desc, TotalUsers desc

let _legacy_clients = dynamic(["Other clients","IMAP4","POP3","Exchange ActiveSync","Authenticated SMTP","Exchange Web Services","Exchange Online PowerShell"]);

            SuccessUsers    = dcountif(UserPrincipalName, ResultType == 0),
            TotalUsers      = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
            FailedAttempts  = countif(ResultType != 0),
            SuccessAttempts = countif(ResultType == 0),
            ResultTypes     = make_set(ResultType, 10),
            Apps            = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),

| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS dl_time
    values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
    where All_Traffic.action="allowed" AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="internal"
      AND (
           All_Traffic.dest="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecode*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*anthropic-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openai-*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*huggingface-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openclaw*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*download-version.1-5-8*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecodedoc*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*macclean*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mac-storage-guide*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*csec-c2-server*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*steamhostserver*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*serverconect*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*transcloud*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*recargapopular*" OR All_Traffic.url="*.msixbundle*"
        OR All_Traffic.url="*claude-pro*" OR All_Traffic.url="*download-version.1-5-8*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest IN (<brand_lookalike_domain_list>)
        OR All_Traffic.dest_ip IN (<c2_ip_list>)
      )
    by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| rename src AS host
| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time
        values(Processes.process_name) AS child_proc values(Processes.process) AS child_cmd
        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh")
          AND Processes.user!="*$"
        by Processes.dest Processes.user

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

let CorrelationWindowSec = 300;
let OfficeApps = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let StagingChildren = dynamic(["mshta.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
// Network fetches by Office processes (vendor-flexible via ASIM)
let TemplateFetches = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (OfficeApps) or tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(EventOriginalUid)))) has_any (OfficeApps)
    | where isnotempty(Url)
    | where Url matches regex @"(?i)\.(docx?|dotm?|rtf|xls[mx]?|ppt[mx]?|xml)(\?|$)"
         or Url matches regex @"(?i)(cloudme\.com|yandex|opendrive|carbonbox)"
    | project FetchTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, FetchUrl = Url, FetchIP = DstIpAddr;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ParentProcessName has_any (OfficeApps)
| where TargetProcessName has_any (StagingChildren)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner TemplateFetches on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (FetchTime .. FetchTime + CorrelationWindowSec * 1s)
| project FetchTime, ChildTime = TimeGenerated,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, FetchTime),
          DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, FetchUrl, FetchIP,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessCommandLine
| order by ChildTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Inception / Cloud Atlas LOLBin C2 to legitimate cloud-storage providers (CloudMe, Yandex Disk, OpenDrive)
ucs.description: Hunts Cloud Atlas's namesake C2 channel: PowerShower, VBShower, and the newer PowerShellRunner backdoors check in to legitimate WebDAV/cloud-storage providers (CloudMe, Yandex Disk, OpenDrive, Mail.ru cloud) over HTTPS to retrieve tasking and exfiltrate data (T1102 + T1071.001 + T1573.001). The high-fidelity pivot is a Windows scripting/LOLBin process — mshta.exe, wscript.exe, cscript.exe, powershell.exe, regsvr32.exe — making outbound HTTPS to one of these consumer cloud-storage endpoints from a corporate workstation that has no legitimate reason to use them.

let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic([
    "cloudme.com","webdav.cloudme.com",
    "yandex.net","yandex.ru","disk.yandex","webdav.yandex.ru",
    "opendrive.com",
    "cloud.mail.ru","webdav.cloud.mail.ru",
    "fex.net","carbonbox"
]);
let ScriptingBins = dynamic([
    "mshta.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","regsvr32.exe",
    "powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe"
]);
// 30-day per-host baseline of cloud-storage usage so we only alert on first-seen pairs
let Baseline = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptingBins)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
    | summarize by DeviceId, RemoteUrl;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptingBins)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on DeviceId, RemoteUrl
| summarize ConnCount = count(),
            DistinctMinutes = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1m)),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            Urls      = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| where ConnCount >= 3 or DistinctMinutes >= 2   // beacon-ish or sustained
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

ucs.title: [LLM] IndigoZebra (BoxCaon) — Dropbox API abused as C2 channel by non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts for HTTPS callbacks to Dropbox API endpoints (api.dropboxapi.com / content.dropboxapi.com / notify.dropboxapi.com) from any process other than the legitimate Dropbox client or a browser. This is the load-bearing IOC family for IndigoZebra's BoxCaon backdoor, used in the 2021 campaign against the Afghan presidential office and recurring against Central Asian foreign-affairs targets — the actor specifically chose Dropbox so that C2 traffic blends with normal cloud storage egress.

ucs.title: [LLM] Indrik Spider / Evil Corp SocGholish (FakeUpdates) — wscript.exe → PowerShell chain from browser-dropped ZIP
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Indrik Spider initial-access chain: a compromised legitimate website serves a 'browser update' ZIP (SocGholish/FakeUpdates) that contains a .js file. When the user runs it, wscript.exe executes the JS from Downloads/Temp and spawns PowerShell to pull a NetSupport RAT or Cobalt Strike beacon — Mandiant tracks this cluster as UNC1543/UNC2165 and Microsoft as DEV-0206/DEV-0243 (Manatee Tempest), Evil Corp's preferred ingress since at least 2018.

ucs.kql:
// Indrik Spider / SocGholish: browser-dropped JS executed by wscript spawns PowerShell to fetch payload
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                                 // skip machine accounts
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wscript.exe"
// JS / JSE launched out of user-writable, internet-facing directories — SocGholish drops to Downloads or %TEMP%
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (".js", ".jse")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Roaming\")
// Non-script-host child = breakout into staging / C2 retrieval
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe")
// Either obfuscated payload OR network retrieval — both characteristic of the SocGholish loader stage
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("EncodedCommand", "-enc ", " -ec ", "FromBase64String",
                                    "DownloadString", "DownloadFile", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression",
                                    "WebClient", "Net.WebRequest")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          GrandparentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ParentImage      = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd        = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage       = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd         = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256      = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Indrik Spider / SocGholish — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688 (requires command-line auditing GPO)
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType == "User" and Account !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName endswith "wscript.exe"
// SecurityEvent 4688 carries the *child* CommandLine; parent cmdline is unavailable, so we anchor on the
// distinctive child behaviour (PS/cmd/mshta with encoded/IEX payload) — Evil Corp's loader signature.
| where NewProcessName endswith "powershell.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "pwsh.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "cmd.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "mshta.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith "rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("EncodedCommand", "-enc ", " -ec ", "FromBase64String",
                              "DownloadString", "DownloadFile", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression",
                              "WebClient", "Net.WebRequest")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

// Indrik Spider WastedLocker/Hades pre-encryption fingerprint:
// takeown /R + icacls /grant + vssadmin/wmic delete shadows on the same host within 30 min
let LookbackHours = 4h;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let TakeOwn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName =~ "takeown.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "/R" or ProcessCommandLine has "/r"           // recursive — Evil Corp signature
    | summarize TakeownTime = min(Timestamp), TakeownCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId, DeviceName;
let Icacls = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "icacls.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/grant", "/T", "everyone:F", "Everyone:(F)", "/inheritance")
    | summarize IcaclsTime = min(Timestamp), IcaclsCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId;
let ShadowDelete = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"     and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy", "delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"  and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | summarize ShadowTime = min(Timestamp), ShadowCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine) by DeviceId;
TakeOwn
| join kind=inner Icacls on DeviceId
| join kind=inner ShadowDelete on DeviceId
| extend DeltaMin = max_of(
        abs(datetime_diff('minute', TakeownTime, IcaclsTime)),
        abs(datetime_diff('minute', TakeownTime, ShadowTime)),
        abs(datetime_diff('minute', IcaclsTime,  ShadowTime)))
| where DeltaMin <= toint(WindowMin / 1m)
| project DeviceName, TakeownTime, IcaclsTime, ShadowTime, DeltaMin,

ucs.title: [LLM] LAPSUS$/DEV-0537 MFA fatigue ('push bombing') culminating in successful Entra ID sign-in
ucs.description: Detects the LAPSUS$ signature initial-access pattern: an attacker armed with stolen credentials (purchased from an IAB or Redline-style stealer log) hammers a victim with repeated MFA push notifications until the user finally approves one, immediately followed by an interactive cloud sign-in from the attacker's IP. This is the exact tradecraft Microsoft (MSTIC) and Okta documented in the 2022 LAPSUS$ intrusions against Microsoft, Okta, NVIDIA and Uber.

ucs.kql:
// LAPSUS$ MFA fatigue → success — 5+ MFA denials in 30m followed by clean auth within 30m
let WindowFail = 30m;
let WindowSuccess = 30m;
let MfaErrorCodes = dynamic([500121, 50074, 50158, 50097, 50140]); // MFA denied / required / interrupted
let Bombing = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ErrorCode in (MfaErrorCodes)
    | summarize MfaDenials = count(),
                FailIPs   = make_set(IPAddress, 20),
                FailCountries = make_set(Country, 10),
                FirstFail = min(Timestamp),
                LastFail  = max(Timestamp)
              by AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, bin(Timestamp, WindowFail)
    | where MfaDenials >= 5;             // empirical bombing threshold (P99 legit user ≈ 3)
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0                      // successful sign-in
| where IsInteractive == true
| join kind=inner Bombing on AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (LastFail .. LastFail + WindowSuccess)
| extend NewIp = iif(IPAddress in (FailIPs), "reused", "new_ip"),
         FailToSuccessSec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, LastFail)
| project SuccessTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, City,
          Application, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
          MfaDenials, FailIPs, FailCountries, FirstFail, LastFail,
          FailToSuccessSec, NewIp, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by SuccessTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] LazyScripter (G0140) — open-source toolkit retrieval from GitHub raw / paste-site staging via LOLBin script interpreters
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LazyScripter staging behaviour: a Windows script-interpreter LOLBin (mshta, powershell, wscript/cscript, bitsadmin, certutil, curl, rundll32, regsvr32) calling raw.githubusercontent.com / pastebin / paste.ee / anonfiles to pull the next stage of an open-source RAT bundle (Koadic, Octopus, LuminosityLink, RMS, KOADIC, Quasar, njRat). Malwarebytes (Feb 2021) and follow-up CrowdStrike/MSFT reporting both pin GitHub-raw-hosted toolkits as the through-line for this airline-targeting actor — almost no other named cluster runs droppers that hard-code raw.githubusercontent.com URLs

let LookbackDays = 14d;
// LazyScripter (G0140) — open-source RAT staging hosts

    "raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com",
    "pastebin.com","paste.ee","anonfiles.com",
    "transfer.sh","controlc.com","cdn.discordapp.com"]);

// (1) cmdline-embedded URL — the canonical `mshta http://raw.githubusercontent.com/...` shape
let ProcessHits =

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ (_LOLBins)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_StagingHosts)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, Source = "ProcessCmd";
// (2) actual outbound socket from the LOLBin to the staging host
let NetworkHits =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_LOLBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (_StagingHosts)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              ParentCmd = "",

let LookbackDays = 14d;
