ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("lazagne.exe","laZagne.exe","firemalv.exe") OR Processes.process="*lazagne*" OR Processes.process="*LaZagne*" OR Processes.process="*FireMalv*" OR (Processes.process_name IN ("python.exe","pythonw.exe") AND Processes.process="*all*" AND (Processes.process="*browsers*" OR Processes.process="*windows*" OR Processes.process="*mails*" OR Processes.process="*wifi*" OR Processes.process="*chats*"))) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name | rename Processes.* as * | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// Leafminer (Raspite) — LaZagne / FireMalv credential dumper execution
// Tool attribution: Symantec 2018 names LaZagne and the custom FireMalv
// Firefox-cred-stealer as Leafminer's two go-to credential-collection tools.
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where
    // 1. Direct binary / cmdline tool names
    FileName has_any ("lazagne","firemalv")
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("lazagne","LaZagne","FireMalv")
    or InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("lazagne","firemalv")
    // 2. PE product-info leak (LaZagne PyInstaller builds keep "LaZagne")
    or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "LaZagne"
    or ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription has "LaZagne"
    or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName has "LaZagne"
    // 3. Python LaZagne with the canonical "all" / category subcommands
    or ( FileName in~ ("python.exe","pythonw.exe")
         and ProcessCommandLine has "all"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("browsers","windows","mails","wifi","chats","sysadmin"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ToolImage = FolderPath, ToolFile = FileName, SHA256,
          ProductName = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
          FileDesc    = ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentFile  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          IntegrityLevel = ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Leafminer (Raspite) — LaZagne / FireMalv credential dumper execution
// Requires GPO 'Include command line in process creation events' for 4688
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where AccountType == "User"
| where
    NewProcessName has_any ("lazagne","firemalv")
    or CommandLine has_any ("lazagne","LaZagne","FireMalv")
    or ParentProcessName has_any ("lazagne","firemalv")
    or ( NewProcessName endswith "\\python.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pythonw.exe" )
        and CommandLine has "all"
        and CommandLine has_any ("browsers","windows","mails","wifi","chats","sysadmin")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects execution of the public LaZagne credential dumper and Leafminer's custom FireMalv Firefox-credential-stealer, both attributed to the Iranian threat group Leafminer (Raspite, MITRE G0077) by Symantec for credential harvesting from browsers, Windows Vault, mail clients and Wi-Fi profiles.

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents

    | where AccountName !endswith "$"

let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","bun.exe","bun","composer","composer.phar","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nuget.exe","pip","pip3","pip.exe","python.exe","python","python3"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["node.exe","node","bun.exe","bun","python.exe","python","python3","php.exe","php","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","sh","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","api.nuget.org","www.nuget.org","files.pythonhosted.org","pypi.org","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","deb.debian.org","security.ubuntu.com"]);
let KnownBadIOC = dynamic(["m-kosche.com","t.m-kosche.com","git-service.com","check.git-service.com","flipboxstudio.info","sportsontheweb.net","aab.sportsontheweb.net","moika.tech","oob.moika.tech","cloudplatform-single-spa.io","t-in-one.io","filev2.getsession.org"]);
let InstallSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InstallParent    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InterpreterImage = FolderPath,
              InterpreterCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              InterpreterPid   = ProcessId,
              InterpreterName  = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend Domain = tolower(tostring(RemoteUrl))
    | where Domain !in~ (RegistryAllow)
    | where not(Domain has_any (RegistryAllow))
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              EgressPid = InitiatingProcessId,
              EgressImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, $left.InterpreterPid == $right.EgressPid
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime)
| extend IsKnownIOC = RemoteUrl has_any (KnownBadIOC)
| summarize SpawnTime = min(SpawnTime), FirstBeacon = min(NetTime),
            Domains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            IPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
            InstallParent = any(InstallParent),
            InstallCmd = any(InstallParentCmd),
            InterpCmd = any(InterpreterCmd),
            MinDelaySec = min(DelaySec),
            IocHit = max(toint(IsKnownIOC))
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InterpreterName, InterpreterPid
| extend Severity = case(IocHit == 1, "High", "Medium")
| order by SpawnTime desc

ucs.title: [WEEKLY] Post-Auth Privilege Boundary Crossing on Edge/Management Appliances (low-priv -> admin within 10m)
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method IN ("POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE") AND Web.status<400 by Web.src Web.dest Web.http_user_agent Web.uri_path Web.url _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | eval req=coalesce(url,uri_path) | eval stage=case(match(req,"(?i)(user_register|/register|onboard-customer|/peering|/auth/login|/login\.action|/api/v1/auth|/sessions/new)"),"low_priv", match(req,"(?i)(/admin|/api/admin|data(\[|%5B)access(\]|%5D)(\[|%5B)admin|data(\[|%5B)groups|/configuration|authorized_keys|/installer|/vmanage|/system/setting|/users/[0-9]+/roles)"),"admin", 1=1,"other") | where stage IN ("low_priv","admin") | sort 0 src dest http_user_agent _time | streamstats current=t window=500 time_window=10m latest(eval(if(stage="low_priv",req,null))) as lowpriv_req latest(eval(if(stage="low_priv",_time,null))) as lowpriv_ts by src dest http_user_agent | where stage="admin" AND isnotnull(lowpriv_ts) AND _time>lowpriv_ts | eval delta_sec=_time-lowpriv_ts | where delta_sec<=600 | stats min(lowpriv_ts) as firstLowPriv max(_time) as adminEventTime values(lowpriv_req) as lowpriv_paths values(req) as admin_paths max(delta_sec) as maxDeltaSec count by src dest http_user_agent | convert ctime(firstLowPriv) ctime(adminEventTime) | search NOT [| inputlookup mgmt_admin_jumphosts.csv | fields src]
ucs.kql:
// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(
    RemoteUrl has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and RemoteIP == PrevIP
| where datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=Timestamp, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime),
          DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, LowPrivUrl=PrevUrl, AdminUrl=RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by AdminEventTime desc

    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)

ucs.title: [LLM] APT40 (Leviathan/MUDCARP) web-shell follow-on recon from IIS/Exchange/Tomcat worker processes
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation hand-off characteristic of Leviathan after they weaponize edge appliances and Exchange (ProxyLogon CVE-2021-26855, Citrix NetScaler CVE-2019-19781, F5 BIG-IP CVE-2020-5902, Fortinet CVE-2018-13379 — all called out in CISA AA21-200A): a web-server worker process (w3wp.exe / UMWorkerProcess.exe / httpd / tomcat) spawns Windows recon LOLBins via a China Chopper- or Antsword-style web shell. This is the T1190 → T1505.003 → T1059 chain APT40 has run against US, AU, UK and EU defense/maritime/biomedical victims since 2017.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","nginx.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","MSExchangeMailboxAssistants.exe","MSExchangeFrontendTransport.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","schtasks.exe","reg.exe","nbtstat.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","netstat.exe","dsquery.exe","csvde.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=parent_process "(?i)(?<app_pool>w3wp\.exe.*-ap\s+\"[^\"]+\")" | eval recon_tokens=if(match(process,"(?i)(whoami|net\s+(user|group|localgroup|view|use)|ipconfig|systeminfo|tasklist|nltest|quser|arp|nbtstat|netstat\s+-an|dsquery|hostname|ping)"),1,0) | stats count min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as process_names values(process) as cmdlines sum(recon_tokens) as recon_tokens_sum by dest user parent_process_name | where recon_tokens_sum>=1 OR mvcount(process_names)>=2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT40 / Leviathan web-shell post-exploitation recon chain
// Catches China Chopper / Antsword / .NET Exchange shell hand-off after edge-appliance exploit
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WebWorkers = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","nginx.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","MSExchangeMailboxAssistants.exe","MSExchangeFrontendTransport.exe"]);
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","schtasks.exe","reg.exe","nbtstat.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","netstat.exe","dsquery.exe"]);
let Shells = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (WebWorkers)
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins) or FileName in~ (Shells)
// shell-only is noise; require recon vocabulary in the cmdline when shell is the child
| where FileName in~ (ReconBins)
   or (FileName in~ (Shells)
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("whoami","net user","net group","net localgroup","net view","net use","ipconfig /all","systeminfo","tasklist","quser","nltest","netstat -an","dsquery","hostname","reg query","schtasks /query"))
// don't filter on `AccountName !endswith "$"` — IIS app pools run as service / IUSR / NETWORK SERVICE
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage   = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage    = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd      = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildSHA256   = SHA256,
          IsRemoteSession = AdditionalFields
| summarize Hits = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            ChildBins = make_set(ChildImage, 25),
            CmdSamples = make_set(ChildCmd, 25)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage
| where Hits >= 2 or array_length(ChildBins) >= 2  // single curious whoami is benign; chain is not
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT40 / Leviathan web-shell post-exploitation recon — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WebWorkers = dynamic(["w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","nginx.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","MSExchangeMailboxAssistants.exe","MSExchangeFrontendTransport.exe"]);
let ReconBins = dynamic(["whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","arp.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","schtasks.exe","reg.exe","nbtstat.exe","hostname.exe","ping.exe","netstat.exe","dsquery.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         ChildBin  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBin in (WebWorkers)
| where ChildBin in (ReconBins)
   or (ChildBin in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
       and CommandLine has_any ("whoami","net user","net group","net localgroup","net view","net use","ipconfig /all","systeminfo","tasklist","quser","nltest","netstat -an","dsquery","hostname","reg query","schtasks /query"))
| summarize Hits = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            ChildBins = make_set(ChildBin, 25),
            CmdSamples = make_set(CommandLine, 25)
            by Computer, Account, ParentBin
| where Hits >= 2 or array_length(ChildBins) >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

title: APT40 (Leviathan) Web-Shell Recon Hand-off from IIS/Exchange/Tomcat Worker

description: Detects China Chopper / Antsword / Exchange .aspx web-shell follow-on activity attributed to APT40 (Leviathan, MUDCARP, BRONZE MOHAWK), where a web-server worker process spawns a Windows recon LOLBin or shell with discovery vocabulary.
references:

  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1087
  - attack.t1018
  - actor.apt40
  - actor.leviathan
logsource:
  category: process_creation

detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:

      - '\tasklist.exe'
      - '\quser.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\dsquery.exe'
      - '\nbtstat.exe'

      - '\arp.exe'
  selection_shell_with_recon:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'

      - 'whoami'
      - 'net user'
      - 'net group'

ucs.title: [LLM] APT40 LSASS credential theft via ProcDump / comsvcs.dll MiniDump after edge-appliance compromise
ucs.description: Targets Leviathan's documented post-foothold credential-access tradecraft: dropping ProcDump (often renamed) or invoking the built-in comsvcs.dll MiniDump export via rundll32 against lsass.exe to obtain hashes/tickets for lateral movement to maritime/defense AD assets. APT40 has been observed by Mandiant (TEMP.Periscope) and CrowdStrike (Kryptonite Panda) running this exact sequence after web-shell-mediated entry.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*lsass*" AND (Processes.process="*-ma*" OR Processes.process="*-mp*" OR Processes.process="*MiniDump*")) OR (Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs*" AND Processes.process="*#-?24*") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash Processes.original_file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval procdump_renamed=if((original_file_name IN ("procdump","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") AND NOT match(process_name,"(?i)^procdump(64)?\.exe$")),1,0) | eval lsass_dump=if(match(process,"(?i)lsass") AND match(process,"(?i)(\-ma\b|\-mp\b|MiniDump)"),1,0) | eval comsvcs_minidump=if(match(process_name,"(?i)rundll32\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)comsvcs(\.dll)?\s*,\s*#?\-?24"),1,0) | where procdump_renamed=1 OR lsass_dump=1 OR comsvcs_minidump=1 | stats count min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as process_names values(process) as cmdlines values(parent_process_name) as parents by dest user | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT40 / Leviathan LSASS credential dumping — ProcDump (incl. renamed) or comsvcs.dll MiniDump
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where
    // ProcDump targeting lsass — covers psexec-deployed and renamed variants APT40 favours
    (ProcessCommandLine has "lsass"
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any (" -ma ", " -mp ", " /ma ", " /mp ", "MiniDump"))
    // Built-in LOLBin — rundll32.exe comsvcs.dll,MiniDump <pid> <path> full
    or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
        and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"
        and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)comsvcs(\.dll)?\s*,\s*#?\-?24\b")
    // ProcDump signature even when renamed (PE original-filename leaks through)
    or (ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ ("procdump","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe")
        and FileName !in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
   or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","UMWorkerProcess.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","nginx.exe")  // KEEP if web-shell-spawned
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentName  = InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT40 LSASS credential dumping — ProcDump (incl. renamed) or comsvcs MiniDump (Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688)
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
         CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| where
    (CmdLower has "lsass"
        and (CmdLower has " -ma " or CmdLower has " -mp " or CmdLower has " /ma " or CmdLower has " /mp " or CmdLower has "minidump"))
    or (ChildBin == "rundll32.exe"
        and CmdLower has "comsvcs"
        and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)comsvcs(\.dll)?\s*,\s*#?\-?24\b")
    or ChildBin in ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe")
| where Account !endswith "$"
   or ParentBin in ("w3wp.exe","umworkerprocess.exe","httpd.exe","tomcat.exe","nginx.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ChildBin, ParentBin,
          CommandLine, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT40 (Leviathan) LSASS Memory Dump via ProcDump or comsvcs.dll MiniDump
id: f1b5e3c4-leviathan-lsass-procdump-comsvcs
status: experimental
description: Detects APT40 (Leviathan / MUDCARP / TEMP.Periscope) LSASS credential dumping using ProcDump (including renamed binaries detected via PE OriginalFileName) or the built-in comsvcs.dll MiniDump export proxied through rundll32.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-200a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065/
  - https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/four-chinese-nationals-working-ministry-state-security-charged-global-computer-intrusion
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/05
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1036.005
  - actor.apt40
  - actor.leviathan
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_procdump_lsass:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'lsass'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -ma '
      - ' -mp '
      - ' /ma '
      - ' /mp '
      - 'MiniDump'
  selection_comsvcs_minidump:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs'
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)comsvcs(\.dll)?\s*,\s*#?\-?24\b'
  selection_procdump_renamed:
    OriginalFileName:
      - 'procdump'
      - 'procdump.exe'
      - 'procdump64.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
  filter_legit_named:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
  condition: selection_procdump_lsass or selection_comsvcs_minidump or (selection_procdump_renamed and not filter_legit_named)
fields:
  - Computer
  - User
  - Image
  - OriginalFileName
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
falsepositives:
  - Authorized incident-response sweeps using Sysinternals ProcDump
  - Microsoft support engagements collecting LSASS dumps for tickets
level: high
ucs.rationale: Three signals fused into one detection: (a) any cmdline-string targeting lsass with ProcDump's -ma/-mp flags, (b) the LOLBAS-canonical rundll32 → comsvcs.dll,MiniDump (ordinal #-24) pattern, and (c) PE OriginalFileName==procdump on a binary not actually named procdump.exe — which catches the rename-evasion APT40 has been documented using. Web-worker parent (w3wp.exe / UMWorkerProcess.exe / tomcat)
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 10m;
let EdgePorts = dynamic([443,4443,5000,8000,8080,6443]);
let EdgeIns = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ListeningConnectionCreated")
    | where LocalPort in (EdgePorts)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project EdgeTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,
              EdgeListenProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let PostExploit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("release_agent","/sys/fs/cgroup","bash -i","sh -i","/dev/tcp/","nc -e","nc.exe -e","reverse shell","python -c","Invoke-Expression","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand"))
         or FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","python","python3","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","nc","ncat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project PostTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              AccountName, SHA256;
EdgeIns
| join kind=inner PostExploit on DeviceName
| where PostTs between (EdgeTs .. EdgeTs + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', PostTs, EdgeTs)
| project EdgeTs, PostTs, DelaySec, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,
          EdgeListenProcess, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256
| order by EdgeTs desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanoutWindow = 5m;
let EgressWindow = 10m;
let _tunnel_domains = dynamic(["bore.pub","trycloudflare.com","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","workers.dev","web.app","pages.dev","transfer.sh","pastebin.com","api.telegram.org","serveo.net","localtunnel.me","loca.lt","cloudfront-js.com"]);
let _allow_procs = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","keepass.exe","1password.exe","bitwarden.exe","git.exe","aws.exe","kubectl.exe","docker.exe","MsMpEng.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed","FileOpened")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allow_procs)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName)
| extend cred_cat = case(
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Login Data|Cookies|logins\.json|key4\.db|Web Data)", "browser",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(\\\.aws\\credentials|\\\.kube\\config|\\\.npmrc|\\\.pypirc|\\\.git-credentials|\\\.docker\\config|\\\.netrc|\\\.azure\\|gcloud\\|\\\.vault-token)", "devops",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)\\\.ssh\\(id_|known_hosts)", "ssh",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)Microsoft\\(Protect|Credentials|Vault|Crypto)\\", "dpapi",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(Ethereum|Exodus|Electrum|Atomic|MetaMask|nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn|keystore)", "wallet",
    FullPath matches regex @"(?i)(KeePass|1Password|Bitwarden|\.kdbx|\.opvault)", "passmgr",
    "")
| where isnotempty(cred_cat)
| summarize FanoutFirst = min(Timestamp), FanoutLast = max(Timestamp),
            CategoryCount = dcount(cred_cat),
            Categories = make_set(cred_cat),
            FilesTouched = make_set(FullPath, 100)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, FanoutWindow)
| where CategoryCount >= 3;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected","ConnectionRequest")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_tunnel_domains)
     or RemoteUrl has_any (dynamic(["<c2_domain_list>"]))
| project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          EgressProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (FanoutFirst .. FanoutLast + EgressWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EgressTime, FanoutLast)
| project FanoutFirst, FanoutLast, DeviceName,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FanoutProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          FanoutPid = InitiatingProcessId,
          CategoryCount, Categories, FilesTouched,
          EgressTime, EgressProcess, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort, DelaySec
| order by FanoutFirst desc

let WindowMin = 5m;
let RuntimeParents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","n8n","n8n.exe","flowise","flowise.exe","deepseek-tui","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek","deepseek.exe","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","portainer","portainer.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","ts-node","tsx","nodemon"]);
let ShellOrLolbin = dynamic(["sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","fish","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","id","hostname","uname"]);
let BenignDevPatterns = @"(?i)(npm\s+(install|run|test|build|ci)|yarn\s+(install|run|test|build)|pnpm\s+(install|run|test)|pip\s+install|poetry\s+install|conda\s+install|cargo\s+(build|check|fmt|clippy)|webpack|tsc\s|eslint|prettier|jest)";
let InjectionMarker = @"(?i)(https?://|/dev/tcp/|base64\s+-d|-enc(odedcommand)?\s|IEX\s|Invoke-Expression|nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|/etc/(passwd|shadow|hosts)|child_process|exec[sS]ync|spawn[sS]ync|getBuiltinModule|constructor\.constructor|;\s*(curl|wget|nc|bash|sh|python|perl)|`[^`]+`|\$\([^)]+\)|chmod\s+\+x\s+/tmp|CMD_\d+_OUTPUT=)";
let RuntimeShells = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1h)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ShellOrLolbin)
    | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex BenignDevPatterns)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex InjectionMarker
    | project ShellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FileName,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildHash   = SHA256,
              ChildPath   = FolderPath;
let RuntimeEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2h)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RuntimeParents)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EgressParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
RuntimeShells
| join kind=inner RuntimeEgress on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (ShellTime - WindowMin .. ShellTime + WindowMin)
| summarize EgressIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            EgressUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            FirstEgress = min(EgressTime),
            LastEgress  = max(EgressTime)
            by ShellTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ParentCmd, ChildImage, ChildCmd, ChildHash, ChildPath
| order by ShellTime desc

    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)

| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)

// Stage 1 — EvilTokens-style: successful device-code or OAuth consent sign-in
let WindowMin = 60m;
let Lookback = 7d;
let ConsentAuth =
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode"
         or AuthenticationRequirement =~ "deviceCode"
         or ApplicationId !in~ ("00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000","1fec8e78-bce4-4aaf-ab1b-5451cc387264")
            and isnotempty(ResourceDisplayName)
    | project AuthTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, AuthIp = IPAddress,
              AuthCountry = Country, AuthApp = ApplicationDisplayName, SessionId,
              AuthAsn = tostring(NetworkLocationDetails);
// Stage 2 — privileged cloud action from a different IP, ≤60 min later
let PrivAct =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in~ (
        "Add service principal credentials.",
        "Add owner to application.",
        "Add app role assignment to service principal.",
        "Consent to application.",
        "New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule",
        "Add-MailboxPermission",
        "FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull",
        "MailItemsAccessed",
        "Update user.","Add member to role.",
        "Register device.")
    | project ActTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn = AccountDisplayName, ActIp = IPAddress,
              ActCountry = CountryCode, ActionType, ObjectName = ObjectId, RawEventData;
ConsentAuth
| join kind=inner (PrivAct) on AccountUpn
| where ActTime between (AuthTime .. AuthTime + WindowMin)
| where tostring(AuthIp) != tostring(ActIp)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ActTime, AuthTime)
| summarize ActionCount = count(),
            Actions = make_set(ActionType, 25),
            FirstAct = min(ActTime),
            LastAct = max(ActTime),
            DistinctActIps = dcount(ActIp),
            ActIps = make_set(ActIp, 10),
            ActCountries = make_set(ActCountry, 10)
            by AuthTime, AccountUpn, AuthIp, AuthCountry, AuthApp, SessionId
| where ActionCount >= 1   // any single sensitive action from a new IP within 60m is alert-worthy
| order by FirstAct desc

    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)

let ScriptHosts   = dynamic(["cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe"]);
let SpanishLureKw = dynamic(["factura","comunicado","ministerio","ejercito","ejército","fuerza armada","denuncia","urgente","confidencial","citación","citacion","presidencia","asamblea","informe","oficio"]);
let ScriptFromOffice = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | extend ChildExe = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1])),
             ParentExe = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | where ParentExe in (OfficeLures) and ChildExe in (ScriptHosts)
    | project ScriptTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account,
              OfficeHost = ParentExe, ScriptHost = ChildExe,
              ScriptPid = NewProcessId, ScriptCmd = CommandLine;
let SchtasksByScript = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | extend ChildExe = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1])),
             ParentExe = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildExe == "schtasks.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/create","/Create","/CREATE")
    | where ParentExe in (ScriptHosts)
    | project SchtasksTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account,
              ParentPid = ProcessId, SchtasksCmd = CommandLine;
let Chain = ScriptFromOffice
    | join kind=inner SchtasksByScript on Computer, $left.ScriptPid == $right.ParentPid
    | where SchtasksTime between (ScriptTime .. ScriptTime + WindowMin);
let PhishMail = OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
    | where Operation in~ ("Deliver","MailItemsAccessed")
    | where Subject has_any (SpanishLureKw)
    | project PhishTime = TimeGenerated, Recipient = MailboxOwnerUPN,
              Subject, Sender;
Chain
| extend AccountUpn = tolower(strcat(tostring(split(Account,"\\")[-1]),"@",tostring(split(Account,"\\")[0])))
| join kind=leftouter PhishMail on $left.Account == $right.Recipient
| where isnull(PhishTime) or (SchtasksTime between (PhishTime .. PhishTime + 24h))

ucs.description: Detects the signature Medusa (Spearwing) defense-evasion playbook called out in CISA AA25-071A: a vulnerable signed kernel driver is registered as a service from a user-writable directory, immediately followed by the operator running KillAV tooling (gaze.exe, abdullah.exe, killav.exe) or PowerShell/sc.exe to terminate Defender, SentinelOne, CrowdStrike or similar EDR processes before ransomware staging.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count earliest(_time) as DriverInstallTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" AND Registry.registry_value_name="ImagePath" AND Registry.registry_value_data="*.sys*" AND (Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Users\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Temp\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\AppData\\*" OR Registry.registry_value_data="*\\Public\\*") by Registry.dest Registry.registry_key_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_name Registry.user | rename Registry.* as * | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=t count earliest(_time) as KillAVTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" AND (Processes.process_name IN ("gaze.exe","abdullah.exe","killav.exe","disabler.exe") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe") AND (Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelAgent*" OR Processes.process="*CSFalconService*" OR Processes.process="*elastic-endpoint*" OR Processes.process="*TaniumClient*" OR Processes.process="*CarbonBlack*" OR Processes.process="*SophosService*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | rename Processes.* as * ] | where KillAVTime>=DriverInstallTime AND KillAVTime<=(DriverInstallTime+1800) | convert ctime(DriverInstallTime) ctime(KillAVTime) | table DriverInstallTime KillAVTime dest user registry_key_name registry_value_data process_name process parent_process_name
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let _UserWritable = dynamic([@"\users\", @"\programdata\", @"\temp\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\public\"]);
let _MedusaKillAVTooling = dynamic(["gaze.exe","abdullah.exe","killav.exe","disabler.exe"]);
let _EdrAvProcs = dynamic(["MsMpEng","SentinelAgent","CSFalconService","elastic-endpoint","TaniumClient","CarbonBlack","SophosService","WinDefend","MDE"]);
// Stage A — kernel driver service registered with ImagePath in a user-writable folder (BYOVD prep)
let DriverInstalls = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "RegistryValueSet"
    | where RegistryKey has @"\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | extend LowerImage = tolower(RegistryValueData)
    | where LowerImage endswith ".sys" or LowerImage has ".sys"
    | where LowerImage has_any (_UserWritable)
    | project DriverInstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              ServiceKey = RegistryKey, DriverImagePath = RegistryValueData,
              Loader = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
// Stage B — KillAV tool or scripted EDR termination on the same host within 30 minutes
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ (_MedusaKillAVTooling)
   or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe")
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Stop-Service","sc stop","taskkill /im","taskkill /f","Stop-Process","net stop")
       and ProcessCommandLine has_any (_EdrAvProcs))
| join kind=inner DriverInstalls on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (DriverInstallTime .. DriverInstallTime + 30m)
| project DriverInstallTime, KillAVTime = Timestamp,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          KillAVProcess = FileName, KillAVCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ServiceKey, DriverImagePath, Loader, LoaderCmd
| order by KillAVTime desc

ucs.rationale: CISA AA25-071A (March 2025), Symantec/Broadcom and Microsoft (Spearwing) all describe Medusa's distinctive BYOVD chain: drop a vulnerable signed driver into ProgramData/Temp/Users, register it as a kernel-mode service (sc create / New-Service), then run gaze.exe or abdullah.exe (KillAV utilities the group ships with the affiliate kit) to abuse that driver and terminate AV/EDR. ucs.title: [LLM] Medusa Group rclone / MEGAcmd staged exfiltration to mega.nz before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Medusa double-extortion exfiltration step: an operator runs rclone.exe (or MEGAcmd) configured against a mega.nz remote, followed by direct egress to MEGA infrastructure from a non-browser process. CISA AA25-071A and Broadcom Spearwing reporting list rclone-to-MEGA as Medusa's preferred staging-and-exfil method prior to deploying gaze.exe and the Medusa locker.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count earliest(_time) as ExfilProcTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" AND ((Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdshell.exe","megasync.exe","mega-cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="* copy *" OR Processes.process="* sync *" OR Processes.process="* move *" OR Processes.process="*--config*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*rclone*" OR Processes.process="*megacmd*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=t count earliest(_time) as NetTime values(All_Traffic.dest) as RemoteIP from datamodel=Network_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*api.mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*userstorage.mega.co.nz") AND All_Traffic.app!="chrome" AND All_Traffic.app!="msedge" AND All_Traffic.app!="firefox" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.app | rename All_Traffic.src as dest All_Traffic.* as * ] | where NetTime>=ExfilProcTime AND NetTime<=(ExfilProcTime+3600) | convert ctime(ExfilProcTime) ctime(NetTime) | table ExfilProcTime NetTime dest user process_name cmdlines dest_host RemoteIP app
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let _MegaHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs.mega.co.nz","ufs.mega.co.nz"]);
let _MegaTooling = dynamic(["rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdshell.exe","megasync.exe","mega-cmd.exe"]);
let _Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe"]);
// Stage A — rclone/MEGAcmd process configured for MEGA target
let StagedExfilProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName in~ (_MegaTooling)
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--config"," copy "," sync "," move "," put "," login "))
        or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
            and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone","megacmd","mega.nz","mega.co.nz"))
    | project ExfilProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ExfilProc = FileName, ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// Stage B — non-browser network egress to MEGA infrastructure on same host within 1h
let MegaEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_Browsers)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (_MegaHosts)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              NetProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
StagedExfilProc
| join kind=inner MegaEgress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ExfilProcTime .. ExfilProcTime + 1h)
| project ExfilProcTime, NetTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ExfilProcTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          ExfilProc, ExfilCmd, Parent, ParentCmd,
          NetProc, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by ExfilProcTime desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Medusa Ransomware (G1051 / Spearwing) - rclone or MEGAcmd Exfiltration to MEGA Cloud
id: 6f3a1c2e-8b04-4d8f-9c1a-medusa-rclone-exfil
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects Medusa Group (CrowdStrike: Spearwing) data-exfiltration tradecraft prior to ransomware
  deployment - the operator runs rclone.exe / MEGAcmd / MEGAsync (or proxies via PowerShell/cmd)
  configured against a mega.nz remote. Documented in CISA AA25-071A (March 2025) and Broadcom
  Symantec Spearwing reporting.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa25-071a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051/
  - https://www.broadcom.com/support/security-center
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rclone:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.co.nz'
  selection_megacmd:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\megacmd.exe'
      - '\megacmdshell.exe'
      - '\megasync.exe'
      - '\mega-cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' put '
      - ' sync '
      - ' login'
      - ' cp '
      - 'mega.nz'
  selection_script_proxy:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'rclone'
      - 'megacmd'
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.co.nz'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_rclone or selection_megacmd or selection_script_proxy) and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT use of MEGA for offsite backup (rare in enterprise; allowlist by host)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.g1051
ucs.rationale: rclone-to-MEGA is repeatedly attributed to Medusa specifically across CISA AA25-071A, Broadcom/Symantec's Spearwing reporting, and Microsoft's tracking. Medusa affiliates package rclone (often dropped via SimpleHelp / ConnectWise ScreenConnect during initial access) with a pre-built mega.nz remote and stage data immediately before deploying the locker. Joining the rclone/MEGAcmd command-line stage

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);

| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(

    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)

ucs.kql:
// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ListenerPorts = make_set(ListenerPort, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, ParentPid, SHA256
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, FirstInbound)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,
          DelaySec, ListenerPorts, SrcIps, DistinctSrcIps, ParentPid, SHA256
| order by ChildTime desc

// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.
// The sender-domain root and url-domain root are extracted then
// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to
// suppress the residual newsletter / vendor-tracker noise.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LegitTrackers = dynamic(["mailchimp.com","sendgrid.net","sendgrid.com",
    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",
    "list-manage.com","createsend1.com","createsend.com","sg.actblue.com",
    "ml-attach.com","emltrk.com","amazonses.com","amazon.com","sndarsffrt.com",
    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | project Url, ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on Url
| extend UrlDomLower = tolower(UrlDomain)
| extend UrlRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| where UrlRoot != SenderRoot
   and UrlRoot !in (LegitTrackers)
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".office.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".sharepoint.com"

                          UrlRoot endswith ".ru" or UrlRoot endswith ".cn", 2,
                          1)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

// Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s.
// Far higher fidelity than "every clicked URL" — most legitimate clicks
// never spawn a non-browser child process, so the join eliminates the
// 99% of noise that makes a raw click query unactionable.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
        | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, EmailTimestamp = Timestamp
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
      ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
              Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress,
              ActionType;
// Correlate to a non-browser child process spawned within 60 seconds on
// the recipient's device.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                         "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                        "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
                        "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 60s)
| project ClickTime, ProcessTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress,

let _persist_window = 5m;
let _droppers = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","outlook.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Local\Temp\Rar", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\7z", @"\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Olk\Attachments")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Temp\")

              DropperCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DropperParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;

let _sched = DeviceProcessEvents

    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)

    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"

let CredFileNames = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc",".netrc",".env","credentials","credentials.json","id_rsa","id_ed25519",".gitconfig","config.json"]);
let CredPathFragments = dynamic([@"\.aws\credentials","/.aws/credentials",@"\.ssh\","/.ssh/",@"\.docker\config.json","/.docker/config.json",@"\.config\gh\","/.config/gh/"]);
let PkgInstallChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentName=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildName=FileName,
              ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid=ProcessId,
              ChildSha256=SHA256;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")

    | project EventTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, Pid=InitiatingProcessId,
              Kind="cred",
              Detail=strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName);

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)

ucs.title: Click on URL whose host doesn't match the sender domain
ucs.kql:
// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.
// The sender-domain root and url-domain root are extracted then
// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to
// suppress the residual newsletter / vendor-tracker noise.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LegitTrackers = dynamic(["mailchimp.com","sendgrid.net","sendgrid.com",
    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",
    "list-manage.com","createsend1.com","createsend.com","sg.actblue.com",
    "ml-attach.com","emltrk.com","amazonses.com","amazon.com","sndarsffrt.com",
    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | project Url, ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on Url
| extend UrlDomLower = tolower(UrlDomain)
| extend UrlRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| where UrlRoot != SenderRoot
   and UrlRoot !in (LegitTrackers)
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".office.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".sharepoint.com"
| extend RiskScore = case(UrlTld in (CheapTlds), 3,
                          UrlRoot endswith ".ru" or UrlRoot endswith ".cn", 2,
                          1)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

ucs.kql:
// Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s.
// Far higher fidelity than "every clicked URL" — most legitimate clicks
// never spawn a non-browser child process, so the join eliminates the
// 99% of noise that makes a raw click query unactionable.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
        | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, EmailTimestamp = Timestamp
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
      ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
              Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress,
              ActionType;
// Correlate to a non-browser child process spawned within 60 seconds on
// the recipient's device.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                         "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                        "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
                        "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 60s)
| project ClickTime, ProcessTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress,
          Subject, Url, UrlDomain, ActionType,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by ClickTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Naikon (PLA Unit 78020) Aria-body / RainyDay DLL search-order hijack via signed-binary side-load
ucs.description: Hunts Naikon's signature delivery technique: dropping a legitimately-signed Microsoft/AV/VPN executable into AppData, Temp, Public or ProgramData and using DLL search-order hijacking so the executable side-loads a malicious DLL (Aria-body, RainyDay, Nebulae) from the same folder. CrowdStrike tracks Naikon as part of the Lotus Panda/Override Panda activity cluster; Kaspersky and Bitdefender both documented this exact loader pattern across SE-Asian government and military intrusions (2015-2021).

ucs.kql:
// Naikon Aria-body / RainyDay side-load: signed exe in user-writeable path
// loads a non-system DLL from the SAME folder.
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let _user_writeable = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\"]);
let _signed_companies = dynamic(["Microsoft Corporation","Kaspersky Lab","ESET","ESET, spol. s r.o.","Symantec Corporation","VMware, Inc.","Adobe Inc.","Adobe Systems Incorporated","Avast Software","Outlook"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_user_writeable)              // dropped to a writeable path — Naikon TTP
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in~ (_signed_companies)    // legit signed loader binary
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")                         // DLL not from system
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files")
| where SHA256 != InitiatingProcessSHA256                                  // distinct file (not the exe itself)
| extend ExeDir = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| extend DllDir = tolower(FolderPath)
| where DllDir == ExeDir                                                   // DLL planted next to the exe
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          LoaderExe = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          LoaderSigner = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          LoaderSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          SideLoadedDll = FileName,
          SideLoadedSHA256 = SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

title: Naikon Aria-body / RainyDay Signed-Binary DLL Side-Load
id: a3d7f8b2-9c11-4e8f-9b6a-7c4d8e2a1f30
status: experimental
description: Detects legitimately-signed loader binaries (Microsoft, Kaspersky, ESET, Symantec, VMware, Adobe) executing from user-writeable paths and loading a non-system DLL from the same directory. This is the canonical Naikon (Lotus Panda, PLA Unit 78020) Aria-body / RainyDay / Nebulae loader pattern.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019/
  - https://securelist.com/the-naikon-apt/
  - https://www.bitdefender.com/files/News/CaseStudies/study/388/Bitdefender-PR-Whitepaper-NAIKON-creat5397-en-EN.pdf
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.t1574.001
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: image_load
detection:
  selection_path:

      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'

      - 'Adobe Inc.'
      - 'Avast Software'

fields:

  - Company
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Portable installers that legitimately ship signed binaries with bundled DLLs
  - Software updaters staging files in ProgramData
level: high
ucs.rationale: Naikon's defining tradecraft across every public report (Kaspersky 2015 'CameraShy', Bitdefender 2020 Aria-body, ESET 2022 Nebulae) is signed-binary DLL side-loading from user-writeable paths. Generic side-load detections fire on installers; pinning the parent's signer to a small list of impersonated vendors AND requiring the DLL to sit next to the exe is what makes this Naikon-specific rather tha

ucs.title: [LLM] Naikon WMIC reconnaissance burst followed by scheduled-task or WMI persistence within 30 min
ucs.description: Naikon operators repeatedly run a stereotyped WMIC discovery sequence (process list, antivirus product enumeration, OS/computersystem, NIC config, domain accounts) immediately before installing persistence via schtasks.exe or 'wmic process call create'. Catching the recon-to-persistence chain on a single host within 30 minutes — by the same actor account — is far higher fidelity than alerting on either side alone, and matches the playbook documented in the Bitdefender/ESET intrusion timelines.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as recon_time values(Processes.process) as recon_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND (Processes.process="*process list*" OR Processes.process="*process get*" OR Processes.process="*/node:*" OR Processes.process="*antivirus*" OR Processes.process="*computersystem*" OR Processes.process="*useraccount*" OR Processes.process="*ntdomain*" OR Processes.process="*nicconfig*") by host Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rename user as recon_user
| join type=inner host [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as persist_time values(Processes.process) as persist_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process="*/create*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*process*" AND Processes.process="*call*" AND Processes.process="*create*") by host Processes.user
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
    | rename user as persist_user
]
| eval delta_sec=persist_time-recon_time
| where delta_sec>=0 AND delta_sec<=1800 AND recon_user=persist_user AND NOT match(recon_user,"\\$$")
| table recon_time persist_time delta_sec host recon_user recon_cmd persist_cmd
| sort - recon_time
ucs.kql:
// Naikon recon → persistence chain: WMIC discovery cluster followed by
// schtasks /create or 'wmic process call create' on the same host
// by the same account within 30 minutes.
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let ChainWindow = 30m;
let _wmic_recon_tokens = dynamic([
    "process list","process get","/node:","antivirus","computersystem",
    "useraccount","ntdomain","nicconfig","product get","service get","os get"
]);
let WmicRecon =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_wmic_recon_tokens)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"                                 // skip machine accounts
    | summarize ReconStart = min(Timestamp),
                ReconCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
                ReconCount = count()
        by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
    | where ReconCount >= 2;                                          // require a CLUSTER, not a one-off
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("process","call","create"))
| project PersistTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          PersistBin = FileName,
          PersistCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          PersistParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          PersistParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| join kind=inner WmicRecon on DeviceId, AccountName
| where PersistTime between (ReconStart .. ReconStart + ChainWindow)
| extend DeltaSec = datetime_diff('second', PersistTime, ReconStart)
| project ReconStart, PersistTime, DeltaSec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ReconCount, ReconCmds, PersistBin, PersistCmd, PersistParent, PersistParentCmd
| order by ReconStart desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Sentinel via 4688 (requires 'Include command line in process creation events' GPO).
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let ChainWindow = 30m;
let _wmic_recon_tokens = dynamic([
    "process list","process get","/node:","antivirus","computersystem",
    "useraccount","ntdomain","nicconfig","product get","service get","os get"
]);
let WmicRecon =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (_wmic_recon_tokens)
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | summarize ReconStart = min(TimeGenerated),
                ReconCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
                ReconCount = count()
        by Computer, Account
    | where ReconCount >= 2;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
