ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureKeywords = dynamic(["telegram","tеlеgrаm","телеграм","opposit","оппозиц","kazakh","kyrgyz","tajik","uzbek","ozbek","diplomat","ministry","embassy"]);
let DelphiHints = dynamic(["Embarcadero","Borland","CodeGear"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Public\"]);
// 1. Inbound CIS / Telegram-themed executable attachment
let LureAttachments =
    EmailAttachmentInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileType in~ ("exe","scr","lnk","rar","zip","iso","img","msi","hta","doc","docx")
    | where tolower(FileName) has_any (LureKeywords)
    | project MailTime = Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
              AttachmentName = FileName, AttachmentSHA256 = SHA256;
// 2. Same hash hits disk on the recipient endpoint via mail / archive / browser
let DroppedToDisk =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe")
    | where FolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
    | join kind=inner LureAttachments on $left.SHA256 == $right.AttachmentSHA256
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DroppedFileName = FileName, DroppedFolder = FolderPath,
              DroppedSHA256 = SHA256, AttachmentName, SenderFromAddress, MailTime;
// 3. Delphi-compiled binary launches a hidden script host within 1h of the drop
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (UserWritable)
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any (DelphiHints)
   or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName has_any (DelphiHints)
   or tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) has_any (LureKeywords)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-WindowStyle Hidden","-WindowStyle 1"," /c "," /q ","-nop","-noni","-EncodedCommand","-enc ")
| join kind=inner DroppedToDisk on $left.DeviceId == $right.DeviceId
        and $left.InitiatingProcessSHA256 == $right.DroppedSHA256
| where Timestamp between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentFolder = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCompany = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          ParentProduct = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName,
          Child = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          AttachmentName, SenderFromAddress, MailTime, DropTime, DroppedSHA256
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let LureRegex = @"(?i)telegram|tеlеgrаm|телеграм|opposit|оппозиц|kazakh|kyrgyz|tajik|uzbek|ozbek|diplomat|ministry|embassy";
let DelphiHints = dynamic(["Embarcadero","Borland","CodeGear"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Downloads\", @"\Desktop\", @"\Public\"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe"]);
// Stage 1 - Telegram/CIS-themed lure landing on disk via mail/archive/browser (ASIM file event)
let LureDrops =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","explorer.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe")
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (UserWritable)
    | where TargetFileName matches regex LureRegex
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","scr","lnk","hta","msi")
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              DroppedFileName = TargetFileName, DroppedSHA256 = TargetFileSHA256;
// Stage 2 - Delphi-compiled (or Telegram-named) binary in user-writable path spawns hidden script host
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName has_any (UserWritable) or ParentProcessName matches regex LureRegex
| where (ParentProcessFileCompany has_any (DelphiHints) or ParentProcessFileDescription has_any (DelphiHints) or ParentProcessName matches regex LureRegex)
| where TargetProcessName has_any (ScriptHosts)
| where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-w(in)?(dow)?style?\s+h(idden)?"
   or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("-WindowStyle Hidden","-WindowStyle 1"," /c "," /q ","-nop","-noni","-EncodedCommand","-enc ")
| join kind=inner LureDrops on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| project SpawnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentBinary = ParentProcessName, ParentCompany = ParentProcessFileCompany,
          ChildBinary = TargetProcessName, ChildCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
          DroppedFileName, DroppedSHA256, DropTime
| order by SpawnTime desc

let KnownIcmpBins = dynamic(["ping.exe","tracert.exe","pathping.exe","system","ntoskrnl.exe"]);
let WindowsSysPaths = dynamic([@"c:\windows\system32\", @"c:\windows\syswow64\"]);

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Protocol == "Icmp"                                    // raw ICMP only
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"                              // skip LAN ping sweeps
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownIcmpBins)
| where not(tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) has_any (WindowsSysPaths))
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessFileName)
| summarize PacketCount      = count(),
            DistinctMinutes  = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1m)),
            DistinctHours    = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1h)),
            FirstSeen        = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen         = max(Timestamp),
            Hosts            = make_set(DeviceName, 50),
            DestIPs          = make_set(RemoteIP, 50),
            SampleCmd        = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            SampleSHA256     = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
            by InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where DistinctMinutes >= 5      // sustained beacon cadence — Dipsind keepalive
   and PacketCount > 20           // strip one-off ICMP probes
| order by DistinctHours desc, PacketCount desc

title: Suspicious ICMP Egress From Non-Standard Process (PLATINUM Dipsind)
id: 7d3b4f1a-9b8a-4e2c-9a4f-platinumicmpc2
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects raw ICMP traffic to public IPs from a process that is not a known
  ping/trace utility — characteristic of the PLATINUM (G0068) Dipsind/JPIN
  backdoor families which use ICMP for C2 to evade web-proxy inspection.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2016/04/26/digging-deep-for-platinum/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1095
  - attack.g0068
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Protocol: 'icmp'
    DestinationIsIpv4: true
  filter_known_bins:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\ping.exe'
      - '\tracert.exe'
      - '\pathping.exe'
  filter_system_paths:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
  filter_private_dest:
    DestinationIp|startswith:
      - '10.'
      - '192.168.'
      - '172.16.'
      - '127.'
      - '169.254.'
  condition: selection and not (filter_known_bins or filter_system_paths or filter_private_dest)
falsepositives:
  - Custom monitoring agents that perform ICMP probes
  - Network management software running outside System32
level: high
ucs.rationale: ICMP-based C2 is rare across all APTs but is a documented signature behaviour of PLATINUM's bespoke Dipsind backdoor (Microsoft DCU/MMPC report April 2016). Almost no legitimate Windows process besides ping/tracert and the kernel emits raw ICMP — the combination of (a) public-IP destination, (b) non-LOLBIN initiator, and (c) sustained cadence (≥5 distinct minutes) excludes troubleshooting use. ucs.kql:
// PLATINUM (G0068) — Office spearphish → masqueraded helper → LSASS access chain
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ChainWindow  = 30m;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wordpad.exe"]);
let UserDropPaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\users\public\", @"\windows\temp\"]);
// Stage 1 — Office spawns a non-Office binary from a user-writable dir (T1204.002 + T1036)
let Stage1 =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where tolower(FolderPath) has_any (UserDropPaths)
    | where FileName !in~ ("splwow64.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
    | where not(tolower(FolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files")
    | project StageOneTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              LureParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              LureParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropName = FileName, DropPath = FolderPath,
              DropSHA256 = SHA256, DropCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              DropProcessId = ProcessId;
// Stage 2 — credential access against LSASS within 30m on the same device (T1003.001)
let Stage2 =
    union
    ( DeviceProcessEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump")
            or (ProcessCommandLine has "lsass" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","procdump","-ma "))
            or FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe")
        | project Stage2Time = Timestamp, DeviceId, Stage2Cmd = ProcessCommandLine, Stage2File = FileName ),
    ( DeviceEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where ActionType in ("OpenProcessApiCall","ReadProcessMemoryApiCall")
        | where FileName =~ "lsass.exe" or AdditionalFields has "lsass.exe"
        | project Stage2Time = Timestamp, DeviceId,
                  Stage2Cmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
                  Stage2File = InitiatingProcessFileName );
Stage1
| join kind=inner Stage2 on DeviceId
| where Stage2Time between (StageOneTime .. StageOneTime + ChainWindow)
| project StageOneTime, Stage2Time,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Stage2Time, StageOneTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          LureParent, LureParentCmd,
          DropName, DropPath, DropSHA256, DropCmd,
          Stage2File, Stage2Cmd
| order by StageOneTime desc

    | project StageOneTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account,

// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(
    RemoteUrl has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and RemoteIP == PrevIP
| where datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=Timestamp, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime),
          DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, LowPrivUrl=PrevUrl, AdminUrl=RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by AdminEventTime desc

ucs.kql:
// POLONIUM CreepyDrive/CreepyBox: PowerShell talking REST to OneDrive/Dropbox/Mega APIs
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["graph.microsoft.com","api.onedrive.com","onedrive.live.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","api-content.dropbox.com","g.api.mega.co.nz","eu.api.mega.co.nz"]);
let CloudC2Tokens = dynamic(["graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive","api.onedrive.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","g.api.mega.co.nz"]);
// 1. PowerShell command lines that embed cloud-storage REST endpoints + auth (CreepyDrive/CreepyBox shape)
let SuspectProc =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","powershell_ise.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudC2Tokens)
       or (ProcessCommandLine has "Invoke-RestMethod" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Bearer ","Authorization","access_token"))
       or (ProcessCommandLine has "Invoke-WebRequest" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Bearer ","OneDrive","Dropbox","sharedAccessSignature"))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountUpn,
              ProcessId, ProcessCommandLine,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
// 2. Confirm the same host actually beaconed to the cloud API (kills LOLscript false positives)
let ConfirmNet =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","powershell_ise.exe")
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
           or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              NetProcessId = InitiatingProcessId;
SuspectProc
| join kind=inner ConfirmNet on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 30m)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(NetTime),
            BeaconCount = count(),
            DistinctMinutes = dcount(bin(NetTime, 1m)),
            CloudHosts = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parent = any(Parent)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
| where BeaconCount >= 5 and DistinctMinutes >= 3   // sustained pattern, not one-off
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindow = 5m;     // empirical: legitimate post-install fetches usually complete in <5m, beyond that the parent/child PID linkage gets noisy
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.cmd","npx.cmd","yarn.cmd","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash.exe","wsl.exe"]);
let EdgeDomains = dynamic([".workers.dev",".trycloudflare.com",".supabase.co",".pages.dev",".web.app",".r2.dev",".vercel.app",".replit.app",".glitch.me",".onrender.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.githubusercontent.com","bitbucket.org/raw"]);
let InstallHints = dynamic(["preinstall","postinstall","install.js","setup.py","pip install","npm install","yarn add","gem install","cargo install"]);
let ProcStart = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ScriptHost  = FileName,
              ScriptCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
              ProcSHA256  = SHA256,
              ProcId      = ProcessId,
              IsRemoteSession = IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (EdgeDomains)
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              EgressProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EgressProcId = InitiatingProcessId;
ProcStart
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, $left.ProcId == $right.EgressProcId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| extend InstallContext = iff(ParentCmd has_any (InstallHints) or ScriptCmd has_any (InstallHints), "install-hook", "runtime")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastSeen = max(NetTime), HitCount = count(),
            DistinctDomains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            SampleScriptCmd = any(ScriptCmd),
            SampleParentCmd = any(ParentCmd),
            arg_min(DelaySec, *)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, ScriptHost, InstallContext
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.title: [LLM] PROMETHIUM/StrongPity trojanized-installer → masqueraded service drop chain
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical StrongPity intrusion: a victim runs what looks like a legitimate installer (Notepad++, WinRAR, 7-Zip, CCleaner, FireFox, VPN client, IDE tooling) downloaded from an attacker-controlled watering hole, the installer side-loads a secondary PE into a user-writable directory (%AppData%, %ProgramData%, %Public%) and registers it as a Windows service for persistence. PROMETHIUM has used this exact T1189 → T1204.002 → T1543.003 chain for a decade against Turkish/Kurdish targets, with code-signed droppers (T1587.002/T1553.002) carrying real software bundled with the implant.

| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as install_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("npp.*Installer.exe","notepad++*.exe","winrar*.exe","7z*.exe","CCleaner*.exe","Firefox*Setup*.exe","VPNSetup*.exe","setup.exe","install.exe") OR Processes.parent_process IN ("*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id _time
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| rename parent_process_id as installer_pid
| join type=inner dest installer_pid [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Services where Services.action=created AND (Services.service_path_name IN ("*\\AppData\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\Temp\\*") OR NOT Services.service_path_name IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*","C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*","C:\\Program Files\\*","C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*")) by Services.dest Services.service_name Services.service_path_name Services.process_id _time

// PROMETHIUM / StrongPity — trojanized installer drops masqueraded service binary
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 600;            // 10-min correlation: installer → service install
let InstallerNamePatterns = dynamic(["npp","notepad++","winrar","7z","7-zip","ccleaner","firefox","setup","install","vpn","truecrypt","veracrypt","putty","wireshark","teamviewer","anydesk"]);
let UserWritablePaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\Temp\"]);
let Installers =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\")
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\")
    | where FileName has_any (InstallerNamePatterns)
    | project InstallerTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              InstallerName = FileName, InstallerPath = FolderPath,
              InstallerCmd = ProcessCommandLine, InstallerSHA256 = SHA256;
// Service installation event (ETW: services.exe ServiceInstalled / 7045-equivalent)
let ServiceInstalls =
    DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("ServiceInstalled","PowerShellCommand")
    | where ActionType == "ServiceInstalled"
         or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "sc.exe" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "create")
    | extend ImagePath = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).ServiceImagePath),
             SvcName   = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).ServiceName)
    | where isnotempty(ImagePath)
    | where ImagePath has_any (UserWritablePaths)
         or not(ImagePath startswith @"C:\Windows\System32\")
            and not(ImagePath startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64\")
            and not(ImagePath startswith @"C:\Program Files\")
            and not(ImagePath startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\")
    | project SvcInstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, SvcName, ImagePath,
              SvcInstaller = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SvcInstallerPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              SvcInstallerCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;

| join kind=inner ServiceInstalls on DeviceId
| where SvcInstallTime between (InstallerTime .. InstallerTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SvcInstallTime, InstallerTime)
| project InstallerTime, SvcInstallTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,

          SvcName, ImagePath, SvcInstaller
| order by InstallerTime desc

ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count as exec_count, values(Processes.process) as commands, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=net.exe OR Processes.process_name=net1.exe) AND NOT (Processes.user IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") OR Processes.user="*$") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval cmd_blob=lower(mvjoin(commands,"||")) | eval has_user=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+user"),1,0) | eval has_group=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+group"),1,0) | eval has_localgroup=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+localgroup"),1,0) | eval has_view=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+view"),1,0) | eval has_session=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+session"),1,0) | eval has_share=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+share"),1,0) | eval has_accounts=if(match(cmd_blob,"\bnet1?\.exe\s+accounts"),1,0) | eval has_priv_target=if(match(cmd_blob,"domain admins|enterprise admins|administrators"),1,0) | eval distinct_subcmds=has_user+has_group+has_localgroup+has_view+has_session+has_share+has_accounts | where distinct_subcmds>=4 AND (last_seen-first_seen)<300 | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// Poseidon Group IGT recon burst — chained net.exe enumeration in <5min window
let WindowMin = 5m;
let MinDistinctSubcommands = 4;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"           // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe")
| extend SubCmd = tolower(extract(@"(?i)\bnet1?\.exe\s+(\w+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine))
| where SubCmd in ("user","group","localgroup","view","session","share","accounts","start")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("domain admins","enterprise admins","administrators")
| summarize
    ExecCount         = count(),
    DistinctSubCmds   = dcount(SubCmd),
    SubCmds           = make_set(SubCmd),
    SampleCmds        = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    Parent            = any(InitiatingProcessFileName),
    ParentCmd         = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
    HitsPrivKeywords  = countif(ProcessCommandLine has_any ("domain admins","enterprise admins","administrators")),
    FirstSeen         = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen          = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where DistinctSubCmds >= MinDistinctSubcommands       // IGT touches user+group+view+session+...
| where datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen) < 300
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, ExecCount, DistinctSubCmds, SubCmds, HitsPrivKeywords, Parent, ParentCmd, SampleCmds
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Poseidon Group IGT recon burst — Sentinel via 4688 process create
let WindowMin = 5m;
let MinDistinctSubcommands = 4;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688                                  // process-create (requires CL audit)
| where AccountType == "User"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\net1.exe"
| extend SubCmd = tolower(extract(@"(?i)\bnet1?\.exe\s+(\w+)", 1, CommandLine))
| where SubCmd in ("user","group","localgroup","view","session","share","accounts","start")
   or CommandLine has_any ("domain admins","enterprise admins","administrators")
| summarize
    ExecCount         = count(),
    DistinctSubCmds   = dcount(SubCmd),
    SubCmds           = make_set(SubCmd),
    SampleCmds        = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
    Parent            = any(ParentProcessName),
    HitsPrivKeywords  = countif(CommandLine has_any ("domain admins","enterprise admins","administrators")),
    FirstSeen         = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen          = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where DistinctSubCmds >= MinDistinctSubcommands
| where datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen) < 300
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Computer, Account, ExecCount, DistinctSubCmds, SubCmds, HitsPrivKeywords, Parent, SampleCmds
| order by LastSeen desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Poseidon Group masqueraded service binary spawning shell (T1036.005 + T1059.001)
ucs.description: Hunts Poseidon's habit of dropping implants under the file names of legitimate Windows service binaries (svchost.exe, lsass.exe, services.exe, etc.) but in non-system folders, then using them to spawn PowerShell/cmd/net for follow-on activity — this name-collision-in-wrong-path pattern was a recurring artefact across the Poseidon Group toolset (G0033) per the Kaspersky writeup.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count, values(Processes.process) as child_cmd, values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("svchost.exe","lsass.exe","services.exe","winlogon.exe","csrss.exe","spoolsv.exe","wininit.exe","smss.exe","taskhostw.exe") AND NOT (Processes.parent_process_path LIKE "C:\\Windows\\System32\\%" OR Processes.parent_process_path LIKE "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\%" OR Processes.parent_process_path LIKE "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\%" OR Processes.parent_process_path LIKE "C:\\Windows\\servicing\\%") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// Poseidon Group — system-binary name in non-system path spawning shell/lolbin
let SystemBinNames = dynamic(["svchost.exe","lsass.exe","services.exe","winlogon.exe","csrss.exe","spoolsv.exe","wininit.exe","smss.exe","taskhostw.exe"]);
let ShellChildren  = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let LegitParentRoots = dynamic([@"c:\windows\system32\", @"c:\windows\syswow64\", @"c:\windows\winsxs\", @"c:\windows\servicing\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SystemBinNames)
| extend ParentPathLower = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| where not (ParentPathLower has_any (LegitParentRoots))    // masqueraded — name matches but path doesn't
| where FileName in~ (ShellChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          MasqueradedParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          MasqueradedParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentSHA256          = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          ParentCmd             = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildName             = FileName,
          ChildCmd              = ProcessCommandLine,
          IsRemoteSession       = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession)
| order by Timestamp desc

// Poseidon Group — masqueraded system-binary spawning shell (Sentinel 4688)
let SystemBinNames   = dynamic(["svchost.exe","lsass.exe","services.exe","winlogon.exe","csrss.exe","spoolsv.exe","wininit.exe","smss.exe","taskhostw.exe"]);
let ShellChildren    = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let LegitParentRoots = dynamic([@"c:\windows\system32\", @"c:\windows\syswow64\", @"c:\windows\winsxs\", @"c:\windows\servicing\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where Account !endswith "$"
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName), ChildLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| extend ParentBase = tostring(split(ParentLower, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildBase  = tostring(split(ChildLower,  "\\")[-1])
| where ParentBase in (SystemBinNames)
| where not (ParentLower has_any (LegitParentRoots))
| where ChildBase in (ShellChildren)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account,
          MasqueradedParentPath = ParentProcessName,
          MasqueradedParentName = ParentBase,
          ChildName             = ChildBase,
          ChildCmd              = CommandLine,
          TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Poseidon Group - System Binary Masquerading Spawning Shell
id: 7a3e2c1b-9f4d-4a8e-b6c3-1d2e5f8a9c0b
status: experimental
description: Detects a process named like a critical Windows system binary executing from outside standard system folders and spawning a script interpreter or LOLBin. Aligns with Poseidon Group (G0033) tradecraft of dropping implants under svchost/lsass/services names in user/temp paths.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0033/
  - https://securelist.com/poseidon-group-a-targeted-attack-boutique/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0033
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent_name:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\svchost.exe'
      - '\lsass.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
      - '\winlogon.exe'
      - '\csrss.exe'
      - '\spoolsv.exe'
      - '\wininit.exe'
      - '\smss.exe'
      - '\taskhostw.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  filter_legit_parent_path:
    ParentImage|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
      - 'C:\Windows\servicing\'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent_name and selection_child and not filter_legit_parent_path and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Third-party software shipping helper binaries with reused system names (rare; whitelist by ParentImage path + signer)
level: high
ucs.rationale: T1036.005 alone is a generic technique, but Poseidon Group is one of the few documented APTs that consistently named its dropped binaries after core Windows service hosts (svchost/lsass/services) and stored them under user-writable paths — a habit Kaspersky highlighted as a fingerprint of the toolset.     values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url
    from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic

        OR All_Traffic.dest="*macclean*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mac-storage-guide*"

| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time

        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh")

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
// Phishing-link click that drives endpoint execution within 60s.
// Far higher fidelity than "every clicked URL" — most legitimate clicks
// never spawn a non-browser child process, so the join eliminates the
// 99% of noise that makes a raw click query unactionable.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspectClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | join kind=inner (
        EmailEvents
        | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
        | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
        | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
        | project NetworkMessageId, Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain,
                  RecipientEmailAddress, EmailTimestamp = Timestamp
      ) on NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter (
        EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
      ) on NetworkMessageId, Url
    | project ClickTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Url, UrlDomain,
              Subject, SenderFromAddress, SenderFromDomain, RecipientEmailAddress,
              ActionType;
// Correlate to a non-browser child process spawned within 60 seconds on
// the recipient's device.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe",
                                         "outlook.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe",
                        "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe",
                        "bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe")
| join kind=inner SuspectClicks on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 60s)
| project ClickTime, ProcessTime = Timestamp,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, ClickTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress,
          Subject, Url, UrlDomain, ActionType,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by ClickTime desc

ucs.kql:
// RTM .bit dead-drop C2 — Namecoin TLD or known public bit→IP resolver hosts
let _bit_resolver_hosts = dynamic([".bit.nu", ".bit.dnshome.de", ".bit.opennic.glue", "namecha.in", "namecoin.id", ".d.namecoin.webbtc.com"]);
let _allowed_browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(^|\.)[a-z0-9-]+\.bit($|[/:?])"
         or RemoteUrl has_any (_bit_resolver_hosts)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allowed_browsers)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let DnsHits = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | extend Q = tolower(tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).QueryName))
    | where Q endswith ".bit" or Q has_any (_bit_resolver_hosts)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_allowed_browsers)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteUrl = Q, RemoteIP = "", RemotePort = int(null),
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256 = tostring(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
union isfuzzy=true NetHits, DnsHits
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            HitCount = count(),
            Resolvers = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            Cmds      = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 10)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Rancor (Unit42) Office-doc → msiexec.exe remote-MSI fetch (DDKONG/PLAINTEE installer chain)
ucs.description: Hunts Rancor's signature delivery chain: a politically-themed Office document spawns msiexec.exe with an HTTP/HTTPS URL argument to pull a remote MSI installer (DDKONG / PLAINTEE / KHRAT loaders). This abuses the trusted, signed msiexec binary as a proxy executor (T1218.007) immediately after macro-driven user execution (T1204.002) and is the most consistent observable across Unit42-tracked Rancor campaigns against SE Asian government/diplomatic targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") Processes.process_name="msiexec.exe" (Processes.process="*http://*" OR Processes.process="*https://*") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.dest Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename firstTime as firstTime_p lastTime as lastTime_p | join type=outer host [| tstats summariesonly=true values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ip values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_dest from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app="msiexec.exe" OR All_Traffic.process_name="msiexec.exe" by host] | convert ctime(firstTime_p) ctime(lastTime_p) | sort - count
ucs.kql:
// Rancor — Office app spawning msiexec.exe to fetch a remote MSI (DDKONG/PLAINTEE delivery chain)
let Lookback = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe"]);
let RemoteMsi =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"                                  // exclude machine accounts
    | where FileName =~ "msiexec.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)               // chain anchor: Office/script host parent
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://")          // remote-fetch flag — Rancor signature
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s/(i|q|quiet|qn|package)\b" // /i, /q, /qn install switches
    | extend RemoteUrl = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[^\s\"']+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              MsiCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteUrl;
// Confirm msiexec actually went out to the internet (kills test/dev FPs)
RemoteMsi
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "msiexec.exe"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl_Net = RemoteUrl
  ) on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, ParentCmd, MsiCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl_Net, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc

title: Rancor Office-Doc Msiexec Remote MSI Fetch
id: a4c1b2e6-9f1a-4f67-8c1d-rancor-msiexec-01
status: experimental
description: Detects msiexec.exe spawned by Office or script host with an HTTP(S) URL argument — Rancor's DDKONG/PLAINTEE installer chain (Unit42, June 2018)
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42-rancor-targeted-attacks-south-east-asia-using-plaintee-ddkong-malware-families/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1218.007
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.g0075
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\msiexec.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
  selection_install_flag:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s/(i|q|quiet|qn|package)\b'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise software deployment via Office-launched setup links (rare)
level: high
ucs.rationale: Rancor (Unit42 G0075) is one of the few SE-Asia-focused crews that consistently chains macro-driven Office docs to msiexec.exe pulling a remote MSI as the staging step for DDKONG and PLAINTEE. The combo of (1) Office/script-host parent + (2) msiexec child + (3) HTTP(S) URL in cmdline + (4) install switches is essentially a Rancor fingerprint — generic ransomware/loader crews overwhelmingly prefer

ucs.title: [LLM] Rancor WMI event-consumer persistence following Office macro execution (PLAINTEE/DDKONG persistence)
ucs.description: Hunts Rancor's persistence step: shortly after a politically-themed Office document executes, a WMI permanent event subscription (__EventFilter / CommandLineEventConsumer / FilterToConsumerBinding) is created — the persistence mechanism observed for PLAINTEE and DDKONG implants. Pairs T1546.003 with the actor's known T1566.001→T1204.002 entry to lift it above generic WMI-persistence noise.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("wmic.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","schtasks.exe") (Processes.process="*__EventFilter*" OR Processes.process="*CommandLineEventConsumer*" OR Processes.process="*FilterToConsumerBinding*" OR Processes.process="*ActiveScriptEventConsumer*" OR (Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process="*/create*"))) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true earliest(_time) as office_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe") by host Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where firstTime - office_time < 600 AND firstTime - office_time > 0 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ctime(office_time) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Rancor — WMI event-subscription / scheduled-task persistence within 10 min of Office macro execution
let Lookback = 14d;
let PersistWindow = 10m;
let OfficeProc =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project OfficeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, OfficeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName, OfficeChild = FileName;
let PersistAct =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("__EventFilter","CommandLineEventConsumer","ActiveScriptEventConsumer","FilterToConsumerBinding","/NAMESPACE:\\\\root\\subscription"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("__EventFilter","CommandLineEventConsumer","Set-WmiInstance","Register-WmiEvent","root\\subscription"))
         or (FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PersistTool = FileName, PersistCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              PersistParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
PersistAct
| join kind=inner OfficeProc on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (OfficeTime .. OfficeTime + PersistWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, OfficeTime)
| project OfficeTime, PersistTime = Timestamp, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          OfficeParent, OfficeChild, PersistTool, PersistCmd, PersistParent
| order by PersistTime desc

| where Account !endswith "$"
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("__EventFilter","CommandLineEventConsumer","ActiveScriptEventConsumer","FilterToConsumerBinding","root\\subscription"))
     or (NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\p(ower)?sh(ell)?(\.exe)?$" and CommandLine has_any ("Set-WmiInstance","Register-WmiEvent","__EventFilter","root\\subscription"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\schtasks.exe" and CommandLine has "/create")

ucs.rationale: Rancor's PLAINTEE / DDKONG implants are documented (Unit42, 2018) using WMI permanent event subscriptions and scheduled tasks for persistence — both rare on user endpoints. Generic WMI-subscription detections drown in legitimate management agents (SCCM, Tanium); requiring an Office-app-spawned ancestor within 10 minutes anchors the hit to the actor's macro-borne entry vector and turns a noisy hunt

    values(All_Traffic.dest) AS dl_dest values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) AS dl_ip values(All_Traffic.app) AS dl_app values(All_Traffic.url) AS dl_url

        OR All_Traffic.dest="*huggingface-*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*openclaw*"
        OR All_Traffic.dest="*download-version.1-5-8*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*claudecodedoc*"

        OR All_Traffic.dest="*serverconect*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*transcloud*"

    by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| rename src AS host
| join type=inner host
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) AS exec_time

        values(Processes.parent_process_name) AS parent_proc values(Processes.process_hash) AS child_hash

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let _impersonation_regex = @"(?i)(claude\-pro|claudecode|claudecodedoc|anthropic\-[a-z0-9]|openai\-[a-z0-9]|huggingface\-[a-z0-9]|openvsx\-[a-z0-9]|openclaw|cursor\-[a-z0-9]|gemini\-[a-z0-9]|copilot\-[a-z0-9]|claude\.msixbundle|download\-version\.1\-5\-8|macclean|mac\-storage\-guide|cleanmymacos|recargapopular|csec\-c2\-server|steamhostserver|serverconect|transcloud)";
let _suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","cmd.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","msiexec.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","osascript","bash","sh"]);
let _user_facing_parents = dynamic(["msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","arc.exe","opera.exe","Code.exe","cursor.exe","explorer.exe","RuntimeBroker.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","Terminal","iTerm2","Safari"]);
let Downloads = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where RemoteUrl matches regex _impersonation_regex
         or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl)["Host"]) matches regex _impersonation_regex
    | project DlTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DlUrl = RemoteUrl, DlIp = RemoteIP, DlPort = RemotePort,
              DlInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DlAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(FileName) in (_suspicious_children)
   and InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_user_facing_parents)
| project ExecTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildHash = SHA256
| join kind=inner Downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DlTime .. DlTime + WindowMin)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ExecTime, DlTime)
| project DlTime, ExecTime, DelaySec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DlUrl, DlIp, DlInitiator, ParentProc, ChildProc, ChildCmd, ChildHash
| order by DlTime desc

ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgr = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","pnpm.exe","pnpm","yarn.exe","yarn","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","nuget.exe","dotnet.exe","code.exe","cursor.exe"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3.exe","python3","pwsh.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","dash","curl.exe","wget.exe","cmd.exe"]);

let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," add ","restore","--install-extension"," ci ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Egress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ScriptHosts)

    | extend HostOnly = tolower(tostring(split(RemoteUrl, "/")[0]))
    | where not(HostOnly in~ (RegistryAllow))
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".npmjs.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pypi.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".pythonhosted.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".yarnpkg.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".nuget.org")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".visualstudio.com")
         and not(HostOnly endswith ".github.com")

ucs.title: Click on URL whose host doesn't match the sender domain
ucs.kql:
// Click on inbound-email URL where url-domain != sender-domain.
// The sender-domain root and url-domain root are extracted then
// compared; a mismatch on a cheap-TLD url-domain is the high-signal
// case. Tune the legit-marketer allowlist to your environment to
// suppress the residual newsletter / vendor-tracker noise.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let LegitTrackers = dynamic(["mailchimp.com","sendgrid.net","sendgrid.com",
    "constantcontact.com","hubspotlinks.com","hubspot.com","mktoresp.com",
    "marketo.com","pardot.com","exacttarget.com","klaviyomail.com",
    "list-manage.com","createsend1.com","createsend.com","sg.actblue.com",
    "ml-attach.com","emltrk.com","amazonses.com","amazon.com","sndarsffrt.com",
    "salesforce.com","force.com","docusign.net","echosign.com",
    "office365.com","microsoft.com","onmicrosoft.com","linkedin.com",
    "github.com","githubusercontent.com","atlassian.net","jira.com"]);
let CheapTlds = dynamic(["sbs","life","top","icu","cyou","gdn","click","loan",
    "rest","monster","work","cn","ru","tk","ml","cf","ga"]);
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where DeliveryAction == "Delivered" and EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend SenderRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, tolower(SenderFromDomain))
| join kind=inner (
    EmailUrlInfo | project NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| join kind=inner (
    UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | project Url, ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress
  ) on Url
| extend UrlDomLower = tolower(UrlDomain)
| extend UrlRoot = extract(@"([^.]+\.[a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| extend UrlTld = extract(@"\.([a-zA-Z]+)$", 1, UrlDomLower)
| where UrlRoot != SenderRoot
   and UrlRoot !in (LegitTrackers)
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".microsoft.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".office.com"
   and UrlDomLower !endswith ".sharepoint.com"
| extend RiskScore = case(UrlTld in (CheapTlds), 3,
                          UrlRoot endswith ".ru" or UrlRoot endswith ".cn", 2,
                          1)
| where RiskScore >= 2
| project ClickTimestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, RecipientEmailAddress,
          SenderFromAddress, SenderRoot, UrlDomain, UrlRoot, UrlTld,
          RiskScore, Subject, Url
| order by RiskScore desc, ClickTimestamp desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Rocke (Iron) — Linux cloud-agent uninstall preceding XMRig/Kinsing miner launch
ucs.description: Hunts Rocke's signature evasion pattern on Linux cloud workloads: the dropper uninstalls the Alibaba Cloud Aegis (/usr/local/aegis) and Tencent Cloud Monitor (/usr/local/qcloud, YunJing, barad_agent) agents before deploying its XMRig/cnrig/Kinsing-derived miner. This sequence — security-tooling removal directly followed by Monero mining on the same host within an hour — is publicly attributed to Rocke (Cisco Talos, 2018; Palo Alto Unit 42, 2019) and is rarely produced by legitimate admin activity.

ucs.kql:
// Rocke (G0106) — cloud-agent removal followed by miner launch on the same Linux host within 1h
let Lookback = 14d;
let CloudAgentTokens = dynamic(["aegis_update","aegis_cli","/usr/local/aegis","/usr/local/qcloud","YunJing","yunjing","barad_agent","CmsGoAgent","quartz_update","sgagent","AliYunDun","AliHids"]);
let MinerTokens = dynamic(["xmrig","minerd","cnrig","kerberods","kthrotlds","sustes","kinsing","kdevtmpfsi","stratum+tcp","--donate-level","cryptonight","pool.minexmr","supportxmr.com","xmr."]);
let AgentKills = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","systemctl","service","rm","pkill","kill","wget","curl")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudAgentTokens)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("uninstall","stop","disable"," rm ","kill","pkill","systemctl stop","service stop")
    | project AgentTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AgentUser = AccountName,
              AgentCmd = ProcessCommandLine, AgentParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              AgentParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName has_any (MinerTokens) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (MinerTokens)
| join kind=inner AgentKills on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (AgentTime .. AgentTime + 1h)
| project DeviceName, AgentUser,
          AgentTime, AgentCmd, AgentParent,
          MinerTime = Timestamp, MinerProc = FileName, MinerCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, AgentTime)
| order by MinerTime desc

let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 10m;
let EdgePorts = dynamic([443,4443,5000,8000,8080,6443]);
let EdgeIns = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ListeningConnectionCreated")
    | where LocalPort in (EdgePorts)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project EdgeTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,
              EdgeListenProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let PostExploit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("release_agent","/sys/fs/cgroup","bash -i","sh -i","/dev/tcp/","nc -e","nc.exe -e","reverse shell","python -c","Invoke-Expression","DownloadString","-EncodedCommand"))

    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project PostTs = Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              AccountName, SHA256;
EdgeIns
| join kind=inner PostExploit on DeviceName
| where PostTs between (EdgeTs .. EdgeTs + Window)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', PostTs, EdgeTs)
| project EdgeTs, PostTs, DelaySec, DeviceName, RemoteIP, LocalPort,

let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","vivaldi.exe","arc.exe","msedgewebview2.exe","iexplore.exe"]);
let SystemBins = dynamic(["MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","SearchProtocolHost.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseNdr.exe","CSFalconService.exe","explorer.exe"]);
let CredFileNames = dynamic(["Login Data","Login Data For Account","Cookies","Web Data","Local State","logins.json","key3.db","key4.db","cert8.db","cert9.db","signons.sqlite"]);
let CredFolderTokens = dynamic([@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\",@"\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data\",@"\Opera Software\Opera Stable\",@"\Vivaldi\User Data\",@"/.config/google-chrome/",@"/.config/chromium/",@"/.mozilla/firefox/"]);
let CredReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
        or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessId)
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames) or FolderPath has_any (CredFolderTokens)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (SystemBins)
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              CredFile = FolderPath, CredName = FileName;
let NetEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempt","HttpConnectionInspected")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
CredReads
| join kind=inner NetEgress on DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where NetTime between (FileTime .. FileTime + WindowMin)
| summarize FirstFile = min(FileTime),
            FirstNet  = min(NetTime),
            DelaySec  = min(datetime_diff('second', NetTime, FileTime)),
            CredFiles = make_set(strcat(CredFile, CredName), 25),
            RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25),
            RemoteUrls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25),
            RemotePorts = make_set(RemotePort, 25),
            EgressCount = count()
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= 600
| order by FirstFile desc

let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowSeconds = 300;
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","poetry.exe","uv.exe","composer.phar","composer","php.exe","node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe"]);
let Interpreters = dynamic(["node.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let TrustedRegistries = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","codeload.github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","ghcr.io","raw.githubusercontent.com","api.github.com","npmjs.com"]);
let CredFileNames = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc",".netrc",".env","credentials","credentials.json","id_rsa","id_ed25519",".gitconfig","config.json"]);
let CredPathFragments = dynamic([@"\.aws\credentials","/.aws/credentials",@"\.ssh\","/.ssh/",@"\.docker\config.json","/.docker/config.json",@"\.config\gh\","/.config/gh/"]);
let PkgInstallChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrs)
    | where FileName in~ (Interpreters)
    | project ChildTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentName=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildName=FileName,
              ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid=ProcessId,
              ChildSha256=SHA256;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
         or ActionType startswith "FileAccessed"
    | where FileName in~ (CredFileNames)
         or FolderPath has_any (CredPathFragments)
    | project EventTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, Pid=InitiatingProcessId,
              Kind="cred",
              Detail=strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName);
let OffRegistryEgress = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl) or isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | extend Host = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | where not(Host has_any (TrustedRegistries))
    | project EventTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, Pid=InitiatingProcessId,
              Kind="net",
              Detail=strcat(RemoteUrl, " ", RemoteIP, ":", tostring(RemotePort));
let FollowUps = union CredAccess, OffRegistryEgress;
PkgInstallChildren
| join kind=inner FollowUps on DeviceId
| where EventTime between (ChildTime .. ChildTime + WindowSeconds * 1s)
| where Pid == ChildPid or Kind == "net"  // file events are pid-tight; net broadens to host-window
| summarize FollowUpEvents=make_set(strcat(Kind,":",Detail), 25),
            Kinds=make_set(Kind),
            FirstChild=min(ChildTime),
            LastFollowUp=max(EventTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentName, ParentCmd, ChildName, ChildCmd, ChildSha256
| where array_length(Kinds) >= 1
| extend HasCred = Kinds has "cred", HasNet = Kinds has "net"
| order by FirstChild desc

// Sea Turtle DNS hijack — flip in resolved IP for sensitive auth/VPN portals
let lookback = 30d;
let recent   = 1h;
let critical_substrings = dynamic([
    "webmail","owa","autodiscover","vpn","sso","adfs","sts",
    "portal","remote","exchange","citrix","mail.","smtp"
]);
let baseline =

    | where Timestamp between (ago(lookback) .. ago(recent))
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
    | extend Q  = tolower(tostring(AF.QueryName)),
             IPs = tostring(AF.IPAddresses)
    | where isnotempty(Q) and isnotempty(IPs)
    | mv-expand IP = parse_json(IPs)
    | extend IP = tostring(IP)
    | summarize by Q, IP;

| where Timestamp > ago(recent)
| where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
| extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend Q  = tolower(tostring(AF.QueryName)),
         IPs = tostring(AF.IPAddresses)
| where isnotempty(Q) and isnotempty(IPs)
| where Q has_any (critical_substrings)
| mv-expand IP = parse_json(IPs)
| extend IP = tostring(IP)
| where not(ipv4_is_private(IP)) and not(IP startswith "127.") and not(IP startswith "169.254.")
| join kind=leftanti baseline on Q, IP                       // never seen this answer before
| summarize FirstSeen   = min(Timestamp),
            HostCount   = dcount(DeviceName),
            SampleHosts = make_set(DeviceName, 10),
            Resolvers   = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by Q, IP
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.kql:
// Best-effort hunt — DeviceNetworkEvents only sees URLs on inspected HTTP traffic; HTTPS surfaces SNI only. Pair with web-access logs in Sentinel for full coverage.
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess","HttpConnectionInspected")
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| extend stage = case(
    RemoteUrl has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    RemoteUrl has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName, stage
| order by RemoteIP asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(Timestamp), PrevUrl=prev(RemoteUrl), PrevIP=prev(RemoteIP)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and RemoteIP == PrevIP
| where datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=Timestamp, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime),
          DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemotePort, LowPrivUrl=PrevUrl, AdminUrl=RemoteUrl, InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by AdminEventTime desc

ucs.kql:
// Self-hosted niche service spawns shell/ssh/interpreter within 120s of inbound API listener hit
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"
]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe",
  "cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"
]);
let ListenerPorts = dynamic([80,443,2222,3000,4242,5000,8000,8080,8081,8443,8888,9000,9090]);
let WebShellChildren = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where tolower(FileName) in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-dev" and InitiatingProcessFileName !endswith "-test"
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where not(InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("healthcheck","--version","/healthz"))
  | extend ChildTime = Timestamp,
           VulnService = InitiatingProcessFileName,
           ChildBin    = FileName,
           ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
           ParentPid   = InitiatingProcessId
  | project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ParentPid,
           InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FolderPath, SHA256;
let InboundHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
  | where ActionType in ("InboundConnectionAccepted","ConnectionInbound","ListeningConnectionCreated")
  | where LocalPort in (ListenerPorts) or RemotePort in (ListenerPorts)
  | extend InboundTime = Timestamp,
           RemoteSrc   = tostring(RemoteIP),
           ListenerPort = coalesce(LocalPort, RemotePort)
  | project DeviceId, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ListenerPort, InitiatingProcessFileName;
WebShellChildren
| join kind=inner InboundHits on DeviceId
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ListenerPorts = make_set(ListenerPort, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, ParentPid, SHA256

| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, DeviceName, AccountName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,

ucs.title: [LLM] SideCopy (G1008) LNK→mshta.exe remote-HTA stager fetching second-stage from attacker infrastructure
ucs.description: Hunts SideCopy's signature initial-access chain — a spearphishing archive containing an LNK that invokes mshta.exe with a remote HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch a malicious HTA stager (the technique it borrowed from / mimics Sidewinder, hence the name). The combination of mshta with an external URL parented by explorer.exe / archive extractors / Office is highly specific to this Pakistan-nexus crew.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.dest) as host from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="mshta.exe" (Processes.process="*http://*" OR Processes.process="*https://*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*") (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe","outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=cmdline "(?<remote_url>https?://[^\s\"']+|\\\\\\\\[^\s\"']+)" | where isnotnull(remote_url) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// SideCopy G1008 — mshta.exe loading a remote HTA (T1218.005) parented by explorer/archive/Office
let _archive_or_office = dynamic(["explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","7zg.exe","outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","thunderbird.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "mshta.exe"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
// SideCopy stagers always pass an http(s) URL or UNC path as the first arg to mshta
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","\\\\")
// parent narrows to user-driven launches typical of LNK-from-archive opens
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_archive_or_office)
| extend RemoteUrl = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[^\s\"']+|\\\\[^\s\"']+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
// pivot: did mshta then talk out to that destination? high-confidence chain
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "mshta.exe"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl_net = RemoteUrl
  ) on DeviceId
| where isnull(NetTime) or NetTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 2m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          MshtaCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteUrl, NetTime, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl_net,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.title: [LLM] SideCopy (G1008) DLL side-loading: signed-binary loader running from user-writable path with co-located unsigned DLL
ucs.description: Hunts SideCopy's hallmark second-stage delivery — they consistently drop a legitimate signed binary (Microsoft/Adobe/Citrix/Credential Manager helpers) into %TEMP% / %APPDATA% / %PUBLIC% alongside a malicious DLL whose name matches an import the binary search-order-loads. ucs.kql:
// SideCopy G1008 — DLL side-loading: signed Microsoft/Adobe binary in user dir loading
// an unsigned/different-author DLL from the SAME directory (T1574.001)
let _user_writable = dynamic([@"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Downloads\"]);
// SideCopy-favoured signed-binary lures (Action/Reverse/AllaKore loader vehicles)
let _abused_loaders = dynamic(["credwiz.exe","CredentialUIBroker.exe","DismHost.exe","WerFault.exe","taskhostw.exe","msiexec.exe","PrintIsolationHost.exe","vmtoolsd.exe","DUser.dll-host"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
// loader binary itself dropped into a user-writable path
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (_user_writable)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_abused_loaders)
   or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any ("Microsoft Corporation","Adobe","Citrix","VMware")
// loaded module is also from the same user-writable path = classic side-load
| where FolderPath has_any (_user_writable)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
// strip noise: same publisher / system DLLs / matching SHA256 (digest match = same file)
| where SHA256 != InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          LoaderImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          LoaderCompany = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          LoaderProduct = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName,
          LoaderSHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          LoaderCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          DllName = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath, DllSHA256 = SHA256, DllSize = FileSize,
          User = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FolderPath has_any (_user_writable)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, DllPath = FolderPath, DllName = FileName,
              DropProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName, DropParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName

WindowsEvent

         Signed = tostring(EventData.Signed),
         SignatureStatus = tostring(EventData.SignatureStatus),

         User = tostring(EventData.User),

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sidewinder CVE-2017-11882 Equation Editor Child Process
id: 9b3d4f7e-1a2b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects EQNEDT32.EXE spawning script interpreters or LOLBins, the canonical Sidewinder (T-APT-04 / Rattlesnake) RTF spearphishing initial-access chain.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-11882
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.g0121
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\EQNEDT32.EXE'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of Equation Editor is essentially nil since Microsoft pulled it in Jan 2018 — any child process is highly suspicious

let PkgMgr = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm","pnpm.exe","pnpm","yarn.exe","yarn","pip.exe","pip","pip3.exe","pip3","uv.exe","uv","poetry.exe","poetry","nuget.exe","dotnet.exe","code.exe","cursor.exe"]);

let Installs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (PkgMgr)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," add ","restore","--install-extension"," ci ")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = FileName, PkgCmd = ProcessCommandLine;

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
